You can see the main novelties in this article. The complete list of changes is available in the patch note.

Click on the link below to see it.

Full Change Log

Main New Content

Special Operation "Heist"

In the new special operation, you’ll have to pull off a full-blown bank robbery and destroy data that mustn’t fall into the hands of General Lee Wharton. "Heist" is a mission for two partners, who with the help of new cable mechanics will move along the bank building, open three storage facilities with increasing levels of difficulty, while simultaneously fighting the police and special forces and, of course, immerse themselves in the atmosphere of a dynamic action-packed thriller.

We created a thematic set of achievements for the new special operation, which can be earned by completing "Heist".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/64792f108f1a942e0e69b2eba51a14c963363213.png

M4 Marksman Custom

The model is a semi-automatic weapon that is capable of destroying the enemy with two impacts at any distance. It favourably compares to its closest competitors (the rifles H&K G28 and Cobalt Kinetics Twenty-Seven) thanks to an increased damage and better rate of fire offset by a less spacious magazine and more modest ammo. The arm comes equipped with 5 unique attachments: a flame suppressor, two handles, a collimator sight and a regular sight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/9f29d9728965030e82099743a877a07dba843f7a.jpg

"The Big Score" Series

The looks of the models will remind you about the success of the mission - just look at the weapon frames and enjoy the detailed cutscene with the opening of the vault. In addition, the guns have gold inlays, which symbolize the bank's wealth and will appeal to those who like to shoot from eye-catching weapons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/6aad526cec4378abbaf59f88c0172dee5b0aa6cf.png

"Heist" Map for Blitz

The battle on the new map for the "Blitz" mode will unfold in locations inspired by the namesake Special Operation "Heist". The main field of battle is an elite bank located in a skyscraper. The rules remain the same: you have to find and defuse a bomb. However, the task is not as easy as it might seem - the enemies will do their best to derail the mission and detonate the charge.

Themed Safe House

The guards of the bank, which you will have to rob during the new special operation, train in the Safe House. The Safe House is decorated with themed elements and looks pretty realistic. "Parkour" training is also updated. The location got new easter eggs, which reveal new details of the plot. Will you be able to find all of them?

Kalashnikov USA Komrad 12

The Kalashnikov USA Komrad 12 is an automatic shotgun boasting excellent specs. It favourably compares to its main competitors Uzkon UNG-12 and Typhoon F12 thanks to increased damage, great firing range and impressive hip fire accuracy, which are offset by an average rate of fire and modest ammo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/fb519cc2dfac04c977896ff2c8fbf292fb1010e8.jpg

"Shapeshifter" Gear Set

"Shapeshifter" gear is equipment for hired robbers. It is essential for them to have good protection from bullets in shootouts with the police. The new gear has the best direct armour protection (more armour points for vests, and more damage absorption points for every shot); however, it is less appealing in all other respects since it features lower movement speed values, reduced number of secondary bonuses (for example, bonuses to recoil, spread and reload), and moderate health restoration, as well as a complete lack of armour replenishment.

In addition, due to the special distribution of armour points among the class vests of the set, it was possible to achieve an increase in the efficiency and value of the Rifleman on the battlefield - this class received the highest number of armour points. With the new armour, the Rifleman will be able to survive longer and gain precious seconds to complete the battle in his or her favour.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/d1c168aa705c298f516fe5831ad7b81edb90f528.jpg

"Shapeshifter" Skins

The exclusive "Shapeshifter" skins offer a unique boost - they increase the overall sprint distance by 60%. The skins are the outfit of robbers who hide their identities with frightening masks. They instill fear in any opponent and are available in 4 class-specific versions: the mask of a wolf, a bull, a monkey or a raven.

Weapon and Camo Series

The Battle Pass "Heist" offers brand new marvellous series "Heat" and "Mechanical". The most active fighters will be able to get their hands on powerful arms inspired by the new Special Operation. Themed camos set in the same style will be a pleasant cosmetic bonus for fans of the series.

"Heist" Weapon Charms

You will be able to expand your collection of available weapon charms with brand new items set in the style of the Special Operation "Heist". They will remind you of taking part in a sensational robbery and fleeing the police and special forces.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/1f3c5caff9667ce4b029487a2d74e97c07777fd4.png

Battle Pass Achievements

Participants of the Battle Pass will be able to gain unique achievements and decorate their profiles with them. Earn all the distinctions and showcase your vault hacking experience at the most secure bank!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/6aa7ff46c34e6a2724913cb1552ace3dbb2119b8.png

АK-15 Custom

The assault rifle AK-15 is designed as an impressive modified version of the real prototype (hence the word Custom in the name) with a lot of attachments. The AK-15 Custom offers all the perks of its main competitors, but inflicts more damage due to its larger caliber. It also surpasses its counterparts in the rate of fire and hip fire accuracy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/825efdedbc41c346c4ba64629086d58de6deb3a5.jpg

The golden version of the gun sports an increased rate of fire, as well as a more spacious magazine and greater ammo. By eliminating enemies with it, you'll be able to get a unique distinction.

"Lucky Rabbit" Series

The seasonal Ranked Matches weapon and camouflage series line-up has been replenished with a brand new one - the spring collection "Lucky Rabbit". This special line-up is designed for the best fighters, who can boast regular impressive victories and enjoy the overall excitement of the battle while eliminating competitors in the struggle for the highest leagues. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/9df4c5feae4fd2b494bf5d52c6fd412b0864ecc9.jpg

By landing killing blows with the "Lucky Rabbit" series, you'll be able to pin a special distinction on your profile.

Toy Hammer;
improved situation with "freezes";
crouch/stand up command improvements;
improved "bloody" effect upon impact;
gear presets;
in-game chat interface improvements.

Read about all these and other changes in the full change log.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/01f3fc7b2b82e0a58b13f592b98943c9bce53e0f.png

In-game improvements

Reworked PvE interface

We've completely revamped the interface of the PvE section. Now PvE missions, Special Operations and training will be combined into one section "PvE" in the main menu. See a detailed description of the changes below.

[olist]The PvE and Special Operations sections in the player's lobby have been united into one category "PvE". After opening it, the player will be able to go to the following sections: "Special Operations", "PvE Missions" or "Training".
Special Operations
Now the player has access to big images demonstrating a line-up of special operations. You can view the full list using the navigation keys ("carousel") on the screen or by rotating the mouse wheel.
In the menu of the section, the player will be able to select the special operation he or she feels like playing, choose a difficulty level and see the basic information on the mission (description, rewards and their progress).
Section ''PvE-missions". Here you will find the current missions in the rotation, the status of their completion and information about the rewards.
Section "Training". In this section, the player will be able to get acquainted with the main game mechanics by completing the Solo Mission. The namesake mission "Training", which existed alongside the Solo Mission, is now available in the "PvE missions" section.
The interface now features new mission image formats. They are now available in high resolutions (1024x1024 and 512x512 - depending on their location in the interface).[/olist]

We'd like to remind you that interface redesign is a large-scale and time-consuming process that has several stages. Previously, we changed the looks of the lobby and those of the main menu, and now we are making tweaks to the PvE-mode interface. We will continue to work in this direction and will deliver other tweaks in the future. Stay tuned.

Optimization of loading attachments in the game

We have changed the approach to information processing and taught the game to remember which set of attachments was equipped the last time you played. Now, at the beginning of the match, if the settings have not been changed, they will be loaded instantly, since information about them is saved. If you change the kit, the game engines will update the data and remember the new set that will load just as quickly next time.

The change will solve the problem when, at the beginning of the match, you could observe that the attachments on the weapon did not get loaded immediately. This was due to the fact that every time the game algorithms used to re-process the information on the attachments you were playing with. It took time to get the data, so for a few seconds the player could see that the attachments were missing.

Solo Mission improvements

We've simplified some mechanics in the Solo Mission:

now cyborgs cannot knock down a soldier;
in "Chernobyl", bots have become simpler to deal with - they deal less damage and have less health.
These changes will help beginners quickly adapt to the game and provide more opportunities for learning game mechanics, as well as make the completion of the mission more comfortable.

Other

Improved the quality of shadows cast by various light sources. This change will help to get rid of certain visual artifacts.
The game defense system has learned to deal with several unintended game advantages more.

See the full list of changes here.

Good luck in combat!

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/f982017b9c71bcbea9e59e71223068114d203d77.jpg

Soldiers!

The January update has been installed on the Warface servers. It brings fixes to the abuse of the "crouch/stand up" and "prone/stand up" mechanics, expanded "Great Gatsby" weapon series, fixes to some bugs and much more. Hurry up to check the list of changes and try them out in game!

Reworked mechanics

We often received requests to rework the key mechanics related to the character's movement while shooting. Surely you have found yourself in a situation when the enemy actively uses the “crouch” and “prone” positions; as a result, the animation of the model is fully played even if the action is performed partially. In the current update, we have reworked the logic and mechanics of these positions. Details.

"Crouch/stand up" positions

The character position now depends on one of the chosen mechanics of using the command - "to hold a key" or "to press a key". Two main points have been revamped: the synchronization of animations in the first and the third person views, and the effectiveness of the “crouch” command and its fading upon repeated activation.

[olist]If the player presses the key, the character model will crouch completely, and if the button is held, it will perform the action depending on the time the key is being pressed. If it is a short-term action, the crouch animation will be partial and the character will soon return to its standing position. Upon a fleeting holding of the key, the enemy silhouette will practically not change in size - it is not easy to notice a change in the enemy height by a couple of centimeters.
Each subsequent short-term key holding will be less effective, and at a certain point it will stop working altogether - the character will not take the "crouch" position. The ability to use the command will be restored after a few seconds of inaction.[/olist]

"Prone/stand up" positions

The "prone" position has an intermediate "crouch" animation stage. Some players used to abuse this mechanic and deliberately skip the mentioned movement in the "prone/stand up" commands. In this case, the character animation looked jerky and abrupt. Now, it will be impossible to skip the intermediate "crouch" stage. This will also apply to those situations when the player performs various movements alongside the action; for example, uses an instant exit from the "prone" position through a jump.

Improved logic of slide sounds

If the player performed an action and collided with an obstacle (a wall), the sliding sound continued to be played and did not stop; some players deliberately exploited this in combat. Now, the sound is synced to the active action. If the slide gets interrupted ahead of time, the sliding sound will also stop playing.

New Content

Expanded "Great Gatsby" series

One of the most beautiful weapon series has been replenished with 6 models: the assault rifle CZ 805 BREN A2, the shotgun Kel-Tec KS7, the submachine gun AMB-17, the sniper rifle SV-98, the pistol TEC-9 and the Gerber Tomahawk. Previously, the sounds of moving around the floor were similar to those played on the first floor; now the sound of walking on the second floor will be different - more sonorous ("metallic") instead of dull. We'd like to learn you feedback on this change - be sure to share you impressions in the comments.

Learn more about other changes. Details.

Have a nice game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/ef118aa9b7676623265ba5adf1f6145bd27e9537.jpg

We will tell you about ways of getting this weapon series in our future publications.

Christmas Content

Xmas Hangar

Is this what you expected? We have updated the Christmas version of one of the most popular maps in the game. Snowball shootouts or Candy Knife battles will provide the right kind of a festive vibe. The Hangar is a great place to enjoy the usual dynamic gameplay and misbehave a bit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/984f558832799f0c6a66c4f4b6eba9bec1c7110a.jpg

Your task is invariably simple: destroy as many opponents as possible using any available means. Hide a mine behind a nice gift, make your enemies really happy with the surprise! But be on the alert - watch out and look under your feet. Rumor has it that iced containers are very slippery. In addition, upon completing a match on this map, you will see a festive background on the statistics screen decorated with gifts and a Christmas tree. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/aea25c63eb5a33bfd5d16950b82af368b5ac2235.png

Naturally, wins on this map will be rewarded with special achievements. Collect the festive set and decorate your profile!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/a676a330c9213f33aa160e397188ef1a9f3f68ca.png

"Glacier" Series

There can be no celebrations without cool arms. Warface now offers a festive weapon series "Glacier", which you can earn right now in a special event. The guns boast original looks and a colourful frosty animation. Beware, the arms are ice-cold, do not forget to put on gloves!

WINTER OPERATION

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/2cfcbcc809bab301674024e9d92ba4c2866df6a2.jpg

Soon there will appear another way of obtaining the weapons of this series. We will provide further information about it in a separate article.

Killing blows made with these weapons will grant you sleek achievements!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/608bf7aeeadb8126a3e5cfbcb1240d1c57f64184.png

Festive Weapon Charm

You've probably noticed many little ducklings in various locations in Warface. And this is not for nothing! Ducks are cute little Easter eggs in the game. And now one of them is now available among the weapon charms. By mounting it on a gun, you will receive +100 to the holiday mood and +100 to luck in battles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/f3340d6f234ddbbc98ebe28a28cd90b1927d08bd.png

Festive Achievements

A special set of achievements awaits true fans of Warface and winter holidays lovers. These distinctions will help you keep the memory of cool events for a long time. We will tell you how to get the entire coat of arms later, stay tuned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/37ee0e381e40d600825211baf133e3c6d2572f53.png

Festive Safe House

Not only game maps are now filled with Christmas spirit. A very important place for every soldier - the Safe House - has also changed for the winter holidays. Christmas wreaths, gift boxes, festive decorations, snowballs, fairy lights, a snowman and even reindeer images have been added to its decor.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/1e3c59aa254cc16a73a6034851af74d75904ccb6.png

In-game Improvements

Reworked Pockets

Now you can take two smoke grenades into battle instead of just one. The implementation is simple: now the player will be able to customize two support slots (the former "Smoke grenade" and "Flashbang grenade"). The total number of slots has not changed and remained the same, the customization possibility has been added only to the "Support" pockets. Thus, this will allow you to choose which set of additional grenades is more important in combat - a flashbang and a smoke grenade or two smoke grenades.

In addition, some visual changes have been made to the equipped item information panel that is displayed in a match. Now the number of consumables is shown on the center panel, and not on the side panel as it used to be.

"Delete all" button

A long-awaited and very necessary button is already activated in the notification box. Now you can forget about the routine manual deleting of notifications - pressing one button will quickly save you from unnecessary spam. Please note: notifications with a choice option (for example, clan invitations or friend requests) cannot be deleted using this button.

Updated Metrics

The server TickRate measurement units have been changed (from milliseconds to hertz). Previously, with a server value of 60 Hz, the client displayed 16.6 ms - these are correct and equivalent indicators. The value of 16.6 ms comes from the formula: 1000 ms / 60 Hz, it reflects information on the data exchange speed between the server and the game client. The user ultimately saw this value on his/her screen. It attracted attention and was interpreted ambiguously, so now the measurement units upon switching to hertz will become more understandable and obvious for each player.

Automatic DirectX 11 Support Detection

Now the Game Center automatically detects DirectX 11 support when the game client starts. If your PC supports this function, the client will be launched with the specified setting. Otherwise, the client will start with DirectX 9 support. We remind you that you can also change it manually in the game settings in the Game Center.

Other Changes

Important

Exchange rate tweaks in the crafting system

The prices in the crafting system have been changed. The exchange of extra cards for free ones for the in-game currencies is now cheaper: 7500 Warface Dollars and 75 Crowns; and you will need to spend 5 cards less to get a free card free of charge.

Other

Improved calculation of the aimed fire direction. Now watching other players shooting, the user will be able to see the correct trajectory. It will coincide with the direction on the server - this will reduce the number of visual errors related to incorrect shooting display.
The Christmas versions of the maps "Xmas Icebound", "Residence Xmas", "Phantom Zone" and "Xmas Oil Depot" are back in the rotation.
The music theme has been replaced with the festive one.
Added themed "Special" class items.

Check out the full list of changes and bug fixes here.

Good luck in game!

notes.title: Soon in game: Benelli M4 Custom and AN-94 "Abakan" and Game Center Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/2dc6b47ddf0c380df973d691f54ad7c9fdd8f6a7.jpg

Soldiers!

In the upcoming update, the primary weapon selection will be replenished with new items. Hurry up to learn more. We are sharing the first details. Medics will get a powerhouse of a shotgun Benelli M4 Custom, while the Riflemen's arsenal will be topped up with the assault rifle AN-94 "Abakan". These guns sport excellent specifications and can be easily modified to suit the shooter's needs, which will definitely appeal to connoisseurs of perfectly balanced weapons.

Benelli M4 Custom

The M4 is the first auto-regulating gas-operated shotgun produced by Benelli. Its simplicity, durability and originality quickly attracted the public interest - and the weapon was quickly employed by the military. Its system consists of two main parts: a gas chamber and a short stroke gas piston. The patented gas-operated system guarantees high accuracy of fire, as well as reliability and durability of the weapon. This made the M4 one of the best combat shotguns of the US military.

In the game, the arm offers a semi-automatic firing mode. Anyone armed with a Benelli M4 Custom is capable of easily eliminating any opponent with one single shot. In addition, depending on the tactical situation, the gun can be easily modified with a unique suppressor and a fast 1,3x zoom sight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/127f4c827b1fbe5cebcb06ed9d11c34119093d50.jpg

The golden version, apart from luxurious looks, will boast an even higher rate of fire and increased magazine capacity.

Benelli M4 Custom Suppressor reduces muzzle flash and damage drop, and improves penetration.
Collimator Hakko BED-24 Panorama sports a fast 1.3x zoom and reduces spread and recoil by 20%.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/62fdd69c5e40580d876762ed6a4ff82b462f9133.png

By landing killing blows with the new weapon, you'll get memorable distinctions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/8b174c4f877af4d0edc9eb2bf701be1708b947d1.png

AN-94 "Abakan"

The AN-94 "Abakan" was developed by a small arms designer Gennady Nikonov. The assault rifle boasts high accuracy and low spread. When firing in long bursts, the weapon shows as good performance as the AK-74 regarding accuracy and bullet spread while in single burst fire mode it even surpasses its peer due to a long sight line.

In the game, the rifle fires two bullets in a semi-automatic firing mode. The weapon specs are perfectly balanced: excellent damage and rate of fire, good aiming range and the availability of a unique grip that reduces spread and increases the arm reloading speed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/b478095354a03b60fd589630629eb2f58927adc2.jpg

The golden version of the assault rifle, apart from stunning looks, will boast an even better effective range and increased magazine capacity.

A special "Abakan" grip decreases spread and recoil by 15%, and improves the reload speed by 15%.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/c0ef64d1ff2953ec4e31386970ead79dfdccfea8.png

By landing killing blows with the new weapon, you'll get memorable distinctions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/5aa18f3fac0f952a37c8a6cca67e341729e3b056.png

Please note that the specs indicated are preliminary and can be subject to change per general testing results.

Game Center Update

Following our strategy of improving the regional matchmaking, we are going to readjust the sub-server selection option for some players. In the near future some regions will remain hidden for a player depending on the ping value they have for each region.

Here’s a quick breakdown of how it will work:

If a player has the ping value of 60ms and less for at least one region, all other regions (having the value of 60+ ms) will be unavailable for them;
If a player’s ping is higher than 60ms for all regions in the list, the selection option will remain the same as it is now.

Please note that these values are preliminary and are subject to change per general testing results. We will be closely monitoring your feedback and our internal statistics to ensure the desired positive impact of these changes.

As we have mentioned before, we are also working on improving the server coverage area as well as readjusting our server structure. Stay tuned for more details!

See you in combat!

notes.title: November Hotfix - 11.11.20 [UPD]
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/be730339136d592b3d531913af5a198224098534.png

Soldiers!

A minor hotfix to the current game version has been installed on the Warface servers. Check out the information and evaluate the changes in the game!

UPD: At 12:45 UTC (13:45 CET), DirectX 11 support was disabled. We recommend restarting the Game Center and updating the Warface client.

Important: DirectX 11 support is in a testing mode now. If you are facing any problems (such as client crashes) please follow the steps below:  
[olist]
 Press a small arrow near the "Play" button in the Game centre.
 Choose "Game settings".
 Uncheck the DirectX 11 support button and press OK.
[/olist]
In case it doesn't help, please contact our Support service.

Technical improvements

DirectX 11 Support

The game client is featuring DirectX 11 support in a testing mode. It will help the system use modern graphics processors more efficiently and increase performance quality, solving a few problems caused by DirectX 9 at the same time. The game centre can automatically check which version of DirectX is supported by the player’s computer at the moment — and open the corresponding application. Read the details.

In case we face any unexpected issues during the testing, DirectX 11 support may be disabled.

NVIDIA Reflex

Along with the DirectX 11 support, Warface players will also enjoy brand new NVIDIA Reflex technology decreasing system delay, which can appear between the moment you press the key and its appearance on the screen. You can enable this technology in the graphics setting menu. NVIDIA Reflex can work in a normal mode as well as the turbo one, which disables energy-saving mode in order to work with higher efficiency. We will tell more about the NVIDIA Reflex technology in a dedicated article.

Other changes


 Now the client with a DirectX 11 support consumes fewer system resources in a minimized window mode.
 Safehouse content was updated for the upcoming “Swarm” special operation — location is slightly different now, and the shooting range can boast some new targets, looking like arachnids. Apart from that, new mini-game for your shooting skills has been added to the shooting range. You can start the game with a special terminal with a green indicator in the centre of the shooting gallery.
 Halloween celebration is over. Themed “Farm” and “Street wars” maps as well as the music theme are back to their original versions.


Bug fixes


 Typhoon F12 Custom "Guardian": fixed the problem due to which weapon had a wrong description.
 FN P90 Custom, HCAR Auto, M16A3 Custom "Fiesta", Golden Katana, Golden FN SCAR-H, SIG MPX SBR Custom "Frankenstein": fixed the problem due to which kills didn’t count for these weapons during the “Mutiny” battle pass.

"Exclusion Area" Map

An energy barrier rules out any movement beyond the zone, attempts to overcome the barrier will result in the death of the character.

An electromagnetic pulse tower is located in the center of the zones. Its delayed impact can be activated by one of the players via a special terminal, and 120 seconds later a powerful electromagnetic pulse destroys all living beings within the area. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/451535f8dd486018e3f8a8abd284ad5b765eb880.jpg

Golden Katana

The arm has got a luxurious golden version that can boast not only impeccable looks but improved performance as well. The golden katana deals more damage with the main and the secondary attacks, and sports an increased damage radius. Details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/179265cd7aa210a2c21c8fd04086dca403be1e87.jpg

"Halloween" Series

Meet and greet the "Halloween" weapon series, a perfect combination of lethal power of potent guns and a unique themed design. The weapons are decorated with the popular Halloween symbols: sinister Jack-o'-lanterns with a nasty cemetery with the living dead on the background. The fantastic colourful decoration patterns on the weapons' frames will surely impress your opponents and delight you. Apart from the guns, there are camouflages set in the same style. Details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/c098da4d30a3e331e320257fd99227a7eefe4763.png

By eliminating opponents with the weapons of the "Halloween" series, you can get unique achievements - a mark, a badge and a stripe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/35d92ae294fcd25e8546df8be802d9b01431bb58.png

Themed Weapon Charms

Themed weapon decorations will send chills down your enemies' spines! The game now offers 5 new charms dedicated to Halloween and designed as symbols of this spooky holiday. Details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/c5204fa6b60fc18083e519eb89084be6f02153c0.png

Pumpkin Claymore

One of the most recognizable Halloween attributes is the Jack-o'-lantern that has now become even deadlier! Unlike other mines in Warface, the unique pumpkin claymore can be thrown right at the enemy's feet. At the same time, it will roll off inclined surfaces or bounce off walls like a grenade. The pumpkin destroys everything around it and deals as much damage as the antipersonnel mine. Details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/06313084a24b946656911e64db2e37507639c6de.png

The new item ignores boots with a mine detonation delay and cannot be destroyed by a shot; however, it disappears from the map on its own 25 seconds after being thrown.

Festive Helmets

New helmets can scare off even the most seasoned fighters! The helmets feature a unique look for each class and will become a great match for the "Halloween" vests. The helmets increase head protection by 40% and reduce the flashbang effect by 40%. Details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/7307634f5c75d112d5a87c4109aefe7b443a00c4.png

"Frankenstein" Series

Another series oozing the spirit of the most creepy holiday! These weapons look really intimidating and clearly hint to the enemy that you are not the one to joke with. Apart from the Frankenstein guns, you will also find similar skins. Details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/e1c936cdc397380dba92b5c928c71099c47de728.png

By killing enemies using the "Frankenstein" weapons, you can earn stripes of the weapon expert!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/04c030e27a06b1545b53e91cfd3200758859aad8.png

TECHNICAL CHANGES

DISCONTINUING SUPPORT FOR 32-BIT OS

Starting from the current game version, we fully discontinue our support for 32-bit systems that are now still used by a small percentage of players. Change to 64-bit systems will shorten the development of new content and allow to elaborate higher quality and more varied gameplay on a larger scale as well as improve performance of the game client by giving it the opportunity to use more RAM. User PCs with fewer RAM will be able to employ the page file more efficiently, thus avoiding client crashes. Details.

TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE MONITORING

Warface now has several tools for tracking important technical parameters such as Internet connection and PC performance. The monitoring tools allow you to choose the optimal equipment settings for comfortable gaming. In case there occur any problems (we hope, there will not be any), special indicators will promptly notify you about this. Details.

CONTENT CHANGES

WEAPON TWEAKS

The textures and models of M4A1, Remington Model 870, H&K MP5, Browning High Power and FN P90 as well as their position in the character's hands when viewed from the first and the third person have been improved. In addition, the icons of achievements for killing enemies with the specified guns have been updated.

The specs of the standard weapon versions have also been tweaked.

M4A1: increased rate of fire (from 610 to 620); lower recoil; reduced minimum spread.
Remington Model 870: increased damage (from 600 to 620); increased rate of fire (from 80 to 85); reduced maximum and minimum spread.
H&K MP5: increased damage (from 56 to 60); lower recoil, reduced maximum recoil.
Dragunov SR: increased damage (from 150 to 155); increased rate of fire (from 260 to 270); increased zoom-in speed.
Browning High Power: increased damage (from 65 to 70); increased rate of fire (from 285 to 300); increased zoom-in speed.

Learn more.

notes.title: Important information on the coming update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/a8acd50b2100efd7b1026d1f406b6a60953979c3.jpg

Dear players!

The massive September update will be launched in the coming days. It will bring not only tons of new content and the test season of the first in-game Battle Pass but will also enable better synchronization between the CIS game version updates and EU/NA ones. With that we are aiming to fix a range of technical issues as well as build a process for bringing content updates at a faster pace. However, this requires two measures that we want to address in this article.

First, the installment of September update will mean the re-downloading of the full game for all the players – that is approximately 17GB of data. We realize how much we inconvenience you with this, so we have prepared a compensation – a Mega VIP booster for 3 days. The way of obtaining your booster will be announced in the update article, once the update goes live. Furthermore, we want to assure you this is a necessary one-off measure that will provide plenty of benefits in the long run. Thank you for your understanding!

The second measure has to do with Battle Pass: Season 0, the test season of the in-game Battle Pass. Its duration will be altered to one week, while the reward accumulation rate will be significantly modified. This way, you will be able to seize all the prizes despite the limited nature of this test event. A lot of bugs and issues have been located and fixed in it during the CIS version tests, so for our update we would like to have a clean one-week run, during which you will hopefully have plenty of fun and rewards. After that, EU/NA and the CIS region will embrace “Mutiny”, the first full-fledged in-game Battle Pass. As for the mentioned modifications used for Season O, we really need your opinion.

There are three options for these modifications:

[olist]Unlock all Battle Pass tasks on day one, without having to wait for new tasks every single day
Put the minimum cost of skipping a task – a nominal value in Warface Dollars
Do both – options 1 and 2 combined[/olist]
To vote, please click the button below that will take you to our discord server PC announcement section. There, react to the notification of this article with numbers “1”, “2” or “3” respectively. We will be closely monitoring the voting and your feedback.

VOTE NOW

Thank you very much for your patience and your understanding. Please look forward to the coming update.

With all the respect,

Warface Team

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/1a6403effdefa286db6677acaec195398dfc51b1.png

Soldiers!

The August Update has landed on the Warface servers. Welcome the machine gun H&K 121, new Ranked Matches skins, tweaks to weapons and gear, and much more. Hurry up to try out the novelties!

NEW CONTENT

H&K 121

The H&K 121 has expanded the Rifleman machine gun lineup. Its toughest competitor is the Stoner LMG A1 to which the new weapon compares favourably thanks to an increased rate of fire, better accuracy, a larger magazine, and a higher damage multiplier in the arms. These advantages are offset by a slightly lower damage, moderate range and ammo. Learn more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/7e2da40ae1ea01a99ddd631a836af34503354472.jpg

The owners of the golden version of the H&K 121 can get a unique stripe by eliminating 999 opponents.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/a9b48a6789ed90b555fe17842d5c47ba9637affb.png

NEW SEASONAL RM SKINS

Our new seasonal Ranked Matches camos were inspired by playing cards. The skins are decorated with colourful images of cards flying in different directions and framing lifeless "ladies" and "kings". The design conveys a clear message: the owner of such a skin is no joke! The series includes skins for such weapons as F90 MBR, Tavor TS12 Custom, SIG MPX SBR Custom, Truvelo CMS 20x42 mm, Maxim 9 and the Gerber Tomahawk. Learn more.

SPADES SKINS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/c777f1dff50e649500e18b2eb1b9650628629973.png

CLUBS SKINS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/7d284dd9b4ca2a2ee3ba60a4c5fc41746fcef3b3.png

DIAMONDS SKINS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/d9c881fc3e9bbe5f079dd1f164421f2d27e85ead.png

HEARTS SKINS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/13219007ddbc79a7f8db5fe30cc3e9926498e660.png

The seasonal skins will become available in the upcoming Ranked Matches season. We will tell you more about it soon in a separate article.

Warface PRO I SKINS

Another skin series will interest everyone who is into Warface eSports events, and prefers to use the most powerful guns available. The colour scheme of the Warface PRO I series continues the tradition of the line-ups dedicated to the tournaments of the past years, combining perfect style and bright colours. Attachments will get a fresh coat of paint as well. Such skinned arms will look great in the hands of your character! The series features skins for such weapons as Howa Type 89 Custom, Kel-Tec KS7, AM-17, SV-98, M134-GAU19b Hybrid, Kel-Tec SUB2000 and the Gerber Tomahawk. Learn more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/91da57a9b85dfbb85de021b703523b8dfe01daa1.png

We will tell you more about how to get the Warface PRO I skins later. Follow the news!

TECHNICAL CHANGES

IMPROVEMENTS TO THE ACTION SYNCHRONIZATION SYSTEM

We have recently told you how in-game events sometimes create a short-term, but abnormally high load on server algorithms. Such a peak load causes micro-delays when performing in-game actions for example, dealing damage, moving characters, etc.

As result of the study of the previously collected data, we have elaborated a plan and carried out measures aimed to eliminate the "load peaks". We will talk about further system improvements in future publications.

CONTENT CHANGES

TWEAKS TO WEAPONS AND GEAR

The list of the primary class-specific weapons of the "Salamander" set has been expanded. As before, the set includes only regular weapon versions. Learn more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/6a3c5c80dde1bc15494817a8728bac43995bf175.png

All the weapon versions will be subject to change, unless stated otherwise. Have a look at the table below to discover what combat stats will be revamped.

The visual model of the melee weapon Black Hawk will be reworked in the next update. Now it will be more detailed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/227917030680ebdddacb768fdaa6460d3950a363.png

In addition, themed models and achievements obtained upon eliminating enemies with the regular version of the axe have also been modified.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/9673e58fcd88b364666d92286701545ff5b870bc.png

OTHER CHANGES

Important

Added Warface PRO I achievements (3 marks, 14 badges, 6 stripes).
Reworked the system of log-in rewards.
- Now in one set there can be several reward streaks instead of just one (at the moment, there are three of them).
- To access the next streak, you must complete the previous one without interruption.
- In reward sets of several streaks the last one will repeat. After completing it without interruption, you will return to the beginning of the same streak instead of the first one.
- The last streak contains the most valuable rewards.
- The entire set and the streaks now have separate timers. At the moment, 7 missed days reset the progress of the current streak and return you to the previous one; while 30 missed weeks reset the progress of the entire set.
The "Quick Play" matchmaking rules have been updated: now the user will not be able to join the match from which he or she was kicked.
The rules of the "Storm" mode have been changed:
- the round time for each side was reduced to 10 minutes (it used to be 15);
- the fighters of both teams will now respawn faster;
- the time required to capture a command post has been reduced;
- now for the fastest possible capture of a command post, you need 3 soldiers instead of 4;
- the ratio between the time spent in the match and the rewards received (both for the first victory of the day and in case of victory/defeat) has been preserved. 

General

Added АК Alpha Random Boxes.
Localization changes.

BUG FIXES

IMPORTANT

Fixed an error due to which the vault animation (for example, overcoming a low fence) by the character was not displayed if the action was performed while shooting.
Fixed an error due to which in some cases the double climb could not be performed.
Fixed an error due to which the player stack indicators were not displayed in PvE and Special Operation rooms.
Fixed an exploit that in some cases allowed to achieve desynchronization of the displayed and the real position of the character, and, thus, get an unintended advantage.

Weapons and gear

F90 MBR: fixed an error which caused visual artifacts on the weapon with equipped camos.
Jackhammer, AS VAL, M16A3 Custom, Steyr Scout, DP-27, Saiga Bullpup, Fabarm XLR5 Prestige, Saiga Spike, Mossberg 500 Custom: fixed an error due to which, when using weapons with a number of skins, the character's right shoulder was displayed incorrectly when viewed in the third person.
Taurus Judge, MPA 930DMG, S&W M&P R8: fixed an error due to which the weapon was displayed incorrectly in the character's hands in the third person view.
TEC-9 Berserk: fixed an error which caused visual artifacts on the weapon in the third person view.
Howa Type 89 Custom: fixed an error due to which the Rifleman Grip Pod of the golden version of the weapon was displayed differently in the first and the third person views.
AK Alpha "Phobos": fixed an error which caused an incorrect texture display of the weapon in the first person view.
Gingerbread Gun: fixed an error due to which, in the first person view, the character's left hand was displayed incorrectly while shooting.
SAP6, Golden FN SCAR-H, AK-103, PP-19 Bizon, AK-47, Magpul FMG-9: fixed an error due to which, in the first-person view, cartridges in the magazine were displayed incorrectly when reloading some camouflaged weapon versions.
AK-103 "Evil Santa": fixed an error due to which the weapon description did not mention the possibility of installing muzzle attachments.
H&K G36C: fixed an error due to which the scope attachments were displayed incorrectly when viewed in the third person.
Chiappa Triple Threat: fixed an error due to which, in the first person view, the unique flash suppressor on the weapon was displayed incorrectly.
Pistol Scope 2X: fixed an error due to which the attachment had an incorrect description of the multiplying parameter.
Kel-Tec KS7: fixed an error due to which the actual hit point did not match the standard iron sight.
Sidewinder Venom: fixed an error due to which the character's left hand was displayed incorrectly when using the Venom Wraptor grip and the "Ghost Squad" skins.
Howa Type 89 Custom: fixed an error due to which the location of the Vism Flip Dot GSS reflex sight did not match the one shown on the stripe given for kills made with this weapon.
Calico M950: fixed an error due to which the barrel attachments had different positions in the first and the third person views.
Fixed some causes of game client crashes.
Ultra-rare SMG Scope: fixed an error due to which the crosshair did not correspond to the actual hit point.
Golden Chiappa Triple Threat: fixed an error due to which the weapon did not have the cyborg damage buff.
Mischief Army Knife: fixed an error due to which the hit animation in the first person view did not match the actual action.
Multipurpose Vest "Raid", Protective Armored vest "Runner": fixed an error due to which the team emblems on the vest were displayed incorrectly when viewed in the third person.

PvP

"Hawkrock": fixed an exploit in the area with a bomb where the player could kill enemies by shooting through the building at the base of the defending team.
"Bridges":
- fixed an error due to which the player could end up on the roof of a building in front of the Blackwood base without double climb;
- fixed an error due to which objects were displayed differently at low and high graphics settings, which in some cases could give players an unintended advantage.
"Black Mamba": fixed an error due to which the player could go through a closed gate at a certain point on the map.
"Highhill", "Downtown", "Motel": fixed an error due to which objects could disappear in the first person view if the character was at a certain point on the map.
"Factory": fixed an error due to which there was an incorrect double climb point in a certain place on the map.
"Blackwood Base": fixed an error due to which the textures of the ground on the map had an incorrect shade.

PvE
"Blackwood" Operation:
- fixed an error due to which the player could kill the Quant only when he or she ran up to him without sprinting or jumping;
- fixed an error due to which an incorrect icon was displayed in the combat log if a character was killed by the Argus' lasers;
- fixed an error due to which the players were displayed incorrectly on the post-match statistics screen if the team lost.
"Sunrise":
- fixed a bug due to which the animation of killing the Firestarter was displayed incorrectly in the first person view if the action was performed by the SED;
- fixed an error due to which the progress of the achievement "Demon of Steel" was not counted;

"Blackout: fixed an error due to which the player could get stuck in the vehicle when trying to climb on top of the boxes in the back.
"Anubis": fixed an error due to which, at high and medium graphic settings, visual artifacts could appear in a certain place of the level.
Earth Shaker: fixed an error due to which the player could get stuck at some points on the map.
Fixed an error due to which enemy snipers in PvE modes did not use cover and did not attack the player.
Fixed a bug due to which special weapons disappeared in PvE missions while loading the next part of the mission.

General 

Fixed an error due to which, when viewed in the third person, the character's right shoulder was unnaturally deformed when throwing a grenade.
Fixed an error due to which some interface elements of the weapon crafting window for cards had incorrect colors.
Fixed a bug due to which, in the spectator mode, the model of a dead character remained standing if he or she died again immediately after the revival.
Fixed an error due to which, in some cases, scrolling of the main window in the "Cards" section could work incorrectly.
Fixed an error due to which the player could not start a PvE mission if he or she had been kicked from a similar room.
Fixed a bug due to which the achievement "Challenger" had the wrong type and image.
Fixed an error due to which the customization menu markers for most submachine guns were incorrectly positioned.
Fixed an error due to which the achievement "MG240B Elite" was not displayed in the list of achievements. 

KNOWN BUGS

Reloading pump-action shotguns in some cases can lead to an incorrect number of shells in the magazine; in this case, the extra cartridge will not deal damage.

notes.title: Warface Dollars Shop Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/079b2878831401d5c755730fac4ee60485ee3843.jpg

Soldiers!

US-12 and Calico M951S are available in Warface Dollar Random Boxes before approximately 09:00 UTC on Aug 05. Don't miss your chance to get them!

CALICO M951S

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/8e3c7a77f6bec676868ce0cc343f91a3c43f0201.png

Technically a carbine rather than a full-size rifle, Calico M951S  is light and mobile. It possesses the absolute highest rate of fire among all other sniper rifles in the game, while its damage, recoil and mag size make it a superb tool for any sniper.

Apart from the fine combination of qualities above, Calico M951S shows great performance in other fields as well: accuracy is on-point, and so is the effective range. The magazine carries a total of 30 (!) rounds, and you can carry a total of 60 ammo into battle. The reload speed is average, though with the magazine size it barely raises concern – the enemy team’s likely to be dead or desperately ducking for cover by the time you stop firing.

You can outfit the carbine with a variety of muzzle attachments, bipods and scopes to your liking.

US-12

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/c5c91d4bf35fef18fe49fb08594ec4f17a65bf23.png

As a combat shotgun, US-12 is designed to mercilessly dispatch any enemy in the path of its user -- provided that they get close enough. While not as rapid-firing as the Viper, it is far more potent and accurate, and yet retains its speed. Not to mention, it outranges many other shotguns with the effective range of 5.5. On top of these specs, it comes with a 20-round mag and carries 40 total ammo, making it a prime weapon for Medics that like unorthodox, bold strategy.

The legends are waiting for you!

Soldiers!

The new update has already landed on Warface servers. You are in for the "Dark Samurai" Battle Pass, new guns, a system for player identification in a stack, and much more! Hurry up to check out the novelties.

"Dark Samurai" Content

Take on the role of an elite Japanese warrior in the upcoming global operation "Dark Samurai"! By participating in it, you can collect an impressive collection of guns, camos, unique skins and achievements. The daily task variation, expanded statistics, updated interface and much more are waiting for you!

GET ACCESS TO "DARK SAMURAI"

Gilboa Snake DBR

We are glad to present you a new Engineer primary, an Israeli automatic carbine Gilboa Snake DBR. Since it employs duplicating automation nodes, this compact gun sports unsurpassed fire power while its twin barrels provide high rate of fire, and the double magazine allows to fire more shots before having to reload the arm. In game, the Gilboa Snake DBR is similar to the Magpul FMG-9. However, the former compares favorably with its counterpart thanks to a higher damage, increased accuracy and a more spacious magazine. Details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/48edcb735b4cd86d68be4e476a2f9062b6bbe377.jpg

"Samurai" Skins

Strange-looking and richly decorated armour is one of the most recognisable samurai attributes. Its traditional features have been translated into the style of the new camo set "Samurai". Unique class-specific traditional mengu masks deserve a special mentioning. Unlike the armor of European knights, samurai equipment is designed to provide maximum mobility in combat, that's why the "Samurai" skins increase the sprint distance by 50%. Details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/a35a58f7e2dcc73048bf389d23882ab4640d05bc.png

notes.title: TickRate and Synchronization Changes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/579d37e7bd1c23c92555aaff5448c7156b8bd26e.png

Soldiers!
 
We would like to tell you how we are tackling the issues of the shooting delays. Our server experts continue to work hard on them meaning that the situation may change any moment. We will keep you updated and informed about further changes!

DETAILS

After the Crafting Update, the speed of data exchange between the client and the server (TickRate) was increased to 60 Hz, which was aimed at improving the accuracy of character positioning in PvP matches. In most in-game situations it works as intended; however, some users began to experience micro-delays, while performing actions (most often when dealing damage to enemies and throwing grenades).

To study the problem, we have developed and added global and individual monitoring tools into the game. With their help, we have found out that from time to time, in-game session events produce a very short-term, but abnormally high load on the server. At such moments, most often the flow of the game process is normal, but sometimes there appear "lags" that interfere with shooting.

SHORT-TERM BUT ABNORMALLY HIGH SERVER LOAD CAUSES DELAYS IN DAMAGE REGISTRATION

Naturally, before increasing the TickRate, we more than doubled our game server performance margin in advance. However, although the anomalous load is short-term, it consumes significantly more resources than was planned (up to tens of times more). It is difficult to settle the issue since the error is rare, random and so far has no visible logic.

Currently, the priority task for us is to find the reasons for the appearance of "peaks" of abnormal loads in the server code and eliminate them. It is important to conserve the improved synchronization system that prevents such occurances as teleports and the F12 problem, correcting only those issues that do not allow its advantages to be fully revealed.

WE'LL ADDRESS THE PROBLEMS IN THE NEW SYNCHRONIZATION SYSTEM WITH 60 HZ TICKRATE

To make the gameplay comfortable for you, we have temporarily lowered the TickRate value to 30 Hz (as it was before the Crafting Update installation) during the maintenance on the 1st of July. As soon as the problem with the "60 Hz" mode is fixed, we will carry out the necessary tests and will inform you about the return of the increased TickRate.
 
Stay tuned and good luck in combat!

notes.title: Crafting Update - Now in game
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/572a432cbaa7bd137e7935ad644fbffeab49ef48.jpg

Soldiers!

The major Crafting Update has landed on Warface servers bringing technical improvements of the movement and synchronization system, in-game crafting, new weapons and skins, and much more! Give them a try and share your impressions.

TICKRATE IMPROVEMENTS

The speed of information exchange between the game client and the server (TickRate) in PvP matches has been significantly increased - up to 60 transmissions per second.

This is an important change that will improve the accuracy of character positioning in battle. After updating the motion registration system transition to a higher tickrate is a logical step that will increase users' comfort in the game and complete a long period of work aimed at improving the movement system.

NEW CONTENT

CRAFTING SYSTEM

Crafting is a new reward system based on the simple principle of card exchange. While participating in various game activities, the player will receive cards and, upon collecting the necessary set, exchange them for cool weapons.
 
Now the crafting system features several previously announced weapon models; they are the assault rifle Cobalt Kinetics EDGE Rifle, the submachine gun Cobalt Kinetics Stealth Pistol, the sniper rifle Cobalt Kinetics Twenty-Seven and the shotgun Typhoon F12 Custom. In the future, the list will be expanded with other interesting weapon models and gear.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/f8d3f2a9fb948b8239983a7a9fc57bcdeb8222a9.png

If you want to learn more about the new system, have a look at F.A.Q. on the topic.

Boxes with cards for weapon crafting can be obtained as log-in rewards, and by advancing between leagues in the new season of Ranked Matches. Free cards will be available in the game store.

Moreover, you can get a nice headstart by clicking the link below to receive the following:

 5 Cobalt Kinetics EDGE Rifle Cards;
 5 Cobalt Kinetics Stealth Pistol Cards;
 5 Cobalt Kinetics Twenty-Seven Cards;
 5 Typhoon F12 Custom Cards.

Get free cards
KEL-TEC SUB2000

We are glad to present you a new secondary weapon which stands out among its peers thanks to its elegant looks and impressive specs. Thanks to an almost complete absence of spread, the Kel-Tec SUB2000 allows its owner to make accurate and deadly shots. The gun's advantages are offset by moderate rate of fire and semi-automatic shooting mode. The Kel-Tec SUB2000 is meant to become one of the most accurate secondary weapons, just like Taurus Judge invariably remains the benchmark for melee revolvers/pistols.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/4666e523cf47672337fb08a82053335b60f8ed33.jpg

notes.title: Server tickrate change after the update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/5a497ed9b386a6288c700841662fb9ba2fa1951d.png

With the next update, we plan to make changes to an important game server indicator - tickrate. It will be increased to 60. What is it and why will it be done? Let's break it down.

WHAT IS TICKRATE?
Tickrate is a measurement unit of the speed of data interchange (sending and receiving) between the server and the game client. It is measured by the number of transmissions per second.

Why is it important? An online game is based on the fact that the game client constantly interchanges data with the server. This frequency is defined as tickrate. Every cycle, the server and the client are synchronized, the position of objects and players on the map, the hit data and other information bits get updated. Therefore, the more often this exchange occurs, the more accurately the player's actions and those of others are reflected for each user. Naturally, it is especially important in a shooter.

THE TICKRATE INCREASE WILL NOT AFFECT THE GAME IF YOU HAVE HIGH PING. TO USE HIGH TICKRATE TO THE FULL, YOUR INTERNET CONNECTION SHOULD BE FAST AND STABLE

This is due to the fact that the Internet channel is responsible for the transfer of data packages. Even if the server is ready to send and receive packages very quickly, and your connection is not stable or is slow, you will not see any improvements in the game.

WHY NOW?
It should be understood that this change is made to the software of the server, it is not abstract "more powerful hardware". This update was made possible thanks to a series of preliminary changes and improvements that were systematically made to the game: no more support of Windows XP, switching to a 64-bit system and others. 

HIGHER TICKRATE RESULTS IN A HIGHER SERVER AND GAME CLIENT LOAD, BUT OUR SERVER IS READY 

After updating the movement synchronization system, transition to a higher tickrate is a logical step that will increase users' comfort in the game and complete a long period of work aimed at improving the movement system.

We will follow the situation and study the game statistics at the tickrate of 60 for some time. After that we will be able to consider the possibility of further raising the value.

Have a nice game!

notes.title: March Update - Now in game
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/4b297d61b36ecf019944b0c385afadded08f5bf2.png

Soldiers!
 
The March update has already landed on Warface servers. It features a reworked damage indicator and remastered "Blackgold" map, SED weapons and gear, April Fool's Day content and much more! Time to try out the novelties!

NEW CONTENT

NEW SED ITEMS

We are glad to present new equipment and weapon for the SED, which will allow you to diversify the class combat strategy and its habitual gameplay.
 
The new “Mercury” gear set will give fresh gaming experience to those who were not "hooked" by the original SED. The modules increase the robot’s speed of movement and reduce its armor. Thus, the SED will be able to assume the role of a more mobile but less enduring fighter. At the same time, the previous armor sets will remain unchanged.

"Mercury" head module

 Detects enemy's claymores


"Mercury" body module

 Armor points: 330.
 Decreases damage by 15 points per hit.
 Increases protection against explosives by 32%.


"Mercury" hands module

 Increases arm protection by 20%.
 Increases weapon select and deselect speed by 20%.


"Mercury" legs module

 Delay claymore activation by 3 sec.
 Increases leg protection by 20%.
 Increases sprint distance by 400%.
 Decreases slide distance by 40%.
 Decreases sprint speed by 15%.
 Decreases strafe speed by 45%.


"Mercury" SED Set

 Additional bonus to slide distance: 20%.
 Additional bonus to sprint speed: 10%.
 Additional bonus to strafe speed: 7%.
 Additional bonus to crouch speed: 10%.
 Decreases the sound of movement.


Apart from the equipment, the SED will also acquire a new weapon M134-GAU19b Hybrid. It stands out among other SED weapons thanks to an incredibly high rate of fire. In addition, the new weapon overheats and cools faster meaning that the arm is more suitable for shooting in deadly short bursts rather than for continuous fire.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/7022e6676c48913485f7d5b6685a8cdc18c8ac2d.png

REMASTERED "BLACKGOLD" MAP

Much time had passed since the location creation, so it required being brought to modern standards. While reworking the map, the developers paid attention not only to its appearance but to the gameplay as well. "Blackgold" is now more balanced and dynamic. Moreover, some "problem areas" have been eradicated, for example, unintended vulnerable spots.

www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q7QnGcM_74s

The map became more “living” after lighting adjustment and replacement of objects and textures with more detailed and modern ones. At the same time, now players are more visible against the background. The location is now even more atmospheric thanks to new animations, and special visual and sound effects that guarantee a complete immersion into the gameplay!
 
Despite all the changes, the map has retained its familiar appearance and will certainly be of interest to both project veterans and beginners.

GORGON WEAPON SERIES

Some battles are really tough to win. To get through them with flying colours you will need the skill, a reliable team and, of course, excellent guns. "Gorgon" is a new weapon series and camos that will appear in one of our future Battle Passes. The new weapons look amazing! Bright flames, frame parts as if oozing poison, green snakes and an image of a real Gorgon will remind your enemies of the well-known myths... and the long-forgotten fear...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/a5fc889d486d6602b4c18d0fb2c95269367ce8f9.png

Kills made with the weapon series "Gorgon" will reward you with unique distinctions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/9d86010141d82f8bd97636c6dd823113a95ded08.png

PARTICLE WEAPON SERIES
This series has a minimalistic design featuring a combination of simple camouflage motifs and small bright elements. The guns seem to be covered with inconspicuous snake scales, which makes them a desirable acquisition for those collectors who prefer  simple elegance. All weapon specs are completely identical to those of the usual versions, so you will feel comfortable in any combat situation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/a7d5cce798b543f729a42c62f4a652790d539869.png

By eliminating the opposition with the "Particle" weapon series, you can get a unique badge, mark and stripe. And if you want to acquire even more spoils of war, earn expert stripes for any model!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/c70bafbd3be763924ddecc62a68b7292fff74e71.png

JAWS WEAPON SERIES
The looks of this series fill the soul with murderous cold and send shivers down the spine. The camos are designed in calm cold blue tones. The color pattern resembles horror films about mysterious amd horrible inhabitants of the deep sea, which are incredibly quick dealing with their prey when they feel the scent of blood. Let your "Jaws" guns become as deadly for your enemies!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/1a3a9d978c8a782b42b0206d9b245b63539cfc6e.png

UNDERTAKER WEAPON SERIES
"Undertaker" is a daring skin series for five cool arms. Gloomy symbols and chilling patterns are its distinctive features. These guns will surely fit a brutal fighter who is confident in his skill and superiority on the battlefield.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/e56043ca55b07080d8690cad117b6b1ef3128ed3.png

"BEDLAM"
A themed location is the best place to test the April Fool’s Day items. The map "Bedlam" for the Team Deathmatch mode will make a perfect scene for full-fledged joke fights.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/16cfce5a2b544cd34f462255fb34a6d7bfce4920.jpg

Have you already guessed which map has changed beyond all recognition? In the framework of the festivities the familiar "Oil Depot" will turn into a circus troupe camp. Be on the alert and keep your eyes open. Do not turn around when you hear jaws snapping: a deep sea predator is watching you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/c8873e94f22e11130b942f5598d6bb26b358c075.png

Do not forget about your main task: be a team player and eliminate as many opponents as possible. Cool guns and our latest development: "Hype Zone" Spray will help you to successfully complete the mission.

"HYPE ZONE" SPRAY
The cutting edge arm "Hype Zone" Spray will become quite an impressive weapon in your fight against the enemy. It will not only wipe anyone who will dare stand in your way from the face of existence, but will also significantly tarnish the reputation of the defeated opponents. Join the fun and enjoy yourselves!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/797f28257bb5f4fa81ef940238efaa91250ae961.jpg

Kills made with the secondary weapon  "Hype Zone" Spray will yield memorable distinctions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/fa95769a1a13bbde94cfaa2849fe02ab6d3f32b8.png

"JESTER" SERIES
This juicy series only seems harmless. Its bright appearance conceals the real power! The model frames carry graffiti featuring in the center an image of a clown who is about to make a dangerous joke. Apart from the weapon series, there are camos designed in the same style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/523a48b2ff07c22879c278daee8b1641e7ee4ea2.png

"Jester" guns will be the best pick for immersing into the festive atmosphere of jokes and infinite fun. Do not forget about the achievements! By killing opponents with the themed weapons you will receive a unique distinction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/7823c12dddbcd68463fd8b4b125993baa7b1b64b.png

CONTENT CHANGES

REWORKED DAMAGE INDICATOR

The damage indicator ("cross") is one of the oldest interface elements. It is extremely important for every fighter at every game stage. At the same time, the previous version of the “cross” often confused users and did not communicate the expected information during the gaming process. We decided to fix it by reworking its mechanics and making them more intuitive.

First, let's look at the mechanics of the old indicator version.

 It displayed only the damage done to the enemy's health and neglected the damage dealt to the armor;
 Each hit had its own damage indicator which depended on certain factors (the state of armor when the shot was performed, defense modifier, the impacted part of the body), but did not depend on the enemy's health and previous hits.
 The size of the displayed "cross" directly depended on the damage dealt to the enemy's health.

This fact gave rise to such questions as “Why does the indicator never change its size?”, “Why does the same weapon cause different damage in different combat situations?”, and others. As a result, we decided to make the damage indicator more understandable and logical.

New mechanics are much simpler and clearer.

 Now the ''cross'' sports both indicators: damage dealt to the enemy's health as well as to the armor.
 The size of the indicator now depends on the current state of the enemy in a gun battle.
 The more you hit the enemy, the more damage you deal him; therefore, the size of the displayed “cross” grows. In other words, the weaker the enemy is, the larger the indicator will become with every hit.
 The full damage indicator means the death of the enemy.

Thus, the new system provides more understandable data about your shooting efficiency, the state of the enemy and your chances of winning the battle.

ACHIEVEMENTS FOR A SET OF PVP MAPS

The game now features 24 new achievements at once! You can get them in PvP battles on 4 classic maps - 6 achievements for each map: 3 marks (win 10/25/50 matches) and 3 badges (take the 1st place 25/50/100 times).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/d0df17703367ee3fcecf9d6a6864086817b6de43.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/8ed559fb60d3fbd4da856641ac692fb79bc01988.png

WEAPON TWEAKS

Such weapons as АК-103, Galil AR, RPK, PP-19 Bizon, Beretta MX4 Storm and Calico M950 will be tweaked.

АК-103
Softer and more manageable recoil.

Galil AR
Softer and more manageable recoil.

RPK
Reduced maximum spread.

PP-19 Bizon
Reduced spread.
Increased leg damage multiplier.

Beretta MX4 Storm
Increased leg damage multiplier.
Increased rate of fire (from 810 to 820).
More manageable recoil.
Reduced spread.
Increased accuracy in the aiming mode.

Calico M950
Reduced spread.
Softer recoil during short bursts.

OTHER CHANGES

IMPORTANT

 Now, in case of a long search for a room, the game will offer to switch to a neighboring regional server to speed up the process. The search for a match in regions other than the one selected in the game client at the start of the game will not begin without your consent.
 Increased the download speed of the game client.
 After the next game update the meta-achievements "King of PvP", "King of PvE" and Emperor "Warface" will become available.
 The SpecOp "Cyber Horde" is now available and will be live till the next update.
 Special Operation access tokens have been disabled and will remain so till the next update.

GENERAL

 For future equipment developments, added the ability to resist damage dealt by a certain weapon type. At the moment, no items have this characteristic.
 Improved the in-game ban timer for more accurate calculation of the ban expiration time.
 Improved the nickname verification logic at the stage of name creation. Now, if the nickname is occupied or does not meet the requirements, the "Create" button will be inactive, and a notification giving the reason for it will be displayed above.
 The friend list capacity has been increased (from 100 to up to 120 people).

WEAPONS AND GEAR

 Remington Model 870 "U.S.", M4A1 "U.S.": updated the durability and repair cost values.
 Barrett M98B: now the weapon takes up less space on the screen when viewed in the first person view.
 The visual style of Blackwood skins has been slightly changed. Now it will be easier to distinguish between fighters of different teams. Further changes are planned.

PVP

 "Bag and Tag": improved display of defeated opponents' dog tags at a distance.
 Added the current match status verification for an in-game pause in Ranked Matches. Now, if after the pause the match should end automatically, it will not be activated.

PVE

 Hydra: the conditions for obtaining the achievement "Safe and sound" have changed. Now you need to complete the Special Operation 10 times.

BUG FIXES

IMPORTANT

 Fixed some causes for game client crashes.
 Improved motion synchronization system.
 Fixed an error due to which in some cases the kill/death counter was reset when reconnecting to the match after connection loss.
 Fixed an error due to which, in some cases, the sound of steps was not correctly reproduced in the spectator mode.
 Fixed a bug due to which at the beginning of a PvP match the player was stuck in one place and could not move for several seconds.

GENERAL

 Safe House: fixed a bug due to which the player could start a training session with moving targets without an instructor.

 Fixed a bug due to which in some cases kills did not count until the class change.
 Fixed a bug due to which in some cases access tokens for Special Operations could not be spent.
 Fixed a bug due to which some visual effects were not reproduced when shooting in the Safe House.

WEAPONS AND GEAR

 VHS-2: fixed a bug due to which the characteristics of the "Underbarrel grenade launcher" for some weapon series did not match the regular version specs.
 Cobalt Kinetics Twenty-Seven: fixed a visual error due to which the weapon model with the UTG Compact Sight was not displayed correctly in the third person view.

PVP

PVE

Hydra:

 Fixed a bug due to which machine-gun shells of the Mech were too large.

Good luck in combat!
