notes.title: February Update - now in game!
notes.notes:
Soldiers!
 
The February update has already landed on Warface servers. You will find:

 assault rifle CZ 805 BREN A2;
 sniper rifle Cobalt Kinetics Twenty-Seven;
 submachine gun Golden Kriss Super V Custom;
 shotgun Kel-Tec KS7

And not only guns, but much more!

NEW CONTENT

CZ 805 BREN A2

CZ 805 BREN A2 is an assault rifle boasting impressive damage, excellent range and soft recoil. Thanks to the weapon's well-balanced specs, enemy destruction at any distance is like shooting fish in a barrel. The new gun's main in-game rivals will be F90 MBR and AK-12. However, higher rate of fire and greater damage make the Czech model stand out favourably.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/bf63b1ed211ea71c2a839937b916d4b2ab30ae02.jpg

By killing 999 enemies with the golden version of the gun, you will be able to get a unique stripe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/aff82a71d5e45e698b4dceafdfec7f209040d0b8.png

COBALT KINETICS TWENTY-SEVEN

Cobalt Kinetics Twenty-Seven is a Sniper rifle offering fast zoom and an extremely competitive hip accuracy among other semi-automatic rifles. Moreover, the weapon comes equipped with a set of 6 tactical accessories, which help to achieve excellent results at any distance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/a84849e1bbcfca0731ddfeec50a26ab3f061eccc.jpg

Among other things, Cobalt Kinetics Twenty-Seven is the first Sniper rifle on which you can mount a collimator sight as a separate attachment rather than an additional one. It will improve visibility by reducing the overall silhouette of the weapon and provide convenient aiming due to the thin frame!

GOLD KRISS SUPER V CUSTOM

Kriss Super V Custom is a popular Engineer primary boasting cool futuristic looks. The golden version will preserve the advantages of the regular Kriss Super V Custom and will boast a larger 36-round magazine and increased ammo (216 rounds).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/067de1b3a840ab1aedd7d2f4f051c30a0cfb13b0.jpg

By killing 999 enemies with the arm’s golden version, you will be able to become a proud bearer of a custom stripe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/dfa7910e8f51bb44b3bad8e29a76eb2d8152622c.png

KEL-TEC KS7

Taking into account the devastating damage, excellent range, good accuracy and decent rate of fire, there is every reason to believe that the Kel-Tec KS7 is a very impressive gun and can easily compete with the popular MAG-7 for the title of the best pump-action shotgun in the game. The former compares favourably with the latter thanks to its load-one-round-and-resume-fire system which the MAG-7 lacks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/7a6b8b9237d0b5e4f997e2e24e205c7357fdb748.jpg

By killing enemies with this weapon you will be able to get memorable distinctions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/a86526abd26a5923564e14dc6e20201d1997cbc1.png

CONTENT CHANGES

WEAPONS

All the versions of the weapons will be subject to changes, unless stated otherwise. Have a look at the table below to discover what combat stats will be revamped.

Benelli M4 Super 90
Increased magazine capacity (from 6 to 8).
Increased ammo (from 42 to 56).
Softer and more manageable recoil.

VEPR 
Reduced maximum spread.
More manageable recoil.

SRM 1216 
Increased range (from 5.2 to 5.5).
Softer and lower recoil.
Increased accuracy in the aiming mode while jumping.
Increased the rate of fire of a burst.

AUG A3 
Removed the attachment "Rifleman Bayonet".

Saiga H.G.C. Custom
Improved weapon reload animation, now the camera does not shake.
 
GOLDEN SMOKE GRENADE
After the visual update of smoke screens, the golden version of the grenade lost its distinctive features and the unique effect. It has been upgraded: the animation of grenade explosion has been reworked; moreover, now there will be sparkling particles in the smoke cloud.

www.youtube.com/watch?v=ahY9RVWiIQM

ACHIEVEMENTS
Now the distinctions achieved by killing enemies with "Idol" weapons can be received by using the series guns that previously did not count for achievement unlocking, they are: FN FAL DSA-58, Winchester 1887, Desert Tech MDR‐C, AMP DSR‐1, S&W M&P R8 and the M48 Bowie Knife.

OTHER CHANGES

IMPORTANT

 Better and quicker analysis of abnormal behaviour improves the overall anticheat mechanics
 Autobalance algorythms in "Quick Play" have been reworked. Now teams will be composed more evenly thanks to a better matching of separate players and groups basing on their combat effectiveness.

WEAPONS AND GEAR

 The specs of some grips (SMG Grip, Rifleman Grip, Shared Grip) have been reworked.
 Cobalt Kinetics Stealth Pistol: reduced rate of fire (from 730 to 720), increased damage drop at distance, reduced leg damage multiplier.
 Advanced Rifleman Scope: smaller aiming dot.
 VHS-2 Grenade Launcher: slightly reduced recoil, increased blast radius.
 M48 Bowie knife: reworked animation of the equipped item in the sprint mode.
 Improved Absolute vest: - 20% damage from explosives.
 The attachment "Iron Sight" has been reworked for all the versions of HArms CQR and CZ 805 BREN A2: now it has 1,1X zoom.
 Stoner LMG A1: The Iron Sight module now has a 1.1x zoom (up from 1.5)
 The following "Idol" weapons now count towards the achievement progress: FN FAL DSA-58, Winchester 1887, Desert Tech MDR ‐ C, AMP DSR ‐ 1, S&W M&P R8 and M48 Bowie Knife.
 Morion Smoke Grenade: The smoke effect is optimized to increase performance.
 PVE
 Hydra: the possibility of collecting resource crates during one wave has been limited.
 Hydra: the cut-off values of time and total score for goal achievement and Crown acquisition have been modified.
 Hydra: The minimum time threshold for receiving crowns has been increased from 22 to 27 minutes.

OTHER

 The spectator mode camera now works better after a player dies and switches to it.
 Optimized algorithms of account data storing and processing.
 Optimized resource consumption by models of some weapons in the first-person view.
 Added special achievements to mark Valentine's Day.
 Added a new smoke grenade "Tornado" and its unique achievements.
 The Christmas content (the Safe House music theme, festive Shop and Inventory decorations, themed maps, special items and log-in streak rewards) has been replaced with the standard one.
 The location of hip and aiming mode accuracy parameters in the game interface has changed. Now the comparison of different weapon models when choosing a SED is more correct.
 Improved the work of the monitoring camera. Now the animation of moving objects in PvE will be identically displayed for all players even if some of them joined after the mission had started.
 Improved the logics of illumination selection on maps while changing graphics settings in game.
 The size of the league icon in the player’s personal profile has been reduced.
 "Money accumulated" and "Crowns accumulated" lines have been removed from the personal statistics of the players.

BUG FIXES

IMPORTANT

 Fixed some reasons for a spontaneous game client shut down;
 Fixed a performance issue due to incorrect CPU load distribution;
 Fixed an error due to which after the pause the sound was looped and had an increased volume.

WEAPONS AND GEAR

 Typhoon F12 Custom: fixed an error that caused an incorrect trigger display;
 Typhoon F12 Custom: fixed an error due to which the character's hand crossed the textures of the drum magazine in the third person view.
 Gingerbread Gun: fixed a visual error due to which the character's hands crossed the textures of the weapon during reload in the third person view.
 KAC Chainsaw: fixed a visual error due to which the shadow while using the weapon did not coincide with the model animation.
 "Tigerstripe" Skins: fixed an error due to which an incorrect text was displayed in the item description in the player’s Inventory.
 Ultra-rare SMG Scope: fixed an error due to which the attachment was not available for "Tigerstripe" SMGs.
 Tavor TS12 Custom, Golden Tavor TS12 Custom: fixed an error which in some cases caused an incorrect shooting animation.
 Fixed an error which caused an incorrect attachment selection animation.
 MPA 930DMG, MPA 930DMG "Absolute": fixed an error which caused an incorrect item animation when interacting with objects (for example, when a player collided with an obstacle).
 Steyr M9A1 "Winter Camo": fixed the error which caused an incorrect display of the "Shared Silencer" in the first person view.
 Calico M955A, Calico M955A "Winter Camo": fixed a visual artefact which appeared upon activation of a sight.
 Honey Badger: fixed the error which caused an incorrect display of the extractor during the reload animation in the first person view.
 Dragunov SR, Winchester 1887, Dragunov SVU-AS, Golden Dragunov SVU-AS: fixed the error which caused an incorrect display of the weapon model in the character’s hands with equipped female skins in the third person view.
 Remington Model 870: fixed the error which caused an incorrect display of the weapon model in the character’s hands in the third person view.
 USAS-12 "Korea Anniversary", CheyTac M200 "Jade Dragon", CheyTac M200 "Scarlet Dragon", AS50 "Yellow Emperor", Beretta MX4 Storm "Flor de Muerto": now the repair cost is correct.
 SIG 550, Alpine: fixed the error which caused an incorrect display of the weapon model in the character’s hands in the third person view.
 TEC-9: fixed the  animation when the character’s hand crossed the pistol model while changing the primary weapon to a secondary one.
 Hawk Pump: correction de l'erreur qui provoquait le tremblement de la camèra lors du rechargement.
 AUG A3, M16A3 Custom: fixed the error which caused an incorrect position of the character’s hands on the trigger of the underbarrel grenade launcher in the third person view.

notes.title: Blackwood Battle Pass Changes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/dfb52402ef9ecd38277cf09e416ab912285ccd62.jpg

Soldiers!

The new week of quests is already available in "Blackwood" Battle Pass. Since the release of the event we have analysed it and decided to improve certain aspects. We hope you will appreciate the tweaks to gear crafting, specializations and personal crates.

BLACKWOOD BATTLE PASS IMPROVEMENTS
Now once you unlock "Smooth Operator" skill in the "Tech" specialization, you will need from 30 to 300 resources to craft permanent items (used to be from 45 to 450).
A smaller increase in energy consumption for the specialization "Marauder" once you unlock "Forager" skill. Now you will need 30 energy points for a simple operation (used to be 40), and 45 energy points for a difficult operation (used to be 50).
Once you unlock "Second Breath" skill in the "Fighter" specialization, you will gain 30 energy points (used to be 10) for the "Operations" tab as an extra reward for daily quests.
We hope that after the modifications the Battle Pass will be even more enjoyable and fun.

VALUABLE REWARDS ARE WAITING

Take active part in the Battle Pass: do tasks, level up and get well-deserved rewards! Learn more about each section from the dedicated articles:

Class selection and skills
Weekly and daily missions
Crafting
Personal progress and crates

 the "Hydra" Operation and the namesake weapon series;
 the weapons АМ-17 and Typhoon F12 Custom;
 festive "Rime" series;
 themed winter locations: Safe House, Inventory, shop and "Krampus Town" map;
 Blackwood skins.
 And much more! Be first to check out the news!


NEW CONTENT

OPERATION "HYDRA"

The new Special Operation "Hydra" is already available. While creating "Hydra", the developers team decided to get back to the basics, making the gameplay intuitive and more "meaty" unlike that of the latest Special Operations such as "Pripyat", "Sunrise" and "Mars" that featured a large number of complex mechanics and a well-developed plot.

www.youtube.com/watch?v=LjyxlvALPt8

In "Hydra" players will have to defend a special terminal located in the center of the map, with each enemy wave being more dangerous than the previous one. In total there are 20 waves. During the last one players will become engaged in the final stand-off with a powerful boss.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/3d4deec27c7890c353f8f11632110fba77003fac.jpg

Upon completing the Special Operation, you can get 15 new achievements, one of which is a secret. To collect all the badges, marks and stripes, you will have not only to defeat the enemies but also demonstrate an excellent teamwork.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/afab82ad3746e27fdd1f84abd14d9ab04cacf0bb.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/d75a3a56ea92d0d64c028e45228d25e155ccbe89.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/7bdc29746677c2be18a12b3f2e7a4a6ed33899c8.png

Starting from the 10th wave completed, you will be able to get rewards including temporary and permanent "Hydra" weapons. The series includes popular models for Riflemen, Medics, Engineers and Snipers and their corresponding camos. Typhoon F12 Custom which previously was not featured in the game is Hydra's particular feature.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/24e39471a784aeb5937b3856502fcaf276f7063f.png

Of course, 10 000 kills made with "Hydra" weapons will bring you a unique stripe "Hydriform"!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/6ad3bad848e3bc1b1a1220806bbdc51dbe72b5ec.png

АМ-17

We are glad to present you a compact submachine gun that was developed by the Kalashnikov Group on the basis of a frame elaborated by the legendary gunmaker Evgueni Dragunov. In Warface the arm boasts excellent combat specs such as a high accuracy in the aiming mode, good range and hip accuracy. The gun’s mind-blowing damage will turn AM-17 into your rivals’ nightmare since even the most modern helmet will not save the enemy from sure death at close range!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/278e91b3a17a0d9b81eb93b6d9b147830c5d3697.jpg

The owners of the golden verison will be able to get a unique stripe for dealing 999 killing blows.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/552c1d0ad11bc17c699de18b0a9bf0bea8e8de6f.png

TYPHOON F12 CUSTOM

An upgraded Typhoon F12 version is yet another curious innovation. Typhoon F12 Custom offers all the advantages of the predecessor while featuring some improved specs such as a high capacity 15-round drum mag and a slightly increased precision in the aiming mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/858e8c31166da4d60f4a5c24e7f91d176a3d15f8.jpg

We will tell you later about the ways of acquiring this gun.

"RIME" WEAPON SERIES

Missing a bright frost series? “Rime” it on! The graceful pattern is flowing along the weapon shell, as if winter winds have left their stamp on the cold steel. These colourfully designed weapons can make your enemies feel hot on the battlefield and will show some magic even to the battle-harded veterans!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/bcf19f5da7d1b3c928774ba79a2d7cbd4d553b53.jpg

By eliminating enemies with “Rime” weapons you an obtain unique stripes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/8ab49ae4c1b4104a8f5c170d63fdc3e298a5763d.png

KRAMPUS MAP

We are glad to present you a themed map designed especially for winter holidays. You are well familiar with the battlefield! This is one of the districts in the abandoned city of Pripyat which has prepared for a harsh winter in its own peculiar manner.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/d15de08ed0db361d99f14e4d6839bef8d0999b67.jpg

Your task is quite simple: intercept an enemy unit and destroy as many foes as possible. Before going on the mission carefully study the field pictures, they will help you quickly navigate in the snowy terrain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/a766541ac9921b22349224d6848d03a7356e92ca.jpg

EXTENDED "ONYX" SERIES

The line-up now includes Typhoon F12 and Kriss Super V Custom. Unique attachments are skinned as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/0d4e4431831feef12a6a95879e72238571e0f655.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/56fee89b47140a9cf362c3cf68fd1e5cb154507a.png

We will tell you later about the ways of acquiring these weapons.

BLACKWOOD SKINS

We have added Blackwood skins for the Rifleman, Medic, Engineer and Sniper, as well as a set containing all of them. Hurry to get them now in the new Battle Pass!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/d2ff1f08bc32da58dddc307a1d0ef9d3ffc76713.jpg

CONTENT CHANGES

WINTER SAFE HOUSE

With a wave of a magic wand the safehouse has transformed: colourful fairy lights, snowmen, synthehic snow piles and some pine trees, which were chosen by General Lee Warton. Moreover, a Christmas tree is already waiting for soldiers in the background of the inventory and the in-game shop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/c33e1b625960512b0a14fc35e38ece6050d40fc5.jpg

WEAPON RARITY

The update has introduced the concept of "weapon rarity." Now every model has its own quality which depends on the uniqueness of the arm and is displayed in the player’s inventory in the item description and weapon icon colour grades. In addition, the localization of progression weapon categories has been updated.

Weapon rarity

 Common
 Uncommon
 Rare
 Epic
 Legendary


Progression weapons categories

 Beginner level
 Medium level
 Advanced level
 Professional level

THE RANKED MATCHES MATCHMAKING ALGORITHMS

The Ranked Matches matchmaking algorithms have been optimized. Now matchmaking even more carefully distributes allies and opponents basing on their combat effectiveness in order to achieve maximum team balance.

ADDITIONAL CHANGES

IMPORTANT

 Added themed winter content: Christmas maps and new log-in reward streaks are now available; the Safe House music theme has been updated.

WEAPONS AND GEAR

 SED's machine guns are now less noisy while shooting.
 The visuals of the grips-attachments have been reworked. The changes apply to their skinned versions as well.

OTHER

 The reward in Random Boxes with "Spectre" gear has been changed. Now it is possible to get permanent "Spectre" (Beta) items.
 Added water animation at low graphics settings; at the same time, the game client performance remains the same.
 Reworked loading screen: the image has changed, the Blackwood Games logo has been added and the Crytek logo has been modified.
 Timing configurations when sending messages to in-game chats have been tweaked. This measure will help to reduce spam and fishing instances.

BUG FIXES

IMPORTANT

 Fixed the bugs due to which in some cases the game client shut down.
 HArms CQR "Great Gatsby": fixed the error due to which the weapons had a higher recoil than their regular peers.
 Fixed and visually corrected the animation when a slide is abruptly interrupted by a jump.
 Fixed the error due to which there were no special effects after a character revival.
 Sometimes weapon management noises (reloading, shooting etc.) were not present.

WEAPONS AND GEAR

 CZ Scorpion Evo3 A1 "Icebreaker": fixed the error which caused incorrect recicle colour with installed "Ultra-rare SMG Scope".
 Marlin 1894 Custom "Great Gatsby": fixed the error due to which kills made with this model did not count for "Great Gatsby" achievements progress.
 SV-98 "Morion": fixed the error due to which the "Fast Mid-Range Scope 5x" icon was not skinned in the attachment menu.
 Maxim 9 "Onyx": fixed the visual error which caused incorrect camo display of the model upon uninstalling the "Trijicon RMR Adjustable LED".
 Anakon, Arcus Tactics: fixed the visual error which caused incorrect display of the weapon model in the soldier's hands in the Inventory.
 Dragunov SR: fixed a visual error which caused an incorrect weapon model display in third person view with a vest applied.
 M40A5: fixed a visual error which caused an incorrect weapon model display in the character's hands in third person view when female skins were equipped.
 Tavor TAR-12: fixed a visual error which caused an incorrect reload animation.
 XM556 Microgun: fixed an error which made it possible to compare the specs of the primary weapon with those of the secondary CZ 805 G1 in the shop and Inventory.
 Steyr M9-A1: fixed the error which caused lots of visual artefacts upon equipping the pistol. 
 "Absolute" Smoke Grenade: fixed the error which produced model textures that did not correspond to the selected grenade after it was equipped.
 Steyr Scout: fixed the error which caused different cartridge casing looks in first and third person view.
 Thompson M1928 "Morion": fixed the error which caused incorrect weapon display in the character's hands in third person view.
 Fixed the error which could cause incorrect attachment textures with the equipped "Rifleman Grip" and "Rifleman Grip Pod".
 Gepard GM6 Lynx: fixed the error which caused incorrect weapon display in the character's hands with equipped female skins.
 Blackwood gear: fixed several visual artefacts that appeared upon equipping various set items or upon combining them with other equipment (in first or third person view).

PVP

 Yard: fixed the error due to which a bomb could be planted on a container (and was impossible to defuse) on a certain spot of the map.
 Yard: fixed an unintended vulnerable spot.
 Xmas Icebound, "Factory": fixed the error due to which the player could get stuck in a certain point of the map.
 Factory: fixed the error due to which the team could not defuse the bomb planted in a certain point of the map.
 Factory: fixed the error due to which the player was teleported to the previous spot when he tried to climb the container.
 Factory: fixed the error which made it possible to climb boxes on a certain spot of the map.
 Factory: fixed unintended vulnerable spots in certain points of the map.
 Airbase: fixed the error due to which one of the objects on the map lacked the collision model.
 Invasion: fixed a visual error due to which the cover on a certain spot of the map disappeared and the player behind became visible to the opponents.
 Sirius: fixed the error due to which the player could die on a certain spot of the map after jumping many times.
 Forest: fixed a visual error which caused incorrect textures display on a certain spot of the map.
 District: fixed a visual error due to which object textures disappeared on certain spots of the map.
 Palace: fixed the error due to which a bomb could be incorrectly planted on a car wheel.
 Palace: fixed the error due to which some surrounding objects lacked the collision model.
 Bridges: fixed the error due to which the player could perform a slide in the lying position and fall under the map textures.
 Hawkrock: fixed the error due to which the player took damage from the gate explosion when he was standing near other gates.
 Palace: fixed an unintended vulnerable spot.
 Fixed the error due to which players' combat stats screen opened when the players put the match on pause.
 Fixed the error due to which the spectator mode camera could take an incorrect position at the beginning of the round.

PVE

 Mars (Act 1): fixed the error due to which in some cases the health indicator of the Heavy Droid disappeared.
 Mars (Act 4): fixed a visual error which caused incorrect display of certain elements of the "Terraformer-1" construction.
 Anubis: fixed the error due to which the player could fall through the map textures in a certain point of the map.
 The HQ: fixed a localization error due to which an incorrect SpecOp name was displayed on the screen upon receiving a box with a reward for mission completion.
 Training: fixed the error due to which the player could walk through textures in a certain point of the map.
 OTHER
 Fixed the tip text position on the match loading screen.
 Fixed the error due to which the SED model was incorrectly displayed in the Inventory if the player left the Safe House while sliding.
 Fixed the error which caused incorrect climb assisting or obstacles overcoming if they were activated by the mouse wheel.

KNOWN ISSUES

 The grip icons in the attachment window can be different from their reworked versions.
 When the game is resumed after the pause in PvP modes, the timer is displayed upon opening the score window.
 The majority of weapons have incorrect rarity.

Good luck in combat!

notes.title: December Update #1 - now in game!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/656a66b42f957effca45732467f20473979609c8.jpg

Soldiers!

The December update #1 has been installed. Reworked netcode, the next Battle Pass contents featuring the series "Obsidian ", "Morion" and "Onyx", golden versions of popular guns, the reworked safe house and much more are awaiting you. Hurry up to check out the changes!

NEW CONTENT

NEW NETCODE SYSTEM IS BACK

We have reworked the netcode system and brought it back. We'll really appreciate your feedback on how the game goes for you now.

Learn more

"OBSIDIAN", "MORION" AND "ONYX" SERIES

Three brand new series have premiered in the game. They will form part of the upcoming Battle Pass. We cannot reveal all details yet but you can already have a look at the impressive new guns.

"OBSIDIAN"SERIES

"MORION" SERIES

"ONYX" SERIES

BATTLE PASS ACHIEVEMENTS

The coming Battle Pass will also offer new achievements: 7 marks, 6 badges and 3 stripes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/ab599c893f85f31cff830394b9a3bc4f38b08b4e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/f59a3510d73da14d2068feff6e7c8f2bb8ed7c3a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/2ef4833cebcb9af05cbe7911aa873034a969e161.png

GOLD AS VAL

Great news for weapon connoisseurs - AS VAL now offers a golden version that boasts increased range of fire, a larger clip size and increased ammo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/b66a8b1a60cc74d46b7d6969ba52be3b6e893872.png

There will be, as usual, an achievement for 999 kills with the golden version.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/4f3a749dd3950aeae0c0dc10c67e41aa09245e98.png

GOLD CDX-MC KRAKEN

The game now offers the golden version of Kraken CDX-MC that has already got a solid reputation due to its high damage, fast zoom and a large capacity magazine.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/c6d833de8f7bcd16a890be9c80eaf8893c03749d.png

There will be, as usual, an achievement for 999 kills with the golden version.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/5449b6e5c741d718cbdf8dd5b891829ac900065c.png

GOLD TYPHOON F12

The modular automatic shotgun can now boast a first-rate golden version. This lethal weapon combines deadly power with outstanding looks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/39ea330c3c38a7cfd6bf0a396c176ddd86f8724f.png

There will be, as usual, an achievement for 999 kills with the golden version.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/c5feae5329868a2a4b92fc266d7b53688efb1f70.png

"GREAT GATSBY" WEAPON SERIES

We are glad to present you a new weapon and camo series "Great Gatsby". It may resemble "Platinum" camos due to the same colour scheme and a similar style. However, the new skins feature a unique ornament that is very impressive!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/afe10f5eec186f1db2df17c6207317d84b7a1913.png

And yes, there are achievements for these guns, too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/e45648f4cd7f300e54cd71a42a953e939774541c.png

"IDOL" SERIES EXTENDED

The "Idol" series has been updated: 6 excellent arms have been added to the existing line up - among them you will find class specific primaries, a pistol and a tomahawk. The guns will also boast unique attachments with a flashy design.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/52f13cfe94192ac99ea71d8fb9c6d1f55749566b.png

This stripe, badge and mark will be yours if you eliminate your enemies with the help of these guns!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/deb5f2a85d7b224c2e98a7dcff25676a911080e1.png

COBALT KINETICS EDGE RIFLE

The game now features a new Rifleman weapon with impressive damage and accuracy — Cobalt Kinetics EDGE Rifle. This model is effective at almost all distances and is capable of eliminating the target with one hit in the head. The weapon will be a reliable ally in solving tactical problems of any complexity due to the multiple possibilities of use of 5 unique attachments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/946456530a916a061d03b16436bdef1aeb7b1c8a.png

We will tell you about the the ways to get Cobalt Kinetics EDGE Rifle in a separate article.

COBALT KINETICS STEALTH PISTOL

The Engineer arsenal has also been stocked up. The new submachine gun is most effective at close and medium range. With this gun you will be able to eliminate almost any enemy with one shot to the head. The model comes with unique attachments that make the Cobalt Kinetics Stealth Pistol a truly deadly arm. In addition, the weapon has a luxurious aspect which will certainly interest all fans of cutting-edge technologies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/a49d13360d4685493805c0aa29931bc178a632b3.png

GERBER TOMAHAWK SKINS

The spectacular Gerber Tomahawk has got 7 one-off skins that will inevitably draw attention to its holder thanks to the unique animation of some of the new camos.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/b21802a2794ea6d6d6186de14dbc0e8983051a06.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/36de0bd74b883ee70882328808d5de6d42ad7e9f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/13fc4958263a83ae98fceead93b321f16798f1ca.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/a0a6417921390a0a1051d585cc0822a7f9285266.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/9d41a04c7c1f0c2a33218c70cf9c5c5e15b1d0aa.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/d6638daefdebbd9a8133a8488659b84a3b162590.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/5aa761a1236f30cd03119d24cea3fc81e32e819d.png

"UNDERGROUND" WEAPON SKINS

There are even more new weapon skins. These bright daring camos give the right vibe to take fast and decisive actions and achieve glorious victories. These are the proper weapons for those who are used to raising banners on the ashes of the enemy camps!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/54a6ebfc7b60cf167b6a1e67b90687bcc788abd9.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/6bdb07d2922b60a059dbf1ef9d871b3a4b32f745.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/6622a54df4f8d3f6a14dab5073fa752e13bc2b4d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/dac620a0be7470624b80ba6b5015ca5b9a5f3ed3.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/864062f15a541bbdd8131a9a556525ede1aace30.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/dac620a0be7470624b80ba6b5015ca5b9a5f3ed3.png

CONTENT CHANGES

REVAMPED SAFEHOUSE

The Safe House, a place where players spend a lot of time improving their skill and trying new weapons, has been updated. The same as before, the safe house is divided into several zones each of them having its own destination. Now you can see a special coach, from who you can take a trainee fighter mission.

WEAPON TWEAKS

The update brings tweaks to the following weapon models: Hera Arms CQR, AS VAL, Tavor TS12 Custom, LWRC SMG-45 and CheyTac M200.

All versions of the specified weapons will be affected unless stated otherwise. You can read more about them below.

Hera Arms CQR
More manageable recoil.
Increased head damage multiplier.

AS VAL
Increased damage (from 81 to 82).
Reduced maximum spread.
Increased damage multiplier to the legs.

Tavor TS12 Custom
Reduced delay between bursts.

LWRC SMG-45
Increased rate of fire (from 700 to 705).
More manageable recoil.
Increased mag capacity (from 30 to 32)
Increased ammo (from 150 to 160).

Golden LWRC SMG-45
Increased rate of fire (from 710 to 715).
More manageable recoil.
Increased mag capacity (from 35 to 37)
Increased ammo (from 175 to 185).

CheyTac M200
Increased minimum damage.
Increased damage multiplier to the body and limbs.
Increased effectiveness against heavily armored enemies.

SHADOWPLAY HIGHLIGHTS

The game now supports the NVIDIA ShadowPlay Highlights technology. It is now easier to save videos with the best gaming moments and share them with friends. The auto recording mode is available in certain cases:

 destruction of one of the mini-bosses or bosses (Mech, SED, "Crusher", "Enigma", "Destroyer", KA-50, "Black Shark", Sharckopter-MG 3000, "Mantis", "Architect", "Cruiser", "General MEGATANK", APC-3000, "Mammoth", "Terraformer-1");
 acquisition of mini-achievements in PvP;
 achievement unlocking;
 character's death in PvE.

ShadowPlay Highlights features:

 NVIDIA video cards starting from the model GTX600 support the function;
 video will not be recorded in first-person spectator mode;
 destruction of hard bosses ("Architect", "General MEGATANK", "Cruiser", "Terraformer-1") will be recorded for all team members.

OTHER CHANGES

WEAPONS AND GEAR

 Now it is easier to get achievements for kills made with certain weapons:

- 10 000 -> 5000 (for regular weapon models);
- 25 000 -> 10 000 (for regular weapon models);
- 10 000 / 15 000 - > 2500 (for special series or themed weapons);
- 5000 -> 1000 (for Crown weapons).

 Now it is possible to apply certain camos to some golden weapons.
 The Rocket Launchers SA-16 and ZSD-11 used in PvE missions have been replaced by a more modern model RLGS.
 АK Alpha, F90 MBR: the size of the weapon model in third person view is now more realistic.

PVP

 The game pause is now activated at the end of the round and not at the beginning.
 In the Ranked Matches it is now possible to activate special combat interface indicators that display which classes each team contains.
 Farm and "Street Wars": the normal map versions have replaced the themed ones.
 Red Sand: the map has been deactivated. We will announce later when it will return.

PVE

Melee weapons for artificial intelligence enemies have been reworked.
OTHER

 Lower ranks (less than 25) can now use global chat less often than higher ranks to prevent spam
 Now in first person view the visual effect of dust while sliding looks the same with all graphics settings.
 The PC resource consumption by the game sound effects has been optimized.
 The PC resource consumption by certain weapon models in first person view has been optimized.
 The main menu music theme has been replaced by the normal one.

FIXED BUGS

IMPORTANT

 The round based logic of PvP modes has been modified. The round used to end immediately after the last kill. That's why there used to be "freezes" and the models of killed enemies could suddenly disappear if players changed classes. Now the problems described will no longer occur since the round will end in several seconds after the last kill.
 Fixed the error which sometimes caused desynchronization of characters' positions if some actions were made with the game window in Windows.
 Fixed the error due to which characters could fall through the floor on some maps.

WEAPONS AND GEAR

 H&K G36C, TEC-9: fixed the error due to which some scopes were incorrectly placed on weapons in third person view.
 Uzkon UNG-12: fixed the error due to which the rear peep sight did not coincide with the front post sight when equipping the Basic Scope.
 Fixed the error due to which the center of the reticle of a 2x pistol sight did not coincide with the actual point of impact.
 АK-47 "Flor de Muerto": fixed the error due to which the Basic Scope did not coincide with the actual point of impact;
 RPD Custom, XM8, M16 SPR Custom, Desert Eagle: fixed the error which caused incorrect attachment interface display in the weapon modification menu.
 Fixed the error which caused incorrect attachment interface display in the modification menu of some Engineer weapons.
 Mossberg 500 Custom, SR-2 Veresk, Golden DP-12, Saiga Bullpup: fixed the error which caused incorrect weapon display in the character’s right hand if a female skin was used.
 Fabarm STF 12 Compact: fixed the error causing incorrect buttstock texture display in first-person view.
 RPK: fixed the error which caused incorrect weapon display in the character’s left hand.
 Tavor TAR-21: fixed the error which caused incorrect weapon display in the character’s left hand.
 Classic Soviet Knife: fixed the error causing incorrect blade texture display in third-person view.
 Arcus Scout: fixed the error causing visual artefacts in the scope if "Motion blur" was on.
 Fixed the error due to which, the cartridge ejection animation after shooting some weapon types repeated when the character made a hit with a buttstock.
 Marlin 1894 Custom, S&W M&P R8: fixed the error due to which the attachments of some weapon versions were of the wrong colour.

PVP

 Armageddon: fixed the error due to which in a certain spot of the map the player could see through the smoke cloud.
 Street Wars: fixed the error due to which in a certain spot of the map the player could fall through the textures.
 Battle Royale: Exclusion Area: fixed the error due to which the player could get stuck in a certain spot of the map.
 Trailer Park: fixed the error due to which a thrown bomb froze in the air in a certain spot of the map.
 Widestreet: fixed the error which caused incorrect display of remote objects in a certain spot of the map.
 Residence: fixed the error which caused incorrect display of remote objects in a certain spot of the map;
 Residence: fixed the error which in some cases caused visual artefacts in a certain spot of the map.

PVE

 Africa: fixed the error due to which the player could get stuck in a certain spot of the map.
 Fixed the error due to which turrets in Special Operations and PvE-missions did not take damage if an enemy impacted them.
 Mars: fixed the error due to which a visual artefact appeared while switching between Arcus and the Jumper.
 Middle East:
 fixed the error due to which in some cases the icon of a planted mine remained on the mini-map after its explosion;
 fixed the visual artefact in a certain spot of the map.
 Cold Peak (Act 1): fixed the error due to which after destruction of a tank it was displayed as an ally unit on the mini-map beyond the location boundaries.
 Mars: fixed the error due to which in some cases the Heavy Droid has no vulnerable spots and could not be destroyed.
 Cyber Horde: fixed the error which caused incorrect movement animation of "Destroyer".

OTHER

 Fixed the error due to which a player who changed the SED class to another one in the final round held the SED weapon on the after-match statistics screen.
 Fixed the error due to which after being invited to a clan, a player did not receive the corresponding notification in the notification box.
 Fixed the error which in some cases caused incorrect animation of a player being helped to his feet after he was knocked down.
 Fixed the error which caused incorrect character model display in first-person view if he switched to melee weapons and looked under his feet.
 Fixed the error which caused incorrect character animation in third-person view if while reloading a weapon the player switched to another one.
 Fixed the error which caused incorrect display of "Berserk" weapons class icons in the store.
 Fixed the error which caused incorrect display of SED’s class icon in the spectator mode.
 Fixed the error due to which class icons of SED and Sniper could subsitute one another in the spectator mode.

notes.title: Halloween update - already in game!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/eb6710ba006684ef8046e7eff04e18669df0fa02.jpg

Soldiers!
 
The Halloween update has landed on Warface servers. The "Poltergeist" series, "Red Sand" map, Halloween celebrations and much more are awaiting you. Check them out!

HALLOWEEN CELEBRATIONS

Warface is ready for Halloween celebrations: the Special Operation "Cyber Horde" is back; you can now enjoy the maps "Halloween Farm" and "Halloween Wars", log-in gifts, a blood-chilling theme song and new shop supplies. The event will end when the next update goes live.

In the next few days you will be able to participate in the traditional festive mini-game and receive excellent rewards. We will announce the promotion page launch later. Stay tuned!

NEW CONTENT

"POLTERGEIST" SERIES

“Poltergeist” is a new weapon series, which combines overwhelming power of other weapons and unique design, inspired by the Halloween atmosphere and its most popular symbols. Amazing power of these weapons can both frighten your enemies and satisfy your sense of beauty with sparkling elements on the barrel. Apart from weapon series there are weapon skins of the same style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/4eba06ef0acdd17ffd0f02859086a0f437729448.png
Stoner LMG A1

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/3dcbecd1490b74977cbe06e0ec59ab6db61ca4be.png
Marlin 1894 Custom

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/c2af435805191c5e2ae93555d85b700bbbdfb37f.png
SIG MPX SBR Custom

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/5d01366dddf6060ed722783d0fa317ec01ce8f13.png
Bushmaster BA50

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/a3e21d724e68ff76589384664a4edce16f87ac8f.png
Maxim 9

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/e0d1d7c7e977ebbdb34dc3fa3c73b8760c5ef374.png
Balisong Knife

You can land killing blows with the “Poltergeist“ series weapons and get unique achievements: a custom stripe, a badge and a mark.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/9f398097fcce0c7fd1844cc8da9baecdbdd9d20b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/07625689f9e6d29f9de7b20cbb2d52337b8e415b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/a56a75804100f978d39b9484a75d505d1f005321.png

You can get the "Poltergeist" items in the festive mini-game that will soon become available.

"RED SAND" MAP

We are glad to present you the new seasonal map for the "Free for All" mode! This time the Red planet will become the scene of combat featuring a low gravity environment and Martian colonist settlements that you could have contemplated while completing the Special Operation "Mars". It is not possible to imagine Mars without SEDs, meaning that "Red Sand" will be available only for robots outfitted with the Martian ARCUS equipment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/0ed58f904311e9304196bd1a10ea07105313aa3f.jpg

"Red Sand" offers a completely new gaming experience and an opportunity to have lots of fun!

CONTENT CHANGES

WEAPON TWEAKS

All versions of the specified weapons will be affected unless stated otherwise. You can read more about them below.

SIG MPX SBR Custom
Clip capacity of the regular version is now 36 rounds and of the golden version - 40 rounds (used to be 32 and 36 respectively).
Max ammo of the regular version is now 180 and of the golden version - 240 (used to be 160 and 180 respectively).

XM556 Microgun
Damage reduced to 80 (used to be 83).
Reduced minimum damage.
Effective range is now 15 (used to be 16).

Maxim 9
The rate of fire of the regular version is now 290 and of the golden version - 300 (used to be 270 and 280 respectively).

NEW MOVEMENT AND SYNCHRONIZATION SYSTEM

The new movement and synchronization system described before is being fine-tuned.
 
Errors have been identified in the "client-server" mechanisms as well as in animations, level design and other game aspects. Thus, most of the developers are now involved in the fine-tuning of the system.
 
Some errors have already been fixed, but it will take us some time to solve them all. Therefore, the system will not be implemented with the current update, we expect that it will be installed within the next month, approximately in mid to late November.

ADDITIONAL CHANGES

IMPORTANT

 Certain Random Boxes now feature different drop rates of certain items:

- the chance of obtaining a permanent version of the weapon (regular and gold) remains the same;
- the chance of obtaining temporary versions of weapons has risen;
- the chance of obtaining character skins has been reduced.

 The game client security system has been modified.
 New tournament and eSport achievements have been added.
 Resource consumption of some game model materials has been optimized.

WEAPONS AND GEAR

 The gloves and boots of the "Specter" series ("Beta" and "Sigma" groups) for Medics and Snipers have been added to the list of rewards for the completion of the Special Operation "Mars" on "Hard".
 The daily log-in rewards have been replaced by themed items. Please note that the progress will start from the day where you finished the previous streak.

PVP

 The Ranked Match matching configurations have been tweaked. Now teams will be better balanced according to players’ effectiveness but at the cost of increased matching time.
 "Free for All":

- the time of the kill-camera demonstration (a special mode after the character's death) has been reduced to 3 sec (used to be 4);
- the respawn protection time has been increased to 1.2 sec (used to be 0.7 sec).

 The "Farm" and "Street Wars" maps have been replaced by their themed versions.

PVE

 "Mars": the number of deaths required to receive class-specific achievements is now 1000 (used to be 5000).
 The Special Operation "Cyber Horde" has returned.

BUG FIXES

IMPORTANT

 Fixed the error when the SED could not pick up a bomb if there was a weapon on top of it.
 Fixed a series of errors in the new movement and synchronization system:

- an error due to which players could occupy unintended positions on the map;
- an error that caused incorrect character animation in the third person view if he was lying and then immediately performed a jump.

 Fixed the error that caused incorrect display of the SED’s sight when it returned to combat and observed its reactivation through the Engineer’s eyes.

WEAPONS AND GEAR

 Mosin Model 1891/30, Dragunov SVU-AS, DSA SA58 SPR: fixed the error when shell casings looked differently in the first and the third person view.
 MG3: fixed the error when shell casings were not displayed in the third person view.
 CheyTac M200: fixed the incorrect position of the special muzzle flash effect.

PVP

 "Residence": fixed the error when the player could get trapped in certain windows while sliding.
 "Forest": fixed the error causing the appearance of a visual artifact under the vehicle in a certain place on the map.
 "Africa": fixed the error due to which the player could get trapped at certain points on the map.
 "Hawkrock": fixed the error of the level geometry in a specific place of the map.
 "D17": fixed the error that caused the appearance of a visual artifact in a specific place on the map.
 "Bridges": fixed the error causing an incorrect character display if the player had low shadow quality.
 "Factory": fixed the error due to which the player got teleported back if he tried to get onto a container.
 "Blackgold": fixed the error due to which the player could get trapped in some doorways while sliding.

PVE

 "Training": fixed the error due to which the Blackwood logo remained in the sky after the destruction of the tower.
 "The HQ" (6th floor): fixed the error due to which grenades did not deal damage if they exploded on wet surfaces.
 "The HQ": fixed the error due to which the effect of dealing damage to various surfaces did not correspond to their materials.
 "Pripyat": fixed the error causing an incorrect display of some objects.
 "Asia": fixed certain visual effects.
 Fixed the error due to which the player could find himself outside the helicopter while the level was loading.
 "Anubis" (Act 2): fixed the error due to which there was an impenetrable and invisible object in a certain place on the map.
 "Black Shark": fixed the error due to which the player could leave the game area if he was on the left side of the helicopter.
 "Black Shark": fixed the error that allowed oppontents to penetrate textures.
 Fixed the error due to which several enemies could appear at a spawn point at the same time.

OTHER

 Fixed the error due to which the player's class icon in the Room sometimes did not correspond to the chosen class.
 Fixed the error due to which the parameter "Allow contacts to join" was sometimes disabled while creating a Room.
 Fixed the error causing an incorrect character position on the after-match-statistics screen.
 Fixed the error producing a lateral movement animation while in fact the character was moving backwards in crouch.

Good luck in battle!

notes.title: Warface: Titan Update - now live! [UPD]
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/2a585dbb86ff37016619e726adecb61a8975d24b.jpg

Soldiers!

A new update has been installed today. A new class, SED, SV-98 sniper rifle, tweaks of guns and equipment, as well as other changes await!

SED

www.youtube.com/watch?v=QWysWLw8iic

SED (Synthetically Engineered Double) is a new class; it is a robot you have already got familiar with in the latest Special Operations. As for other classes, it is well-balanced and will not be stronger than them; however, it has unique features that will allow for a brand new gaming experience.

Unsurpassed armor. The SED class has a huge armor supply that ensures excellent protection from enemy bullets shot even from the most effective weapon models. This advantage is set off by few health that Medics will not be able to replenish. However, the Engineer class has been adjusted and now they can support SEDs restoring their armor and putting the android back into lines with a special tool — jumper.

Heavy weaponry. SED is armored with a heavy machine gun that does not require reloading. Its precision increases with every shot fired. However, there is a drawback to it - SED can shoot only from the hip and the gun tends to overheat so you will not be able to maintain your fire for a long time.

XM556 Microgun is already available in the shop

SED's secondary weapon is a grenade launcher with two charges: explosion deals damage and has a flashbang effect.

CZ 805 G1 is already available in the shop

Unassisted climbing. Unlike other classes SED can climb high objects without teammates' help: it should only run to an obstacle and jump.

Increased stability. There is no way to knock SED off its feet.

Special equipment. SED stats are improved with the help of special modules, but it can't use the same equipment as other players.

Improved modules are already available in the shop.

Low mobility. SED's impressive armor makes it quite heavy: thus, the android has low running and strafe speed as well as a shorter slide distance. Naturally, "human" soldiers are much quicker.

The introduction of the fifth class will have a significant impact on the roles of other classes. The Engineer will now become some kind of a Medic due to the fact that he will be able to put the android back in line. Teamwork will reach a new level when the new class will become the vanguard closely monitored by the Engineer healed by Medics in their turn.

SED is allowed in Ranked matches with all its weapons and equipment!
You can obtain a lot of new and reworked achievements playing as SED.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/5d757fa437a2e3a3bffcc04a4c95caee5616b13f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/ef147c30bcc4a0b6f2949b3ff39c805161cf7847.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/d9540f1acdd5528c5f6b9d856c018b2fdf7d3d3f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/7e23523d45e0ab7228a32babfa338bfbc4aa640f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/f6c0a37ce69157305340b2a5840736422bf8bb5a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/e8ff311fba7fbfa12b216d01d5c5d5779069e27f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/213064dd7c49390eae59134b30b6ac3d236f341a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/dff5dd97a8e67c794e086101c08e742ad4526745.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/1bc839c9bd6de27e2b54257e8c25c34d05b58e47.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/09e6eed142b5427e65dc5081d68397689e56d26a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/e127336ba2874751e4d6acb68d21524241f47874.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/3ac034e35cf726c7600e50c347044723a468f481.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/d853bc4a60456415b1944356b7eae3882e17dcbd.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/af42b3d9dd666ee5a6ae2ac0891e90de00c13ac7.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/5179a2ba5bf570456b1da8dc55355d58efe27153.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/ba66d3173693a8bec3397f52df55d87ce9d1242d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/c1296c4c51c924b35387749ce0c28f75cd0f901b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/da5e6ac38184fc68a3aadd3ff5c9e281db911131.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/242bdcbf5e3979d0c104f8e75e54586abd4663e3.png

SV-98

SV-98 is a sniper rifle that combines crushing power with the ability to aim quickly. This weapon can neutralize almost any target, regardless of where they were hit and their armor.So, the rifle is similar to the Truvelo CMS 20x42 mm, but it is not able to neutralize the new SED class with one shot, even after an aimed shot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/1ff35e5c408d8d19995c6bc27e69a5c7acfbbb9d.jpg

Don't forget about achievements! You will get special awards for eliminating your enemies with this weapon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/a0eb65590a96ae41f42439eda341cf0e149bb17d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/fd57e3ae15438843d00cba699a8869ed7c36eb3e.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/528e122843636cbbe2af3751fa31e5134e1e9a09.png

We will inform you once SV-98 appears in the shop.

Content changes

Item changes

This update features tweaks to the specs of certain primary weapon models. In addition, the "Spectre" set bonus will be increased.

All the versions of the weapons will be subject to changes, unless stated otherwise.

FN FAL DSA 58
Increased efficient range (from 16 to 17).
More manageable recoil.

Saiga Bullpup
More manageable recoil.
Decreased minimum spread.

Crye Precision SIX12
Increased rate of fire (from 185 to 190).
Increased efficient range (from 5,8 to 6).

Tavor CTAR-21
Increased damage (from 75 to 76).
Increased damage multiplier to the limbs.

Tavor CTAR-21 Crown (Model 1)
Increased magazine capacity (from 30 to 32).
Increased ammo (from 180 to 192).

SCAR-L PDW
Increased head damage multiplier.

Magpul FMG-9
Increased damage (from 63 to 65).
Reduced minimum spread.
Increased damage multiplier to the legs.

Golden Magpul FMG-9
Increased damage (from 64 to 66).
Reduced minimum spread.
Increased damage multiplier to the legs.

Moreover, changes will apply to "Spectre" gear as well.

 4-item "Spectre" set bonus: increased health and armor regeneration (from 1 to 2 points) for all classes after 4 secs without hits.
 4-item "Salamander" set bonus: decreases damage by 6 per hit.
 5-item "Salamander" set bonus: decreases damage by 12 per hit.

Secondary gear slot tweaks

We have revamped slots for secondary gear (explosives, non-lethal weapons and class-specific items). In total there will be 6 slots, each of them with a certain function.

 "Special" big slot  for class-specific gear has been removed and replaced with 2 slots below that have a similar function.
 a total of 6 slots for additional ammunition (there were 7 before): 3 slots for grenades of various types, 1 slot for a mine and 2 slots for special class equipment;
 now each player can have only one grenade or mine of each type

Slide spread changes

The quality of shooting in various character positions is an important part of game mechanics. After changing the sliding system, players faced a situation when there were no additional shooting factors for sniper rifles when sliding - instead, they used the factors for a prone position.

This situation needs to be improved, since when running, sliding or jumping the shooting quality should deteriorate. To get closer to the classic sniper archetype, the current mechanics have been adjusted - the spread when hip-firingduring the slide for all sniper rifles has been increased. We will continue to study this situation and the opinions of the players, and other changes are possible.

Other changes

Important

 The logic of smoke grenades mechanics upon in a collision with a solid surface has been reworked. Even if a grenade continues to roll or hits a moving object after hitting an obstacle, it will now work anyway.
 The visual effect of the smoke grenade has been improved: the saturation of the cloud inside will change depending on the position of the player in it - the smoke will be thicker and darker in the center than at the edge.

Weapons and equipment

PVP

PVE

[previewyoutube=https://www.youtube.com/embed/SAaDyumI57c;full][/previewyoutube]

Changes in the personal crates system

One more innovation is the personal crates system update. There are two of them now:

 Crates are class-specific now;
 Now you can get a guaranteed permanent weapon from the crates.


And some more info:

The class you choose will have influence on the crates that you will get during the event. They become class-specific and contain the reward which the player can use.

Apart from this, we’ve changed the reward system. There were no restrictions before, but now there’s a "limit on amount of failures":  if the players weren’t lucky enough to get the gun from the 49 crates, the 50-th crate will definitely bring them the weapon they were to get. More crates  — more weapons! Rewards cannot duplicate: getting the weapon you want means that you will not be able to get one more from this crate.

See you in game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/097930493cee9ca6efb47c9d66412ed795b34361.png

Soldiers!
 
A minor patch containing fixes for the September Update has been installed. Check out the list below and evaluate in-game changes!
 
Please bear in mind that the "Salamander" gear and "Berserk" guns are still unavailable. We will tell you about the dates and ways of obtaining these items in a dedicated article.

Content Changes

 The "Berserk" gear set has been renamed "Salamander" and revamped:
 The Engineer and the Sniper Set perks protecting from one impact have been substituted for the Rifleman and the Medic effects respectively. This will help Engineers feel more confident thanks to increased hand protection while Snipers will be able to take on the role of silent assassins dealing impressive damage at the cost of weak armor.
 The overall health and armor regeneration speed has been slightly increased.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/f6460cc20b6ed84cfa764e647ad72271ec24c104.jpg

 The season maps "Hangar (Jogos 2016)" and "Brazilian Vault" have been replaced with their regular versions.

 McMillan CS5 "Phobos": fixed the error causing incorrect texture animation display on the model’s body.

Please note that new weapons will be available in the future - we'll annouce their arrival to the store in separate articles.

F90 MBR
We are glad to present a new Rifleman primary F90 MBR. Only AK-12 is a worthy opponent for it. The latter still provides a better rate of fire, while its higher recoil can be reduced by mounting a unique grip.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/60cf628a675df81ea0a05287402346f0d9ad1e7f.jpg
Apart from the standard set of attachments the rifle comes equipped with a special grip that increases accuracy, reload speed, and weapon selection speed, while slightly reducing recoil. Read more.

GERBER TOMAHAWK

Gerber Tomahawk is a multifunctional axe that has increased melee damage. And its secondary attack can defeat even an enemy in a Corundum vest!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/859318d78d446b5802c87a1176d6c85e7d67c702.jpg
Its flashy golden version features even higher range and damage, which will satisfy all the fans of melee combat.Read more.

EXPANSION OF "SPECTRE" SERIES

The collection has been expanded with "Sigma" gloves and boots as well as "Beta" boots. These items can be obtained upon completing the Special Operations "Anubis" and "Pripyat" on Hard difficulty.

Beta Rifleman Boots

 Increase leg protection by 15%
 Delay claymore activation by 3 sec
 Increase crouch speed by 35%

Beta Medic Boots

 Increase sprint distance by 50%

Sigma Rifleman Gloves

Sigma Medic Boots

 Increase slide distance by 30%

Sigma Engineer Boots

 Increase leg protection 20%
 Increase slide distance by 30%
 Increase sprint speed by 15%

"BERSERK" SERIES
“Berserk” gear, weapons and weapon camo have been added to the game client. We will tell you more about "Berserk" series and the ways of obtaining it in our future publications.
CONTENT CHANGES
WEAPON TWEAKS

The specs of certain weapons have been changed. The modifications affected guns for all the classes, namely Desert Tech MDR-C, VHS-2, HCAR, Saiga H.G.C. Custom, Fostech Origin-12, Saiga Spike, Marlin 1894 Custom, Mini Uzi, SR-2 Veresk, H&K MP5A5 Custom, Micro-Roni, SIG MPX SBR Custom, Remington R11 RSASS. Several "Anti-Cyborg" weapons have been modified as well. In addition, Remington MSR and the Executor knife animations have been fine-tuned.

The tweaks will apply to all the versions of the weapons unless stated otherwise. See the table below to learn more about in-game stats changes.

 Increased damage multiplier to arms
 Decreased spread in the aiming mode while jumping

VHS-2

 Increased damage multiplier to arms

 Decreased recoil and spread while using the grenade launcher

HCAR

 Decreased recoil
 Increased damage multiplier to limbs

Saiga H.G.C. Custom

Fostech Origin-12

Saiga Spike

 Increased rate of fire (to 115, used to be 110)
 Decreased spread in the aiming mode (except while sliding and jumping)

Marlin 1894 Custom

 Decreased spread in the aiming mode while jumping

Mini Uzi

 Decreased damage drop at distance
 Decreased spread
 Increased mag capacity (to 35, used to be 30)
 Increased ammo (to 210, used to be 180)
 Increased damage multiplier to legs

SR-2 Veresk

 Increased damage (to 65, used to be 63)
 Increased mag capacity (to 32, used to be 30)
 Increased ammo (to 192, used to be 180)
 Increased damage multiplier to limbs
 Decreased recoil

H&K MP5A5 Custom

 Increased damage (to 77, used to be 75)
 Increased damage multiplier to limbs

Micro-Roni

 Increased rate of fire (to 770, used to be 750)

SIG MPX SBR Custom

Remington R11 RSASS

 Increased minimum damage.

"Anti-Cyborg" XM8 LMG

"Anti-Cyborg" FN Five-seveN

"TIGERSTRIPE" WEAPONS AND SKINS

The "Tigerstripe" camo series has been extended with a namesake weapon line-up! It includes the same guns and achievements: a badge, a mark and a stripe. Now it is possible to apply the skins to more arms: AS VAL, Enfield L85A2 Custom, M249 Para, MG3, VEPR, USAS-12, H&K MP5A5 Custom, Uzi Pro, SIG MPX SBR Custom, CheyTac M200, MK 14 EBR, COLT Python, CZ 75 Czechmate Parrot, Balisong Knife and the Classic Soviet Knife.

We will tell you more about the ways of obtaining "Tigerstripe" guns in our future publications.

OTHER CHANGES
WEAPONS AND EQUIPMENT

 Cartridge casing ejection animation has been improved:
 its direction now depends on the character and the camera position;
 cartridge casings bump into surrounding objects;
 cartridge casings are of the right size;
 cartridge casings do not hinder aiming;
 added revolver cartridge casings;
 fixed the error when cartridge casings were not displayed or were not fully caught on camera.
 Added experimental weapon models that will become available in the up-coming game events.


PVE

 Now damage dealt to mini-bosses in the Special Operations "Sunrise" and "Mars" is more notable due to new special effects.


OTHER

 Added "Berserk" achievements.
 The explosive grenade effect looks the same at any graphics configurations.


FIXED BUGS
WEAPONS AND EQUIPMENT

PVE

KNOWN BUGS

 There is no localization of crates with achievements awarded for completing certain Special Operations.

notes.title: August Update - Now Live!
notes.notes:
Soldiers!

The first part of the August update has just landed on Warface servers. Hurry up to discover more about precision rifle Truvelo CMS 20x42 mm, shotgun Tavor TS12 Custom, automatic pistol TEC-9, "Hollywood" map for the "Destruction" mode and much more!

New Content
Truvelo CMS 20X42 mm

Truvelo CMS 20x42 mm packs a superb punch: even one impact in the limb will be enough to kill a soldier wearing "Armageddon" or "Syndicate" gear. The gun sports a low aiming speed resembling Bushmaster BA50, but boasts a higher rate of fire and excellent selection and deselection speed. The rifle comes equipped with two unique suppressors.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/5f85cc8f7f402ff730b3b141a8e4c478a46f2463.jpg

The weapon’s golden version offers awesome looks, increased hip fire accuracy and a large capacity 7-round mag. Truvelo CMS 20x42 will make a fine addition to your collection!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/43d8048e938922d026ded9975264d6b634e7b288.png

Tavor TS12 Custom

Tavor TS12 Custom is a one-off shotgun that fires three-round bursts and boasts fast follow-up shots. One burst will eliminate any foe in a heartbeat! This weapon offers good accuracy while aiming and also excellent range. On top of that, the load-one-round-and-resume-fire system makes Tavor TS12 Custom lethal in close and medium range combat that fits Meds just perfectly.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/bf3e41e2feeaf202cb219cf100a2b645ec71c785.jpg
The gun’s golden version sports impeccable looks, increased damage and a large capacity 18-round mag. Learn more.

And don’t forget about achievements! Annihilating enemies with Tavor TS12 Custom will earn you honorable distinctions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/d2a98969519bd0e97aa09b7a22bd7f152b7ed64d.png

TEC-9

TEC-9 offers automatic firing mode, insanely high rate of fire, manageable recoil and a high capacity magazine. The gun will be most useful in close and middle range combat. The enemy managed to get too close? No worries! This weapon will make a great rear guard and become a reliable ally whatever surprises your opponents keep in store.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/440d88896821ce8d0fe6a16449fe7b56b4f9fc19.jpg
The illustrious golden version sports improved damage, slightly increased rate of fire and a large capacity magazine holding 30 rounds.
Kills dealt with this gun will grant you custom achievements.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/ffa37c1b8526583038b6536d9cfcc4854d92588a.png

Open Cup 2019 Series

Every eSports fan dreams of getting their hands on a gun that a foe, once defeated, will never be able to forget. The Open Cup 2019 series features all-time favourite class-specific primaries that will not let you down no matter what dangers lie ahead. Attachments will also receive a stylish finish and make you stand out. Apart from the weapon line-up, the update brings themed skins. Learn more.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/77223e27128870aa7717fe2e44f1195c760ef0e9.png
Killing enemies with Open Cup 2019 guns results in exclusive spoils of war: a badge, a mark and a stripe.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/8988e821b4dac779fba78b93cb3d69526451209e.png
We will inform you about the ways to get the Open Cup 2019 items later. Stay tuned!

"SOCIAL JUSTICE" CAMOS

The new series offers weapon skins for primary, secondary and melee weapons. Camouflaged attachments will further enhance their already striking looks.Learn more.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/20bc72ef3bd11b9cea89013b2920f4d4fcc52740.png
We will inform you about the ways to get the "Social Justice" skins later. Stay tuned!

"Hollywood" Map
[previewyoutube=r7uHmMrMu3Q;full][/previewyoutube]
The update brings a new map "Hollywood" for the "Destruction" mode. In comparison with the previous maps of the mode, "Hollywood" has a different gameplay: the number of the winning team’s passes and vantage points decreases.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/991c588f49ef03bc634390d52244b092035ef249.png
The map looks like a film set sporting many attributes of a studio such as production and lighting devices, scenery, large green screens (chroma key) and others. Read more.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/42e5d38022d286f1651b6a6661af06fb4f1a8c6a.png

"Spectre" Series top-up

The "Spectre" gear line-up has been extended with "Sigma" gloves, and "Beta" gloves and boots. The objects can be obtained upon completing the Special Operations "Sunrise" and "Black Shark" on Hard difficulty:

"Spectre" (Sigma) Rifleman Gloves

 Increase hand protection by 20%.
 Decrease recoil by 20%


"Spectre" (Sigma) Medic Gloves

 Increase hand protection by 20%
 Increase accuracy by 20%


"Spectre" (Sigma) Engineer Gloves

 Increase hand protection by 20%
 Increase accuracy by 20%


"Spectre" (Sigma) Sniper Gloves

 Increase hand protection by 20%
 Increase accuracy by 15%
 Increase reload speed by 10%.


"Spectre" (Beta) Engineer Gloves

 Increase hand protection by 20%
 Increase reload speed by 20%
 Increase accuracy by 10%


"Spectre" (Beta) Medic Gloves

 Increase hand protection by 20%
 Increase reload speed by 20%
 Increase accuracy by 10%


"Spectre" (Beta) Medic Gloves

 Increase leg protection by 20%
 Increase slide distance by 30%
 Increase dash distance by 50%

Content changes
Other Changes

 Now character models displayed in the Inventory or the Shop consume less PC resources.
 Spec tweaks to Type 97B:
 rate of fire increased to 660 (used to be 650);
 increased minimum damage;
 effective range increased to 14,5 (used to be 13);
 more comfortable recoil.
 Improved game client components protecting from third-party software.
 The game maps have been revamped to suit the upcoming movement system.

Details:
Movement system update is a large-scale and complex process. Apart from movements as such, it affects many other systems introducing changes that require overhaul of all the maps (PvP as well as PvE). This stage cannot be skipped as it is vital for correct functioning of the new movement system. Level designers were revamping the maps while programmers were developing the new system. This is a great example of how complex such innovations are, because they affect many different game aspects.

Please note that the gameplay of the levels has not altered due to the purely technical nature of the changes.


Bug Fixes

IMPORTANT

 Fixed errors which sometimes prevented player’s personal stats update.
 Fixed the error causing audio delay of bomb defusing if the player started it right after jumping.

Weapons

 Mossberg 500 Custom, UTAS UTS-15, MAG-7, Anakon, Saiga Bullpup, Sidewinder Venom: fixed the error causing incorrect display of the character’s left arm in third person view when the shotgun was equipped with the Default Vest.
 Mateba Autorevolver: fixed the error causing incorrect reload animation if the pistol was equipped with a 2x scope.
 H&K USP, Browning High Power: fixed the error causing incorrect pistol display in the character’s right hand in first person view.
 Kriss Super V: fixed icon display in the camo application menu of the inventory.
 АK-103: fixed the error causing incorrect display of the character’s right hand during reload animation in first person view.
 Fabarm P.S.S.10: fixed a shooting visual effect.
 Rhino 60DS: the specs of all the versions of the pistol are now aligned with the basic model.
 АK-103, RPK: fixed the error causing incorrect left hand animation during a melee strike.
 Christmas Desert Eagle, Christmas Daewoo K1, AUG A3 9mm XS, Kriss Super V: fixed the error permitting to resume fire before the end of reload.
 Golden CZ 75 Czechmate Parrot: fixed the model’s error when the pistol had no firing pin.
 CZ 75 Czechmate Parrot: fixed the textures of the C-More reflex sight.
 Fabarm S.A.T. 8 Pro: the weapon’s textures are now correctly displayed.
 Barrett M98B: fixed the error of the weapon model.
 M40A5 "Radiance": readjusted the repair cost.
 SMG Suppressor: fixed a muzzle flash visual artefact.
 Kel-Tec Shotgun Vibrant: fixed the visual artefact on the weapon icon.
 Fixed the error in the weapon parameter comparison menu which caused incorrect weapon specs display as if the gun was damaged even if it had 100% durability.
 MC 255 12: fixed the error causing incorrect buttstock display if the player was in the sitting position.
 FN F2000, Desert Eagle, XM8, MK 14 EBR "Ares": fixed the incorrect position of the attachment group markers in the weapon customization menu.
 Benelli Nova tactical: fixed incorrect textures of discarded cartridges.
 АK-47: fixed the error causing appearance of a visual artefact while aiming with the Advanced Rifleman Scope.
 M16 SPR Custom: fixed the visual artefact in the lower left corner while using the rifle.
 Honey Badger: fixed the error due to which the weapon model’s trigger was not displayed.
 Golden Beretta ARX160: fixed the colour of the Default Iron Sight.
 Taurus Judge: fixed the error causing a visual artefact when the player moved surrounding objects (for example, red cubes in the safe house).
 SIG MPX SBR Сustom: fixed the visual error due to which AK-12 was displayed on the Smuggler’s card icon.
 АK-12: readjusted the repair cost.

Equipment

 Sapper Helmet for Medics and Riflemen: fixed incorrect display of the helmet’s parts while equipped with certain vest types.
 Christmas Engineer Helmet: fixed incorrect display of the helmet on certain characters.
 Christmas Sniper Helmet: fixed incorrect display of the helmet’s parts while equipped with certain vest types.

PvP

 Fixed the error due to which the character’s arms and weapons were not displayed in the spectator mode if a new player joined the match.
 "Factory": fixed the incorrect collision model in "Overhang" point.
 "District": the bomb on the roof of the van can no longer be defused from the ground in point 2.
 The creator of a private room is no longer excluded from it upon changing the number of players to 4.
 "Icebound": fixed a visual error in a certain spot of the map.

PvE

 "Africa": fixed the error causing incorrect freight container display in a certain spot of the map.
 "Training": fixed the error causing incorrect visual effects when the player performed a knife attack standing on the bridge.
 "Icebreaker": fixed the error due to which some enemy types did not use grenades while fighting against players.
 "Sunrise" (Act 2): fixed the error causing incorrect display of the C4 application hint.
 "Mars" (Act 2): fixed the error due to which opponents had fire displayed on their backs even after removing jet packs.
 "Sunrise" (Act 3): fixed incorrect object display when the player overcame an obstacle next to them.
 "Mars" (Act 3): fixed the error due to which a collision model was situated before the stage when players got separated.
 "Mars" (Act 4): demolished SEDs are now correctly displayed after they fall into the mine below the boss.
 "Mars" (Act 4): the boss’s laser beams no longer penetrate the shields behind which players hide.
 "Mars": fixed the error which sometimes caused an incorrect visual effect upon turret destruction.

Other

 The kill counter no longer stops at 1023.
 Resistance Skins Bundle: fixed the error due to which the set contained temporary skins.
 Fixed a visual artefact which sometimes appeared on the spot of grenade explosion.
 Absolute Engineer: the Warface squad emblem is no longer displayed on the helmet if the player is in the Blackwood team.
 Fixed the error due to which the dust effect was displayed even if the player was in front of a smoke screen.
 Fixed the incorrect target behaviour in the safe house.

Soldiers!

these breezy weapons! The following weapons will be available in store till around 11:00 CEST (9:00 UTC) on the 9th of August:

 Regular, Icebreaker and "Nuclear" Honey Badger via Random Kredit Boxes and Direct Sale

Special Highlight: CCR Honey Badger
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6139533/a89b3f18c5759f1767d5146bd71c14ce63186b38.png
