notes.title: Sunrise Update - now in game!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/e773cb49f892650b4a1a8eca4d7f5346aa47ef24.jpg

Soldiers!

This year's by far the most anticipated update is premiering now, bringing the all-new global Special Operation “Sunrise”, LWRC SMG-45, H&K G28 sniper rifle, golden Glock G18C, gingerbread gun, newly-added, expanded and returning weapon series: “Yakuza”, “Santa Hog”, “Yellow Emperor”, “Icebreaker” — and so much more!

NEW SPECIAL OPERATION “SUNRISE”

Meet the most epic special operation to be introduced to the game yet — "Sunrise". It brings numerous new enemy units, a thrilling storyline packed with plot twists, authentic locations and breathtaking gameplay features.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KBap0-xG1hU

“Sunrise” will deliver a fresh experience with its new core features, custom first-person view interactions and seamless cutscenes running on the very own game engine. Get ready to walk on a blade's edge -- you'll need to bend up and show team play yet unseen before to survive the combat encounters and see another Sunrise.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/0f6d542ba41dce2ac1f59b5f3c4ecc58be3c9a30.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/b23d278bd4032e956da001887a53481f7cce9f9d.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/b53b5f1b17d2e686b2e5cd45381429d176ef480d.jpg

“YAKUZA” WEAPON SERIES

The Yakuza series will become available with the release of the Special Operation “Sunrise” — acquiring these guns will be tough! The series consists of four class-specific weapons, one secondary and a melee: RPD Custom, Fabarm XLR5 Prestige, ACR CQB, M14 Crazy Horse, S&W M&P R8 and Katana.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/1fdb541651259a8263b34e9647fb9733d824233b.jpg

H&K G28 SNIPER RIFLE

This is hands down one of the most unique sniper rifles to be introduced to the game. If you main the Sniper class and are longing for a fresh experience, best give this one a shot! Its combat specs and design allow it to remain competitive at medium and even short ranges, much owed to the unique collimator sight.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/bf8479ea24a2e3baeb7e78b8db3e7b75d9c293fb.jpg

Two shots from the G28 to any part of the body are enough to take your enemy down, and a single headshot will definitely be lethal. The rifle is extremely lenient on its user with the combination of soft recoil and high rate of fire. The golden version has a somewhat increased rate of fire and magazine capacity.

You will soon be able to get the H&K G28 sniper rifle in Random Kredit or Crown Boxes.

LWRC SMG-45

Chambered in .45 ACP, the new SMG stands out due to its high damage.

Following in the footsteps of the G28, LWRC-45 is another game changer. Essentially a step up from the familiar UMP, this Engineer weapon can deliver one-shot kills if you land a headshot. To counterbalance, the SMG has the lowest rate of fire in its class, as well as a medium effective range and substantial recoil. Apart from that, LWRC SMG-45 comes with 2 unique attachments.


 LWRC SMG-45 1.3x collimator sight
 LWRC SMG-45 Angle Grip: increases accuracy, substantially reduces recoil, increases weapon selection / deselection speed


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/374c543187ca307710251d44db66ef629897b772.jpg

The golden version follows the tradition, bringing slightly improved combat specs.

You will soon be able to get LWRC SMG-45 in Random Kredit or Crown Boxes.

GOLDEN GLOCK 18C

Glock 18C was the first fully automatic pistol to be introduced to Warface. Initially, we feared it would become extremely overpowered due to its seemingly lethal combination of high damage and rate of fire that are easily comparable to the Engineer’s starter primaries. However, the secondary weapon lineup improved as time went by, and that forced Glock 18C to drop out of the competition. This update we’ve decided to bring it back!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/052ae6da25e13ba48a6774ce4bd92d78383d715b.jpg

To start with, Glock 18C will have its damage increased by 10 points up to 60, and will receive a minor buff to its accuracy while aiming. Apart from that, hit multipliers will be adjusted: the gun will deliver increased damage to legs but reduced to the head. This will make the gun more competitive overall, but will not guarantee a single headshot takedown.

You will be able to get Glock 18C in Random Kredit Boxes.

“ICEBREAKER” SERIES EXPANSION

The Icebreaker set will be expanded to include new weapons and skins in one of the upcoming game updates. The following weapons will join the series: Beretta ARX160, DP-12, CZ Scorpion Evo3 A1, Bushmaster BA50, CZ 75 Czechmate Parrot.

These guns will receive a striking ice cold pattern while retaining their original combat specifications — these guns will be a solid pick for dealing with any enemy just as before. Icebreaker weapon skins — applicable to the original listed weapons — will be added as well.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/978e8628c9f475e979035be905cd321577735b56.png

“SANTA HOG” WEAPON SERIES

As celebrations draw near, the festive Santa Hog series will be introduced to the game, consisting of the Legendary tier weapons: VHS-2, Saiga H.G.C. Custom, UZI PRO, Gepard GM6 Lynx, MPA 930DMG, the M48 Bowie knife and their respective weapon skins.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/60b71fd39d3749aab509513fabdfca7ded8a0677.png

Weapon extensions and attachments will adopt the same merry theme. And just as before, you will be able to get awesome achievements with these guns!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/4418111fd329982d4096e1aae50ceee07435dcb5.png

“YELLOW EMPEROR” SERIES

A great addition to any collector’s armory, and even more so to those who favor flashy, trendy guns! The Yellow Emperor weapon series will be introduced shortly before the Lunar New Year. The fierce Chinese dragon will be engraved into the side of the firearm, making it a true guardian in battle!

The Yellow Emperor series will consist of skins for ACR, ACR CQB, Daewoo K1, AS50, Cobray Striker, Fabarm STF 12 Compact, Desert Eagle and the Ultramarine knife. By the way, its achievements are just as marvellous as the guns themselves!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/336b38739d9d6ec52c996f2861aa45ffee5ee666.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/9c1214fafed3b713d156e66f2a324e5b36a2f896.png

GINGERBREAD GUN

Looking to sate your ‘sweet’ temptations? Check out the double-barrelled Gingerbread gun! Don’t be misled by its looks, it’s incredibly dangerous despite its… questionable origins.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/0e638be8e01a89a655a67017a2ee4b4a5aad7ae9.png

The shotgun packs a punch, and will be lethal in close quarters when hip-firing. Give it a shot and enjoy the unique firing animation — can’t wait for you to try it!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/75c083aa7b04d3f869022ee573576cabf4615cf8.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/ed9c74e20c561f636002c7e640e0f73abd93faea.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/baa47e0621e8fe712934c90164c8154680bf1280.png

CHRISTMAS CHANGES

 Added a new music theme to the game menu.
 Training grounds, warehouse and game shop have been updated to their festive versions.
 Ammo supply kit, First Aid kit and Repair kit have been replaced with their festive versions.
 “Residence”, “Icebound”, “Hangar” and “Oil depot” have been replaced with their festive versions.
 Login rewards have been replaced with Christmas items.

OTHER CHANGES

 “Carbon” series: reduced visual luminosity, glare and reflection intensity. The guns no longer distract the player from the game.
 New weapon skin series added for the following primary weapons: Tavor TAR-21, AA-12, Daewoo K1, AWM, Desert Eagle.
 Slightly increased armor points of several vests.
 Added the function to disable system messages in the game chat.
 Updated the kill bar with K/D stats displayed after death to include the weapon name used by the enemy that kills you.
 Fixed several thematic achievements.
 Fixed the error causing hipfire and aiming animations to switch incorrectly when firing primary weapon while moving.
 Fixed the error causing FPS drops during the game (normally occuring during Special Operations)
 Fixed the error causing critical client crashes.
 Fixed the error causing a “Replace me” tooltip pop up, replacing the achievement picture in the case of several achievements.
 Fixed the error causing the Christmas Firecracker kills to be ignored in “the Nightmare before Christmas” achievement.
 Fixed the error causing Christmas Cobray Striker reload animation to be displayed incorrectly in first-person view.
 Increased armor by 10 points of the following vests: Default Vest, Special Sniper Vest, Special Rifleman Vest, Atlant Vest and Strikeforce Vest.
 Removed the team chat in room chat (lobby before the match starts).
 Removed Resurrection Coins from the weapon Random Box loot tables. Resurrection Coins will be also purchasable for Crowns.
 Updated the loading screen.
 Updated the duel screen after a critical shot with the weapon name used by the enemy.

BUG FIXES

GENERAL

 Fixed the error causing the spectator mode to function incorrectly (blinking/shaking).
 Fixed visual artifacts and specific textures appearing in several PvP maps and Special Operations.
 Fixed a minor error related to the leaver suspension timer.
 Fixed a range of bomb planting and defusing animations.
 Fixed the issue causing the scrolling bar to appear when it’s not being used.
 Fixed the error causing several explosive eliminations with grenades and mines to fail to score achievement progress on several maps.
 Fixed the error causing the player to be unable to leave a clan if their rank was under 10.
 Fixed visual particles when jumping in water, causing dust to be shown instead of splashes.
 Fixed bomb planting and defusing animations in third-person view.

WEAPONS

 Fixed a visual artifact appearing when using the underbarrel grenade launcher on VHS-2.
 Fixed the mount color of the CZ Scorpion EVO A1 “Flor de Muerto” skin.
 Fixed the Hawk Pump shotgun firing animation and particles synchronization when firing whilst sliding.
 Fixed a visual artifact appearing when reloading underbarrel grenade launchers.
 Fixed attachments of the CZ Scorpion EVO A1 “Flor de Muerto” skin.

PVP

 Fixed visual artifacts and textures on several PvP maps and Special Operations.
 Fixed co-op climb positioning and animation issues on several PvP maps.
 Fixed the position issue that allowed the player to access the second floor unintentionally on “Factory”.

PVE

 Special Operation “Earth Shaker”: fixed the error causing the enemies to be displayed differently for several players at once.
 Special Operation “Blackout”: fixed the error causing the cyborgs to fall under the ground.
 Special Operation “Icebreaker”: fixed the visual crosshair issue when firing at specific turrets.
 Fixed helicopter sound issues in a range of PvE missions.

Discuss on Discord
Discuss on Facebook

notes.title: November Update is now live
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/9c5cb9e808e85f6ba9454c7619ac12a233818488.jpg

Soldiers!

The November update has just gone live, bringing the first-person spectator mode, weapon improvements and much more!

BATTLE PASS "SYNDICATE"

The next Battle Pass: "Syndicate" is right around the corner. Among other things, its members will be able to get various "Syndicate" and "Carbon" armor, weapon and skin sets. These can be earned by participating in the event: advancing your personal progress and completing game missions.

GET ACCESS

Great deal! Only until the end of November, every premium access purchase gets extra: CZ 75-Auto (for 14 days), its "Flor De Muerto" permanent skin and 5000 "Syndicate" smoke grenades. These additional gifts will be sent to the inventory only after the battle pass is released. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/586cc56acbcb0ef2b47a9fecd6cf8795a988f888.jpg

"SYNDICATE" AND "CARBON" WEAPON SERIES

These weapon series consist of all the top picks from Random Kredit Box, progression and Warface dollar series (including highly popular and powerful models), as well as weapon skins.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/bb7fd9b94c407d7437504d7ff56126583323cd85.jpg
Please note that the "Carbon" series was deemed too illuminated, and is currently pending a visual overhaul to reduce overall "brightness", glare and reflections. This fix will be implemented in one of the future updates.

"Carbon" weapon series

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/52a5676b84278d80908ad69459666e25f4230c5e.jpg

ACHIEVEMENTS

You will be able to earn dozens of unique achievements for killing enemies both within the Battle Pass and with the "Carbon" and "Syndicate" guns!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/18cf9728caf4d0d7ef4072cd0ba87f11f02e4c14.jpg

"SYNDICATE" GEAR

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/070e53c93194af262d818db9fdba85852ba1c1dd.jpg
			
SET BONUS

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/e0783241157d5059bf283a8b14e86210285feca9.jpg

CDX-MC KRAKEN

This deadly predator is going to be available to all Battle Pass: "Syndicate" members. The craftable sniper rifle can be found in the weapon crafting section. Not even the toughest vests will be able to save your enemy from a CDX-MC Kraken round, including those protecting from the first hit!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/cd554443607f263bc1692fc77f5341ca9894c139.jpg

This highly potent bolt-action rifle combines all the traits a sniper needs: high damage, incredibly fast zooming speeds (in and out), increased damage to limbs and a magazine large enough to keep you firing. Apart from that, the rifle can be outfitted with a suppressor, and comes with a unique flashguard that increases penetration capability even better than the standard one!

Achievement-hunters will be able to unlock unique stripes for 10000 and 25000 combat kills with this rifle.

Warface Team

notes.title: Next update bringing: pauses during tournament matches
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/5a3adc67b098dee9d4cb4cc6a7d00e67c0f04307.jpg

Soldiers!

The next game update will be bringing a new “Pause” feature, allowing you to take technical breaks during a competitive match. Please note that this feature will be available exclusively on the tournament server and will prove a useful asset to teams when they need to discuss tactics or address technical issues.

Let’s walk over the key points here:

 Pausing will be enabled only on the tournament server in Clan Battles in the following game modes: “Plant the Bomb”, “Capture”, “Blitz”.
 Either team can initiate the vote to pause.
 As soon as the minimum amount of votes required is reached, the game is paused for the following 60 seconds (may be changed in future).
 Both teams can initiate a vote at the same time, but as soon as either of them reaches the votes required, the second one stops and the game is paused.
 Each team can only pause the game once during the match (may be changed in future).
 Vote to pause cannot be started if there’s any other vote in progress.
 Vote to pause can be started via the class selection menu, accessed via “ESC” -> “Vote” -> “Game Pause” -> “Pause”. Other game modes will not feature this button.
 During the pause, the game screen changes to the “Game paused” screen. Players can use all the functions available before the beginning of the match. As soon as the pause expires, the screen returns to normal and the game resumes. 

Pausing will prove helpful to teams in case of a disconnect — a team will be able to pause the game to wait for the player to return and continue the match in full roster.

Future competitive events will also feature tactical pauses: so-called “Timeouts” for quick breaks during the match.

Please note that technical details of the feature may change per the testing results.

Master new tactics and maneuvers following the pro players! Let’s walk through the basics of how it will work:

Players can only spectate members of their team.

notes.title: Next update bringing: Uzkon UNG-12
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/6274925ca9d8c61405dddeaf948d91c7b9b4c834.jpg

Soldiers!

Meet Uzkon UNG-12 — a brand new Medic weapon to be featured in the next update. This shotgun is bound to catch an eye with its unusual futuristic design. Fully automatic, it’s able to unleash a hailstorm of lead upon the battlefield, posing a severe threat in close quarters!

INSPIRATION

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/2998213740492834157addb73bdb1a45fb35228a.jpg

This compact bullpup shotgun was designed by a Turkish small arms manufacturer, Uzkon Arms Defence. On their own, smooth-bore bullpup rifles are a proven exotic for the international market, though UNG-12 manages to capture the spotlight — much owed to its magazine feed system.

IN WARFACE

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/11111f8ae399e672bf73b9aef07bdf0e3a9c94da.jpg

Delivered straight into the hands of Medics, this aluminum-polymer hybrid threatens to strip the class of its supportive role: UNG-12 is far superior to both its automatic and semi-automatic analogues, and even poses a solid threat to the pump-action powerhouses! Let’s get into the details.

To start with, Uzkon UNG-12 shows plenty of promise with accuracy, effective range, damage and rate of fire values — the latter as its forte. Having said that, it falls short of customization features provided by its peers, as the shotgun can only be outfitted with a flash guard that reduces muzzle flash and damage drop beyond its effective range.

Uzkon UNG-12 will be available in Random Kredit Boxes and Random Crown Boxes.

The shotgun also comes in three variants: regular, golden and platinum. The Golden UNG-12 will feature increased magazine capacity and rate of fire, while the Platinum counts as a visual upgrade to your golden variant, and can be only obtained in Random Kredit Boxes. By the way, if you find the Platinum shotgun in a Random Box, you’ll get the Golden variant as well!

Don’t forget the achievements! Landing killing blows with this shotgun will provide you with memorable stripes that can be pinned on your profile. Wear ‘em with pride!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/f9faaabfdd602222002c0fc8f45d8d827ad696cc.png

Achievements

You will of course receive special achievements for the successes on this map.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/046189ad3430583c57420d94a180423992573e75.jpg

Learn more

SAIGA SPIKE SHOTGUN

Saiga Spike is a one-of-a-kind shotgun that will blow up and completely redefine your typical medic gameplay! It comes loaded with an LMG round instead of a buckshot, the so-called “slug”. Loaded with 12-gauge slugs Spike is bound to knock down even the most heavily-armored foes at ranges up to 12 meters.

https://youtu.be/vhMRGRnbv6o

Moving on to the specs, one can’t help but notice the damage values and how they translate into performance in the real world of Warface. Unlike pellets, a slug round delivers a steady focused shot that powerful enough to knock anyone down, regardless of their armor.

While lenient on damage — maxing out at 500 points within its effective range of 12m — this gun leaves little room for error with its low rate of fire and capacity. Nevertheless, the bullpup configuration makes recoil manageable and accuracy reliable enough for an average user, while the Picatinny rail provides plenty of customization opportunities.

Looking for a new experience as a medic? Look no further and check out Saiga Spike in Warface Dollar Boxes.

Learn more

HCAR ASSAULT RIFLE

HCAR is the first semi-automatic assault rifle to be featured in the game. This is a great pick for both Snipers looking for transition to other roles, and Riflemen that wish to try something different than their usual automatic toolkit.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/aa3a41aaa146082f18096e6efafe20b8d03d4c26.jpg

The rifle is set to revolutionize gameplay in Warface, and is the first semi-automatic weapon for the Rifleman. Whether you’re a Rifleman ‘main’ looking to try something new, or a veteran Sniper looking for an easy transition, this is hands down your best pick.

HCAR deals double damage to body and limbs, sports considerably high damage — enough to knock most of them down. These great qualities are offset by recoil and a limited capacity, as the mag carries only 20 rounds.

The golden variant brings an increased rate of fire and an expanded mag capacity. Both regular and golden variants will be available in Random Kredit Boxes.

Learn more

	ACHIEVEMENTS

The game now features 24 new achievements for combat prowess on the new “Platform” map, as well as “Longway”, “Wharf” and “Sirius” (3 badges and 3 marks for each map).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/ff17dac1be8bdb9b3330b962fb6094485d7e0b93.png

	RANKED MATCHES 2.0 SEASON 1

Compete in the first season of the reworked ranked matches.

Learn more

MATCHMAKING

Regional matchmaking has been improved: players will now be selected for a match also based on proximity to one another.

WEAPONS

Reworked Taurus Judge specs. Secondary weapons are designed to support the primaries, and can be used frequently if the situation, like a specific map, just calls for it. However, it has become obvious that Taurus Judge filled the niche intended for the primary weapons, and this revolver shows better performance than shotguns at times. We believe a single weapon — even the one possessing unique features — shouldn’t ruin class balance, and thus we’ll be reducing some of its strengths. The revolver is meant to be a reliable secondary weapon, not a primary one. After these changes, Taurus Judge will keep its unthinkable powers in close quarters combat, thanks to the ability to deliver swift one-shot justice.
- rate of fire reduced to 150 (prev. 200)
- damage drop at greater ranges changed to 3 (prev. 4)
- increased spread

In order to improve class balance, we will be increasing the sniper rifle sway caused by jumping while in the aiming mode. This change will impact all sniper rifles and their versions with 120ms zoom speed and higher (XM8 Sharpshooter, Calico M951S, Barrett M98B, McMillan CS5, SIG 550, SVU-AS, M16 SPR Custom, AX308, QBU-88, Steyr Scout, Remington MSR). Their actual speed remains the same. This change is meant to enhance the concept of the class. Acrobatics and sharp movement are more suited to classes fighting in close quarters combat. For example, Medics and Engineers often have to depend on it to survive a gunfight. In regards to Snipers, their archetype suggests  more subtle gameplay and long-range attacks.			Improved animations for Saiga 12-S

OTHER CHANGES

Disabled particles appearing on the ground during walking or landing after a jump. These particles will remain when falling into water.
Added two new contracts to replace the ones removed previously:

- eliminate 15 enemies with headshots in “Free for All”, “Bag and Tag” or “Battle Royale”
- eliminate 20 enemies with slide kills

Game client: disabled the global operation K.I.W.I. button

BUG FIXES

PvP: Plant the Bomb, Yard - fixed the error causing one of the walls to be displayed differently based on video settings.
Fixed the problem with screen resolution allowing players to see through specific objects.
Fixed specific achievement positions within the banner.
PvP: Battle Royale, Exclusion Zone - fixed the error causing the fence to disappear due to character position in specific places.

KNOWN ISSUES

Saiga Spike: muzzle flame with the standard flashguard doesn’t reflect upon the nearby objects.
Saiga Spike: shotgun ammo doesn’t refill with Rifleman class ability.

Join the fun!

notes.title: September update is live!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/c577d0a40a9fb2115d2de509c20f9588cc4090c8.png

Soldiers!

We have plenty things to talk about but let’s start from changes to Ranked Matches.

 RANKED MATCHES 

Our vision is to make Ranked Matches closer to competitive scene.

We are happy to introduce a number of changes to the ruleset. They are aimed at improving the tactical gameplay and make this game mode overall more engaging. Apart from that, these changes will also make classes stand out as a part of the team, and grant them an ability to have a greater impact on how the team performs as a whole in its regular interactions.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q5ruarlalKw

Some of these changes have already been subjected to final testing stages to take place during test seasons, while others will be reworked over time.

 Test Season 

During first week of the update, we’re going to test new system for ranked matches. You will be able to earn Warface Dollars, Crowns and Boosters, while finishing the season in any league will award you additionally with a “Lion” mark.

We’ll keep a close eye on the results and feedback, and after we accumulate enough – we will either commence the second Testing Season or switch to the new ruleset altogether. 

Please note that the test season can be interrupted at any time prematurely, and players may have their leagues changed without prior notice.

Progression Changes

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/5adb8c525404358a9c89a006a6425dd134bc0a7a.png

Climbing ranks will become harder but more rewarding if you reach new heights. The more you progress, the steeper will be the way. It’s pretty straight forward – if you lose a match, you won’t lose progress right away, you’ll have a chance to come back by winning a series of games. But if you don’t use this opportunity and keep losing, you get demoted to lower rank.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/842b173eb7eb980d79edc59c7b5c521dbaa16f72.png

Status: final testing. Ranked system settings may change throughout the test seasons depending on how hard it is to progress through the leagues. Player leagues are subject to change during test season without prior notice.

 Equipment Restrictions 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/5337460d4977de64a4bf8396477633f9689adee9.png

In pursuit of making ranked games more competitive, we also have to restrict specific gear that’s prohibited in the official tournaments. As such, items that are eligible in ranked matches are marked in your equipment menu. If you equip restricted items, you will not be able to join the queue for a ranked game.

 Status: postponed until overhaul. We will need some time to fix an error related to the new system and matchmaking. This time will also be used to monitor in-game data and player feedback on restricted gear to ensure a fair and competitive environment.

 Rewards 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/554fb1428204fb5d51739cb9ec7bfe75a122e252.png

Following up on the changes, we will also be increasing the traditional rewards for advancing leagues: crowns, Warface dollars, boosters and so on. Not only that, but we’ll also be adding some new rewards alongside awesome achievements!

The ultimate reward for reaching the first league in a regular season will be special seasonal camos for 5 guns and a knife: MSBS Radon assault rifle, Sidewinder Venom shotgun, PP-2000 PDW, ORSIS T-5000 sniper rifle, M1911A1 pistol and on top of that, a Jagdkommando knife.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/d2ef76f1d845111b9c5ec890c7000c0fb60078ae.png

Apart from that, we will be adding 14 unique achievements, 12 of which can be obtained exclusively for advancing to the first league during a regular season. Each month has its own achievement, so don’t miss a single one or you’ll have to wait until the next year to try again!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/9a49630cf1305504953b17588ff42ecd085b9d5f.png

 Status: pending test season results. We’ll need more information in order to assess the rewards for advancing leagues and completing seasons.

Voice Communication

Note that the voice chat is available for Ranked Matches and Special Operations only. And of course in PvP only your teammates will hear you: your enemies will not intercept your messages.

Please read our dedicated article to learn more.

 CZ 75 CZECHMATE PARROT 

“Parrot” is already in store!

CZ 75 Czechmate Parrot will help you outsmart your opponent five moves ahead in a pistol duel. The “Parrot” is highly efficient at close to medium ranges, and is bound to earn the hearts of those fond of PvP. Its high headshot damage is enough to take down even opponents wearing helmets, while the 1.2x C-More scope and its reticles are quite manageable in close quarters as well.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2I6a7E_1giM

This gun can be found in Random Crown Boxes and Random Kredit Boxes in two variants: regular and golden. Golden CZ 75 Czechmate Parrot has higher damage, rate of fire and magazine capacity values. Drop rates are equal in both boxes.

Please note that Random Crown Boxes can be purchased only by the players that have reached Rank 11.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/43e0f63dbb3c28ee07bcc31bfc61052323bd7055.png

Please read our dedicated article to learn more.

 Sniper Rifles Optimizations 

Following the rebalance of shotguns and SMGs we have reworked 11 sniper rifles: Walther WA 2000, Alpine, AMP DSR-1, Tavor STAR-21 Navy Blue, SVD, M16 SPR Custom, SIG 550, ACR SPR, H&K SL8, XM8 Sharpshooter and AWM. We mainly rebalanced their minimal and maximal damage.

Please read our dedicated article to learn more.

 “Desert Snake” Camo Series 

“Desert Snake” line-up includes camos for assault rifles Beretta ARX160 and IMBEL IA2, machine gun PKP Pecheneg, shotguns MAG-7, Fabarm P.S.S.10 and Fabarm S.A.T. 8 Pro, SMGs CZ Scorpion EVO, Desert Tech MDR‐C, PP-19 Bizon and Tavor CTAR‐21, sniper rifles AX308, Calico M951S and M40A5, pistol CZ 75-Auto, Mateba Autorevolver and Jagdkommando knife.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/a7d91f4bba2a91f75342602c1c51f93ca4f70921.png

Please read our dedicated article to learn more.

 Miscellaneous

 Client-side security optimizations. Details will remain undisclosed for security reasons.
 New countermeasures added against smoke screen / flash grenade abuse within the game client and launcher.
 Battle Royale: Mojave has replaced Exclusion Zone.
 Kriss Super V SMG: stats changed. Reduced the time to enter and exit the aiming mode, increased damage to legs and arms, reduced the rate of fire.
 Improved visuals for some of the golden weapons in the game.
 Custom rooms: added the observer feature to the interface. Observers do not count as valid players in rooms and active matches.
 Thematic variants of “Vault”, “Hangar” and “Oil Depot” have been replaced with the basic ones. Check them out next year!
 Vote changes: cannot initiate a voting session against players that are in your friend list.
 Added secret achievements.
 Ranked matches rewards: weapon skins for semi-automatic sniper rifles in Warface Random Boxes have been replaced with other weapon skins.
 NVidia Apex Settings have been removed from the game client.
 Warface Box icon containing resurrection coins has been changed.

Bug Fixes

 All SVU-AS sniper rifle variants: fixed animations for particles emitted when fired.
 AK-47 and its golden variant: fixed hand position in first-person view.
 Kriss super V and all M14 Crazy Horse variants: fixed hand position in third-person view.
 Remington 870 RAS: fixed attachment positions.
 M16 SPR Custom and its camo variant: fixed melee attack (shove) animation in close quarters.
 Micro-Roni CAA Warface Random Box: localization error fixed.
 Fixed an animation error occuring due to sharp character rotation (90> degrees) in spectator mode after death.
 Fixed a series of errors related to co-op interactions.
 Fixed the error related to bomb / weapon interactions (when both are in vicinity).
 Fixed the error related to primary weapon selection.
 Fixed the error causing firing animation to interrupt reload animations.
 All FN F2000 variants: fixed hand position in first-person view.
 Fixed the error causing interference with PvE mission launches.
 Fixed textures for “Exclusion Zone”, “Residence”, “Keep”, “Lighthouse”.
 Fixed textures for several PvE missions.
 Fixed spawn points in several PvE missions.
 Fixed textures and object positions in Special Operation: Pripyat.
 Fixed the weapon scrolling error.
 Fixed room chat errors.
 Fixed incorrect positions following a smoke grenade deployment on “Deposit” (map).
 Fixed visual artifacts in first-person view when using Kriss super V with specific attachments.
 “Yard” and “Trailer Park” (maps): fixed positions granting unfair superiority.
 Fixed AI behaviour when using grenades in PvE missions and special operations.
 Fixed the golden SIG Sauer P226 attachment icon.
 Fixed the reticle for SIG Sauer P226 (regular & golden).
 Fixed issues with long item names in general interface.
 Fixed the bug with disappearing enemy units in several PvE missions.
 Gepard GM6 rifle: default attachment changed from standard 5.5-zoom scope to Schmidt & Bendet v2 4.6-zoom scope.
 Walther P99: melee attack (shove) animation has been resynced with the actual hit.
 Fixed the AK-47 “Flor de Muerto” icon.
 Fixed the error causing PvE missions to disappear from the list.
 Cobray Striker, Fabarm P.S.S.10, AS “Val” and MSBS Radon: repair costs fixed.
 Exclusion Zone: fixed achievement localization errors for the 1st and 3rd places.
 Brain Scorcher achievement: localization fixed.
 Fixed the error causing the contracts to display incorrectly.
 “Palace” (map): fixed the area designation tooltip.
 Game client: game sessions required for in-game events and promos no longer disappear.
 Changing classes in a custom room when the option’s disabled no longer brings up an incorrect tooltip.
 FN Five-seveN “Punisher”: added correct information about additional damage values to cyborgs.


Known Bugs 

 Voice communication: PUSH-TO-TALK settings may sometimes change to VOICE ACTIVATION until the end of the match.
PvP: "Bag and Tag": can't invite friends to this mode.


Disclaimer: some information provided in this article refers to the work in progress and is subject to change.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Soon in game: Ranked Games update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/f7f7e96c8af945b55a9fba273f5c7a0985e962ed.jpg

Dear friends!

Many players love Ranked Games and enthusiastically take part in the competition. In the nearest update we are planning to improve this mode. The main concept lies in keeping the mode foundations intact, while adding more tactical variety, making it more entertaining and taking it closer to the format of official Warface Open Cup tournaments.

In the future the participants of Ranked Games can expect new rewards: unique achievements and camos. We would like the first league entry to be an even more important occasion and the players reaching it - to stand our proud with commemorative stripes and prizes! New rewards will not be added to the game immediately - they will be thoroughly tested first.

Disclaimer: the information provided in this article refers to the work in progress and is subject to change.

About the changes

The coming update will introduce the changes in a range of mechanics utilized in Ranked Games. The competition rules will be slightly amended and the UI will be improved. In the future we plan to increase the rewards for reaching leagues in Ranked Games. 

Changes in mechanics

The underlying principle remains the same: you need to press onward to the first league and if you suffer defeat in a series of matches – you will be pushed one league back.

Fighting your way in each league, you need to grasp several victories instead of one. The higher the league, the more determination you will need to showcase. At the same time, if you have been struck down, you will not lose your progress immediately: you will have a chance to retaliate by winning a series of matches. If you don’t make good use of this opportunity and continue scoring low, you will find yourself in the previous league.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/73c71edf8c7b0e1619dcaadaee565165880d8e36.jpg

Bonus activated for the victory streak will be working in a slightly different way than before: if you have achieved three consecutive victories in the last matches of the previous league, then in the new league one victory will be automatically granted to you. You can see an example below.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/8d540e920c7cb6212c47d3b41ec058743e83511a.jpg

New rewards

The list of rewards for reaching the new leagues has been amended. New achievements for the successes in Ranked Games will appear. Conquering the first league will be awarded with special boxes with new camos as well as plenty of rare stripes. Each season the rewards for reaching the first league will be changed – and this way, they will be truly unique!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/73ab404b9a15faac644a042bc32e5e7d2e67373e.jpg

The other achievements for taking part in ranked games will also be saved.

We will tell you when the awards appear in-game through our future articles.

Please note that the appearance, description and conditions for receiving these rewards can be changed.

Restricted weapons and gear

To equalize the chances of the players and to make the battles more coordinated and tactical, it has been decided to impose restrictions on certain weapons and equipment. When creating the list we used the guidelines described ibn the regulations of Warface Open Cup tournaments. The restrictions will help players to organize regular training sessions in Ranked Games and get used quicker to the eSports dimension of the game. It is quite possible that for many the renewed Ranked Games will be the first step towards pro eSports.

It is prohibited to use the following items:
Any automatic or semi-automatic sniper rifles
Seasonal items with characteristics that are different from the original ones
Festive weapons
Anti-personnel and seasonal mines
Frag grenades except for standard ones
Any equipment protecting from the first shot
Gear that replenishes HP and AP
“Absolute” gloves and vest

Items allowed at Ranked Games will be marked with a special symbol https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/f8d1df20c4e1f66c235eea58107c70130b547b69.jpg.

If you equip prohibited items, you won’t be able to start the match in Ranked Games. 

Recently we told you about another change to Ranked Matches - voice chat. You can learn more about this feature from  this article.

Disclaimer: the information provided in this article refers to the work in progress and is subject to change.

We hope that the veterans of this mode will appreciate the changes. The renewed season of Ranked Games will come out with the new update and will enter its test phase. Then, according to the test results, we will look into the possibility of increasing rewards and introducing unique achievements and camos that you could see in this article. So stay tuned.

Good hunting, soldiers!

notes.title: Marketplace Update #2
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/c31d99bc238f56bc56f28953eceb7450632d2743.jpg

Dear players!

We know that marketplace is one of the hottest community topics nowadays, so we decided to implement a different approach this time and, if we can’t give you this feature, at least provide you with a detailed description of how it goes with it and address the most important questions arising in the community.

First thing we wanted to say is, we are aiming to open the marketplace for my.com players after August, 23rd.

Secondly, we have thoroughly studied your feedback and we are ready to comment on the most commonly aroused questions regarding the marketplace.

	Q: Why did you decide to open the Marketplace for My.Com players, when there are so many Steam players, maybe even more than My.Com users?

A: The point is, we didn’t “choose the side”. We were choosing between helping a vast part of our players and helping no one. We opted for the first. Currently, we are working on a solution that will suit all players in Warface.

	Q: You separated players according to the type of their account and gave them different priviliges. It’s unfair.

A: We equally respect all our players. The problem lies not in Steam itself, but in the fraud that is possible there. We are grateful to those who support our game with money, so that we could support the servers, enhance our development and promote Warface all over the world. Whenever fraud occurs, it significantly impedes the development process, that is why we cannot risk the fraud.

	Q: Why does community have to suffer because of issues between My.Com and Steam?

A: We do not have any issues between us and Steam, it’s rather that we don’t have enough experience in fighting the fraud in Steam. And that is why we are grateful to every single piece of advice you give us on that, as well as to those who inform players about the situation (ty, seanwlk!)

	Q: You can’t convert a Steam account back, so now your access to the Marketplace depends on sheer luck, whether you converted it to Steam or not.

A: We are currently doing everything we can to eliminate this inconsistency, as we want each an every our player to enjoy our game on the same level and have access to all the privileges. Unfortunately, convertions back from Steam account into my.com account contradict the policy of Steam games: we are just not allowed to do that.

	Q: Why can you still buy Kredits in Steam? What’s the difference?

A: The overall damage is different. If someone just buys a load of Kredits from a stolen account and even buys some guns for that, we can just block the account and roll everything back. However, with the access to marketplace violators can distribute these weapons to many other accounts, which makes them way more difficult to trace. Besides, innocent players can suffer while using Kredits or items obtained from the violator without even knowing they obtain it from a violator.

So, these were the main issues we found in various marketplace topics. If you have any ideas on how we can fight fraud in Steam and make marketplace available again, you are welcome to leave them here. Next week we are planning to give you feedback on your suggestions about it.

We thank you once again for your understanding and patience and apologize for not providing you with the service on the expected level.

All the best,

Warface Team

notes.title: Next update bringing: CZ 75 Czechmate Parrot
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/a50db60f73360d8a71ecb2c6e378e42799384b75.png

Atten-hut!

The next game update will be bringing a new sidearm: CZ 75 Czechmate Parrot. Designed by a renowned small firearms manufacturer Ceska Zbrojovka, this pistol is a modified variant belonging to the CZ 75 line-up. As one can figure by the name, this gun stands out owing to its fancy look resembling parrot feather pattern.

Inspiration

Ceska Zbrojovka, a Czech manufacturer has earned its reputation in the small arms industry ever since the 20th century. Two of its other engineering marvels are already present in the game: CZ 75 Auto and CZ Scorpion Evo3 A1.

CZ 75 TS Czechmate is a 9mm modified CZ 75, featuring a unique internal configuration. These newer pistols can be outfitted with barrel attachments, either a 4-piece compensator (which helps reduce recoil and increase rate of fire), or a ‘cap’ with an interchangeable sight. Accuracy is enhanced thanks to the C-More scope fixed atop the Picatinny rail.

Among its key strengths are the hand-polished barrel and shutter parts that are also hand-fitted to the frame. This helps minimize the risks of having loose parts, boosting the already accurate gun.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/eaf36d126b7b7e4bd0a3f25574c904755f145e3d.jpg

Seeing as the basic Czechmate had a success, the company went onward to produce the newer variant — Parrot — for recreational shooting, and thus the gun fits most International Practical Shooting Confederation’s regulations as well. Its trigger and magazine are colored bright red, ejection port guard is green, palm grip — anodized yellow, and slide control — purple. To add, the rail for its C-More secope has a blueish finish. “Parrot” has also been outfitted with a new configuration for its striking hammer and trigger.

Recreational and professional shooters have been drawn to this sidearm and Parrot’s become a much-desired collector’s prize, given that no more than 10 pistols are produced yearly.

In Warface

CZ 75 Czechmate Parrot will help you outsmart your opponent five moves ahead in a pistol duel. The “Parrot” is highly efficient at close to medium ranges, and is bound to earn the hearts of those fond of PvP. Its high headshot damage is enough to take down even opponents wearing helmets, and the 1.2x C-More scope and its reticles are quite manageable in close quarters as well.

This gun can be found in Random Kredit Boxes in two variants: regular and golden. Golden CZ 75 Czechmate Parrot has higher damage, rate of fire and magazine capacity values.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/43e0f63dbb3c28ee07bcc31bfc61052323bd7055.png

PLATINUM SKIN

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/5528ff2fc2bba7d71eefc41422fb734ddfc015aa.jpg

This isn’t all yet! First things first, we wanted to create something truly outstanding, and thus for the first time ever, we’re rolling out the platinum skin for the golden version of the gun. The stats won’t differ from the golden one (as it's a skin), but if you’ve got your hands on this you can be sure you’re in possession of an absolute rare prize.

And yes - if you happen to roll out the skin, it always comes along with the golden version of the gun.

CROWN BOXES

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/b191ca76afa1822e8c61533b5b0371bd9db3fb41.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/4089da4795355f37495d28f1e9d7b17ac0efd6c2.png

Apart from that, we’re going to try something new: CZ 75 Czechmate Parrot and its golden variant will be available in Crown Boxes as well!

ACHIEVEMENTS

Landing killing blows with this gun will earn you memorable achievements with custom marks, badges and stripes.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/f5b44f1153359b634f66c3452797bfe8ff43eeab.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/1c538c4269602502e043de6edbf7ef917a0dd990.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/9fa8ace2cc6480660ec2330c933c321f7a286acc.png

notes.title: Battle Royale 2.0 Update - now in game!
notes.notes:
New and epic Battle Royale, maps, guns and achievements

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/26fda303b9f5c6dec465a4ebbcec441a0cb90fe3.jpg

Soldiers!

This update will address maps, weapons and various optimizations aimed at the competitive level, alongside the much-anticipated reworked Battle Royale game mode.

Battle Royale 2.0

The new map, named Exclusion Zone will be available in this update. It captures the niche atmosphere of grim to the bone, apocalyptic Pripyat. The new map is designed to enhance and diversify the gameplay featured in the current active BR map, “Mojave”. You’ll be able to explore numerous new objects and hideouts as well as experience brand new weapons yet unseen in other game modes.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/6e46627fbcc813072b3615032a2cfae34cc147da.png

To know more about the map, achievements and story behind the game – visit our Exclusion Zone announcement !

Weapons

Micro Roni CAA

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/29d87af8ca8eb7aec39760d2081e1aa690f792b9.jpg

The new Micro RONI CAA personal defense weapon is the perfect pick for any game mode thanks to its considerably high damage, soft recoil and a 40-round mag capacity. Its stability yields some impressive results when fired ‘from the hip’. The golden variant will feature the highest ‘hip-fire’ accuracy values in the game as well as an extended magazine.

The PDW comes with several attachment slots and three unique upgrades:

Micro RONI CAA Laser Grip -- provides a considerable boost to ‘hip-fire’ accuracy, slightly reduces recoil and crosshair sway
Micro RONI CAA Custom Grip -- provides a slight boost to ‘hip-fire’ accuracy, reduces recoil and crosshair sway
Hartman MH1 -- 1.4x Fast-Zoom scope.

Micro RONI CAA can be found in Random Kredit Boxes, and landing killing blows with it will award
custom achievements that can be pinned on your profile!



QSZ-92

Random Warface Boxes for QSZ-92 have been added to the game. You can purchase them for 600/580/560/540/520 WF$.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/733fe70fe00443a8661c7aa2ce0acf3973b9be5d.png

 “Tigerstripe” series weapon skins

Factory 2.0

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/a3dd52ef58fa0b7c40356979c199a8840f3222b8.png

Improved maps for Ranked Matches

Positioning issues causing players to get stuck
Abuse of vulnerable ‘areas’ and ‘positions’ on the map
“Teleports” or blinks
Animation problems with sliding in case of collision with other objects

notes.title: Marketplace update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/c31d99bc238f56bc56f28953eceb7450632d2743.jpg

Dear players!

We are aware of how important Marketplace feature is for plenty of you. As you recall, the marketplace system abuse by some users has forced us to shut it down, which we did with a heavy heart. Many of you have been wondering what is the current status of marketplace issue, and when it will open its doors again.

We are happy to announce that marketplace will be open soon for my.com registered users, those who have registered on our official website and use our official launcher.

However, marketplace will still not open yet for our Steam users, while we are working on anti-fraud solutions. It’s this fraud that we want to talk about today.

A lot of our players come from Steam, where you link your card to your account to purchase games and in-game items or currency. However, we have unfortunately uncovered quite a few cases of players using fraudulent (not-working/overdue/stolen) cards and thus abusing the marketplace system, which caused us to take action. Most of the processes are on Steam’s side, which prevents us from impacting them directly and results in the marketplace still being closed for Steam users.

To both my.com and Steam users - please note that we will return all the items you put up for sale on the marketplace before we closed it.

We bring our sincere apologies and will continue working in order to provide equal game experience for all our community. Thank you for your understanding and your patience.


With all the respect,
Warface Team

notes.title: July Update - now live
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/211491fea77f3d777146b9b95a8443318f915817.png

Soldiers!

The latest update has just gone live. Get in game to check out the new butterfly knife, legendary Rifleman weapon: VHS-2, and read up on the changes we’re bringing to the disciplinary system!

BUTTERFLY KNIFE

https://media.giphy.com/media/1zlCNVsOgZUinXCgZl/giphy.gif

As eccentric as it is deadly, this unorthodox weapon will make a fine trophy in any elite collection thanks to its eye-catching animations and skins. The Butterfly passes all the tests of your average melee weapon with flying colors, and its power attack (RMB) will be enough to take down even a heavily armored foe. Not even a “Corundum” vest’s stopping that!

Its golden variant brings even more to the table: increased damage for quick attacks (LMB) is a sure pick for anyone that finds themselves going melee often.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/d80c27017fe23a49cff270dbf2adcde95ecb4b15.png

The Butterfly knife and all of its 8 custom skins can be looted from Random Kredit Boxes. Drop rates for the regular and golden variant are equal to any other Random Kredit Box weapons in the game.

Flick the blade open and earn custom achievement stripes for combat eliminations!

VHS-2

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/db9af28a2ba44950a2e6192e32bdd9ba63426ade.png

VHS-2 is the second legendary-tier Rifleman Arsenal weapon to be added to the game, and can now be unlocked once you obtain enough Arsenal Points. Among its distinctive features are four attachments unique to this very rifle!

Built-in Custom 3x Zoom scope; can be replaced with any other unlocked attachments.
VHS-2 Flash Guard, reduces muzzle break and damage drop at greater distances, improves penetration.
VHS-2 Underbarrel Grenade Launcher, improves breaching capabilities, reduces accuracy and increases recoil.
VHS-2 Custom Grip, improves accuracy and reduces recoil (except when firing prone).


The VHS-2 assault rifle has superb specs and handles similarly to M16A3 Custom. Earn custom achievements for combat eliminations with this rifle!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/45d4ca3da6dd2494b1c0382ed17b2e0922f40537.jpg

NEW DISCIPLINARY ACTIONS

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/68198ca918549112ac5a86e098db22962320adf0.png

We are introducing a new disciplinary action system for players abandoning matches early in Quickplay. This system will follow an escalating pattern: the punishment will be based on the player’s past history of leaving matches.

If a player attempts to leave a match, they will be presented with a warning about a potential disciplinary action. If this warning is ignored and the player quits, they will be unable to start a new Quickplay match for 1 minute, and will enter a 3-day probation period.

If a player leaves once again while on their probation period, they’ll be unable to queue for another match for 3 minutes, then 5 minutes and so on, consecutively to a total of 30 minutes. Meanwhile, the probation period will be restarted after each violation, and can be reset only if no matches are abandoned while on probation.

This system will be active for most PvP game modes in Quickplay, excluding “Free for All”, “Bag and Tag” and “Battle Royale”. These matches can be abandoned without consequences at any point. Please note that this system will not be active in Custom Rooms and Clan Wars. Punishments for Ranked Matches will remain unchanged.

If you’re experiencing any issues with queue suspension timers, please make sure your PC time and date settings are correct.

GLOBAL OPERATION: K.I.W.I.

New global operations items have been added to the game:

Kriss Super V Custom
K.I.W.I. weapons
K.I.W.I. skins
K.I.W.I. armor
“Tigerstripe” skins


OTHER CHANGES

“Battle Royale” game mode has been temporarily disabled while we work on improving it as planned. You can find out more about the changes from our article on Battle Royale 2.0!
Drastically reduced repair costs for all secondary and melee weapons, excluding the basic tier weapons (like Beretta M9 or the Ultramarine knife).
Flash Grenade M4: improved the visuals (textures and animations) to make it look even… flashier. Hope you like the new looks: the mechanics will remain unchanged. We have changed the icon though.
Capture: Vault has been replaced with its more festive sibling, Brazilian Vault! Both versions are available in Custom Rooms and Clan Wars.
Removed several CO-OP contracts related to melee and secondary weapon eliminations and headshot eliminations. It became apparent that these contracts had affected the teamplay in a negative fashion, often leading to an undeserved loss.
Certain weapons and gear are now unavailable in the in-game shop for characters that have not yet reached the rank of 11 (combat gear, “Crown” gear and primary weapon Random Boxes).
Extended the duration of various weapons awarded for reaching a new rank. Characters ranking 1 to 8 will receive their rewards for 30 days, and rank 11-59 rewards will vary from 7 to 30 days.
FN FAL DSA-58 assault rifle: moderately boosted the recoil reduction effects from the DSA-58 Custom Tactical Grip. This same effect has been also moderately reduced for other Arsenal grips.
D17 (map): added surface for easier access and entry to the side pathway to the second plant site.

BUG FIXES

Fixed a bug causing loading screen freezes when entering a match.
Fixed a bug causing a player to get stuck after helping a team climbing.
Fixed incorrect leg animation on other players when joining a match.
Fixed a texture bug with incorrect smoke screen if waterfalls and other liquids were in line of sight.
Fixed issues with AI units getting stuck in several PvE missions.
Fixed incorrect C4 plant indicators in several PvE missions.
Plant the Bomb: fixed a bug that caused the bomb to be stuck with the player if the said player was knocked down on top of it.
Blitz: fixed a bug that caused the round not to end if no opposition was present.
Bridges 2.0, D17, Yard 2.0 and District (maps): fixed several objects. These changes are aimed to fix grenade issues (that previously caused them to ricochet off invisible textures back at the original player).
Destination (map): fixed visual artifacts following the C4 explosion.
Hawkrock (map): fixed view distance for specific objects based on distance to player.
Yard 2.0 (map): fixed a bug that enabled the player to shoot through the entire map
Yard 2.0 (map): fixed several objects that were previously impassable.
Yard 2.0 (map): fixed player positions on the final rewards screen.
Bridges 2.0 (map): fixed a bug that allowed the player to gain access to an unintended vantage point.
Special Operation: Blackout; fixed view distance settings for several objects.
Special Operation: Black Shark; fixed a bug that caused the players to fall through the helicopter.
Special Operation: Black Shark; several enemy units have been empowered to behave more aggressively when player is behind cover.
Shotguns: fixed the animation bug (getting stuck in tactical reloading (shell by shell)).
CheyTac M200: synchronized reloading and shell ejection animations.
Anakon: the crosshair is now displayed correctly when sprinting.
“Absolute” Black Hawk: combat eliminations are now correctly scored for the “Crazed Axeman” achievement.
Fabarm P.S.S. 10, M249 Para and its golden variant: fixed flicker animations when fired.
Fostech Origin-12 and its golden variant: character hands and weapon model textures no longer behave incorrectly when viewed in third person.
EOTECH 553 Scope (regular and enhanced): left hand no longer goes through the scope during animations.
Fixed tooltip for Icebreaker M16A3 and one of the contracts.
S&W M&P R8 and its golden variant: fixed Leupold DeltaPoint scope position.
Light Sniper Scope (5x): reticles are now thinner.
Fixed a bug causing the player to get stuck, unable to move, shoot or modify weapons until the end of the round.
Fixed a bug forcing the player off the map with a melee weapon hit.


Happy hunting!

notes.title: Changes in the refer-a-friend program
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/acc3e77a5f9fdb28139d91b40732748e9eb740f8.jpg

Soldiers!

Referring your friends via the ‘Refer-a-friend’ program now provides even better rewards both for the referrer and the invited person. Granted, the structure of the objectives has been altered. See for yourself!

REFER-A-FRIEND PAGE

For those of you who are not yet acquainted with the program – here is why referring others and adventuring together can be valuable.

How does it work?

As a referring player, you need to be at least Rank 20 in the game, and you can refer up to 10 players. 

You may generate a link either via Facebook, Twitter or Google. Alternatively, you can copy the direct link in the special window. Send the link to your friend, and they will be able to register their account. For Steam users, make sure your friend registers via Steam if they’re installing the game via Steam as well.

To pass all the conditions and receive the final reward, three referred friends need to complete all the objectives. Some objectives need to be completed by the referred friends, while the others should be done together by a friend and a referrer. The objectives are accessible to all referred friends and can be completed simultaneously.

The objective is registered when a referred friend completes it. After that the referrer can claim the reward. All the rewards appear in "My Items" section of the website. The achievement is immediately added to the account.

You can delete referred friends from the list only 7 days after adding them.

Progress

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/e6a5d27d2ab7c78d77be85e8317671bf4943a28e.png

The very page you use to invite your friends allows you to track your progress and that of your friends. There’s a wide variety of objectives you need to complete, ranging from those your friends have to complete themselves, all the way to the ones you have to complete together.

Each friend will have a mini-profile that you can expand to show their progress, and most importantly – how far away they are from getting you and themselves the rewards.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/9fdcd88c1f8226a7f8c3d445f17a478efcc0144f.jpg

Rewards

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/2c75ebc687c241c47cfe61a236870706af7d90bf.png

The program provides plenty of rewards but the ultimate royal price is Golden AY 226. There’s absolutely no other way to get it at this time than through ‘Refer-a-friend’! Needless to say, with this pistol you’ll be able to unlock astonishing achievements to pin on your profile.

notes.title: An update on the smoke bug fixes
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/bf63dd6063451e91a964ba0d9479c92823011a13.jpg

Dear players!

Today we are going to address the smoke bug - one of the issues of great importance for the community. As you may know, we’ve identified that the ability to see through smoke comes from Nvidia’s Inspector utility.

Over the course of past several months, we’ve been trying to tackle this issue. It’s necessary to note that this bug is hard to fix, since it involves the third-party software. Our developers at Crytek have been working in collaboration with Nvidia to figure out a solution to this problem. Despite their joint efforts, most of the fixes we’ve been able to achieve are temporary, so we will keep working on a permanent solution.

Disciplinary sanctions against bug abusers 

Following the rising complaints within the community we’ve decided that the current penalties for abusing the bug involving Nvidia Inspector are not sufficient enough. It’s discouraging to see that some players opt in for such an exploit to get a meaningless victory, and we’re forced to introduce stricter disciplinary punishments as a result.

After May the 10th, we’ll be raising the account suspensions for abusing the Nvidia Inspector vulnerability to 30 days and higher.

It’s worth noting that reporting Nvidia Inspector abuse via a Support Centre request (in “Code of Conduct Violations” reports) is far more efficient than a simple in-game report. We encourage you to record the gameplay via the built-in My.Com Launcher recording software (you can set it to enable via a hotkey combination).

Before contacting the support please evaluate the situation once again. The fact of shooting down an opponent through smoke is in itself no proof of a bug abuse. The shots can be random and that also goes for headshots. Moreover, the smoke is not designed to be completely non-transparent and in certain situations, like with muzzle blasts, you can partially see through it. Using guns without a silencer reveals your position on the radar and the experienced players can foresee the movements of the foes and shoot at positions most likely occupied by their opponents. For example, a smoke has been used around a fallen soldier. In several seconds a medic is most certain to dive in to approach the target and start reviving. Thus you know that by shooting at the location around the treated soldier – you will probably take down the medic. The lower is the percentage of false reports, the faster the real bug abusers will be identified and punished. 

We assure you that we are sincerely concerned about this specific bug and its impact on your experience. Unfortunately, this problem is so complex that even with full cooperation from Nvidia’s engineers we’ve been unable to find a direct permanent solution as of yet.

We thank you for your support and for you abiding by the rules. We will not stop until the bug issue is fixed. 

Support Centre report specifics
First, a bot with a certain algorithm processes the report.
The date of report should not exceed 72h after the violation was witnessed.
 You should put only ONE correct username (not a clan name) in the “Offender nickname” field. If you want to report several cases of violation, please make separate tickets. 
If you’ve chosen “Griefing” the bot scans the ticket for .mp4 file or a link (starting with http/https). For this category you can upload an unlisted Youtube video.
If you’ve submitted the ticket correctly it’ll be proceeded. Please, take notice that the bot was created in order to speed up the process of investigation.

Soldiers!

April update has finally arrived! New TDM map “Phantom Zone”, new weapons, rebalanced old weapons and bug fixes - everything you have been waiting for.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KvedCHn3fiA

WEAPONS

M48 Bowie Knife

A new addition to the legendary tier – Bowie knife, a national legend and a legacy bearer in the USA. Warface will feature its M48 variation produced by United Cutlery.

The damage and speed of its quick attack (LMB) are comparable with the ones delivered with an axe or a katana, whereas the damage of the heavy attack (RMB) is enough to kill players wearing Corundum vest with one strike.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/a3b00d97cce7d299d08a68f3bb3ebc2c47984ad0.jpg

Don’t forget about the achievements! For killing 10 000 and 25 000 enemies with this knife you will receive “Knife fight” and “Remember Alamo” stripes respectively!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/2f88f2ab84c766d3a5e7eec41d29435e585f6454.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/e5b64bc906b11e23bce170c85e4136334c6493b4.png

M48 Bowie knife is an arsenal weapon, and it is unlocked through arsenal points you receive by playing the game. The players that have just started unlocking the legendary tier have a higher chance of unlocking the knife first. That is, new players will not need a lot of arsenal points and time to get the knife unlocked.

Learn more

Remington MSR

Remington MSR, or Modular Sniper Rifle, is the next high-caliber weapon to appear in the game. It will be added to the game a little bit later. Follow the news to learn more!

Learn more

SMG-9 Ares

Increased damage (up to 63), range (up to 8.5 meters) and head multiplier, as well as the zoom-in time. The changes affect all versions of this weapon.

	Shotgun rebalance

We have rebalanced the damage, range and recoil of a wide range of some of your favourite guns. Here is a table of full changes.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/95ca4de528dd473d5d4bef501500d8b84264c59a.png

New map "Phantom Zone"

A new Team Deathmatch map is finally here, the “Phantom Zone”. Warface will clash with Blackwood in Pripyat, one of the most atmospheric ghost towns in the world, the one you can also see in the corresponding Special Operation. Anyone leaving the battlefield will inevitably die of radiation poisoning!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/7d129ddd0e6c96fa5522c111d72d0dc38ef7834b.png

Mikhail Khaimzon, the creative director of Crytek, has much to say about the new map. Watch the video diaries to learn more!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uqH57aTSAgg

SMOKE AND FLASHBANG VISION FIXED

It is no longer possible to see through the smoke and ignore the flashbang effect.

OTHER CHANGES
			Arsenal progression has become smoother. The overall number of arsenal points needed has been decreased by approx. 20%. Please note that we have recounted your VP progress according to the new system. The percentage of the progress remained the same: that is, if you made 50% progress towards the item you want to unlock, you will have exactly the same percentage after the recount, even though the VP number will be different.			Knockback grenades. Knockback grenades have been removed from the shop, including side drops from the random boxes. This does not affect the grenades that players currently have in their warehouses.			Repair cost of the following weapons has been decreased: AC7, R60E4, RST-14, Anatolia RK-102 (regular and "Atlas"), SX-41 (regular and "Anubis"), MT-19, TT‐3000 (regular, "Anubis" and "Radiance"), AP-84 Custom "Atlas", Q-88, B-5000 (regular and "Anubis").			The following melee weapon skins have been reworked: Ultra Marine knife ("Urban", "Desert" and "Wilderness"), Utility knife ("Urban", "Desert" and "Wilderness"), Katana ("Mk.60 Mod" и "Special Forces"). Now the camo also covers the blade.			Firing visuals while using the following weapons have been improved: Python, High Power Pistol, M9A1 and MD9.			PvP, Premades: specific game modes now have different restrictions regarding the number of players in premade parties that can join the game: Battle Royale – no more than 1, Free for All – no more than 5, other modes – no more than 3.			Now after certain actions (e.g. planting the bomb or jumping over an obstacle) players have a quicker weapon animation that allows shooting earlier than before. This change only concerns the guns with a special animation.		BUG FIXES			PvP, Ranked matches: some cases of players not retaining their KDA after the reconnection have been fixed.			PvP: "Storm": "Wharf": it is no longer possible to get stuck in certain places.			PvP: "Storm": "Wharf ": thrown grenades no longer get stuck between the cables in the upper part of the fence.			PvP: "Storm ": "Wharf ": it is no longer possible to get to a position that gives unintended advantage in the match.			PvP: "Plant the Bomb": "Destination": objects destroyed by the blast now reset in the beginning of the next round.			PvP: "Destruction": "Towers": it is no longer possible to get to a position that gives unintended advantage in the match.			PvP: "Bag and Tag": "Coliseum": some visual artifacts have been fixed.			PvP, Chat: chat now opens automatically upon entering the game room.			Special Operation “Pripyat”: it is no longer possible to spawn inside of an object and get stuck in it.			Special Operation “Pripyat”: enemies no longer spawn out of the wall.			Special Operation “Anubis”: it is no longer possible to kill the enemies through the wall.			"Russian Punisher" achievement: now kills from Viper Halloween Skin, as well as SMG-19 Wisent Halloween and Evil Santa Skins count correctly towards the achievement.			“Harvester of Pain" achievement: now kills from gold CCR CQB count correctly towards the achievement.			Smoke grenades: the pin no longer interferes with the character’s fingers.			Female Nanosuits: animation of armor repair in prone position is now displayed correctly.			Basic Scope (x5.5 Zoom): the crosshair is no longer that big.			Sniper Scope (x4.5 Zoom): visual artifacts while zooming have been fixed.			M217 (all versions): reload animation has been fixed.			Python: zoom-in without attachments has been fixed.			Interface: “Full screen” option in graphics settings has been fixed.			Animation: there is now no animation delay after you get knocked down.			Animation: team climbing with a mine in hands is now visually correct.			Fireworks grenade: item icon in shop and inventory has been fixed.

KNOWN ISSUES
