notes.title: GAME UPDATE - 06.06.2017
notes.notes:
https://wf.my.com/ms/cafdb8dbe5251c3d5cc24ffde4dfa7df.jpg

Soldiers!

The new update is already on the way: weapons, increased maximum rank, technical improvements and more – see them in the game!

NEW RANK

We are introducing a new maximum rank – the “Maori warrior”, Captain of the Heralds of Death squadron. The indigenous warriors of New Zealand, the Maori have always been renowned for their unyielding morale and absolute ruthlessness in combat. Every true Maori wears a so-called “moko” – a unique tattoo that reflects the whole history of his ancestors. The memory of their ancestors’ deeds helps them crush anyone standing in front of them, and that is why they are second to none when it comes to leadership in battle.

POSITIONING SYSTEM REWORK

The positioning system has been improved in order to pinpoint the player’s exact location. It will help decrease the number of character’s incorrect movements: “bottleneck” interactions and “blinktz/teleports”.

Please note that this system will be enabled only in 1% of the game rooms for testing purposes. Later on we are planning to enable it in all game rooms.

WEAPONS

WAI GRAY RG-15

Good news for Riflemen! Soon you will be finally able to get your hands on the WAI GRAY RG-15 Assault Rifle. High damage and great rate of fire make it an ultimate weapon in the hands of an experienced soldier. You will definitely have your work cut out trying to obtain WAI GRAY RG-15 – but it’s well worth it. It may cost you up to 500000 Arsenal Points to unlock this Assault Rifle depending on legendary weapons unlock order. As you know the first legendary weapon will cost you 300000 points, the second – 450000 and the last, currently the third – 500000, so if you are given WAI GRAY RG-15 to unlock before PEG H.G.C. Custom and WT308 – you will need 300000 points only!

Special mention should be made of weapon customization that includes a unique barrel extension, a flash guard that improves accuracy, reduces bullet spread and adds special shooting animation.

WX METASOMA EVO3 A1

Another new addition – the WX Metasoma Evo3 SMG – will not leave a single Engineer unimpressed. Its astonishing damage and consistently great performance empowers you, while the Golden variant draws all the envious side-glances. Both regular and golden versions of this SMG will be available in Random Kredit Boxes.

Besides, you can also obtain a Smuggler's card to get the gun for a fixed price. Learm more about the weapon and the new Random box here!

It’s vital to note that the WX METASOMA EVO3 A1 Random box reward system has been changed:

You are still able to get the main rewards – the actual weapons – the same way as before;
Due to the addition of the Smuggler’s card you are less likely to receive such items as knives, grenades and so on;
The HEX Auto revolver has been replaced with the Shark-443 pistol;
Blue Smoke Grenades have been replaced with Yellow Smoke grenades;
Utility knife “City” has been replaced the Survival Tanto knife;
The Knockback Grenade has been removed from the random box;
The custom character skin remains as one of the possible rewards.


OTHER WEAPON CHANGES


PDW 19’s rate of fire increased (up to 900), recoil pattern reworked and recoil itself changed to parametric;
PDW 19’s “Winter” camo rate of fire and damage have been increased (up to 920 and 64 respectively), parametric recoil is added, the recoil pattern has been changed;
RBA SR58 SPR minimal spread and rate of fire have been increased (the latter up to 62), maximum hip fire spread decreased;
Elite weapons (obtained for Crowns) damage against cyborgs has been increased by 50%;
Executor’s hit animation has been changed.


MISCELLANEOUS

Rewards: first win bonus has been changed – increased for PvE missions and slightly decreased in PvP game modes. The value of PvE reward increase is twice as high as the amount of PvP decrease.

Controls: you will be able to toggle sprint mode by holding set key instead of pressing it once as it used to be before. This can be changed per preferences in the game settings.

CoOP missions: There will be 2 INSANE maps and 1 NORMAL one in daily rotation.

PVP matches: Creating a room and starting a new quick play now requires at least 6 players (instead of the old 4).

Armor: Titan-II Vest armor points have been readjusted from 100 to 85. Presently this vest has the lowest defence rating and there are no plans to return this item to the in-game shop.

In-game chat:


The “dead can chat” option has been removed from the room settings and it will be enabled by default;
Leaving/joining players will be displayed in the chat;
The nicknames of hostile team will be red in the chat;
Room and in-game chats are combined now so that all the messages written in the game chat will also be displayed in the room chat.


BUG FIXES

Client: The issue leading to the crash of the game client.

PvP/PvE: The player could stick in some certain parts of the map or get to unavailable zones.

PvE:


Incorrect Multipliers in the “Icebreaker” Special Operation;
The rewards for CO-OPs in Africa have been brought in line with the mission rewards in all other regions;
Incorrect icons in Black Shark special operation have been fixed.


Armor: Incorrect repair costs for the Tournament vest have been fixed.

Weapons:


Bug that allowed increasing CV-12 fire rate by incomplete load is fixed.
Animation issues of secondary melee attack of some knives are fixed.
Incorrect skin displaying of S60B3 4-y Anniversary is fixed.



Interface: In-game chat issues are fixed.

Security: Security software has been improved.

Arsenal: Ultra-rare and Legendary weapon used to have even chances to be unlocked.

Challenges: “The key of commando” and “Schweizer Armee” function issues are fixed.

SHOP

Resurrection coins Random Boxes for Warface Dollars have been added to the shop.

Please, make sure that you have updated your game client to the latest version before entering.

See you in game!

Elite weapons (obtained for Crowns) damage against cyborgs has been increased by 50%;
Executor’s hit animation has been changed.


MISCELLANEOUS

Rewards: first win bonus has been changed – increased for PvE missions and slightly decreased in PvP game modes. The value of PvE reward increase is twice as high as the amount of PvP decrease.

Controls: you will be able to toggle sprint mode by holding set key instead of pressing it once as it used to be before. This can be changed per preferences in the game settings.

CoOP missions: There will be 2 INSANE maps and 1 NORMAL one in daily rotation.

PVP matches: Creating a room and starting a new quick play now requires at least 6 players (instead of the old 4).

Armor: Titan-II Vest armor points have been readjusted from 100 to 85. Presently this vest has the lowest defence rating and there are no plans to return this item to the in-game shop.

In-game chat:


The “dead can chat” option has been removed from the room settings and it will be enabled by default;
Leaving/joining players will be displayed in the chat;
The nicknames of hostile team will be red in the chat;
Room and in-game chats are combined now so that all the messages written in the game chat will also be displayed in the room chat.


BUG FIXES

Client: The issue leading to the crash of the game client.

PvP/PvE: The player could stick in some certain parts of the map or get to unavailable zones.

PvE:


Incorrect Multipliers in the “Icebreaker” Special Operation;
The rewards for CO-OPs in Africa have been brought in line with the mission rewards in all other regions;
Incorrect icons in Black Shark special operation have been fixed.


Armor: Incorrect repair costs for the Tournament vest have been fixed.

Weapons:


Bug that allowed increasing CV-12 fire rate by incomplete load is fixed.
Animation issues of secondary melee attack of some knives are fixed.
Incorrect skin displaying of S60B3 4-y Anniversary is fixed.



Interface: In-game chat issues are fixed.

Security: Security software has been improved.

Arsenal: Ultra-rare and Legendary weapon used to have even chances to be unlocked.

Challenges: “The key of commando” and “Schweizer Armee” function issues are fixed.

SHOP

Resurrection coins Random Boxes for Warface Dollars have been added to the shop.

Please, make sure that you have updated your game client to the latest version before entering.

See you in game!

notes.title: Operation Maxwell – Mission update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/b9e5ce9cb2dd6a3f866188cef17ca24a18d34097.jpg

Soldiers!

At this point we are fairly deep into hostile territory and UAV’s have been picking up unusual surges of activity in Blackwood convoys. Intel suggests domestic, highly valuable cargo. The downside is, the enemy employs a broad variety of tactics to disguise their operations, and given their capabilities there’s an estimated total of three days for them to complete the displacement. Deny them the chance and deliver a swift coup de main in key engagements – rest assured your efforts will be amply rewarded.

OBJECTIVE AND REWARDS

To summarize, you need to win as many Quick Matches and Ranked Matches as you can to receive the FULL set of Tournament gear for a period of time. The more victories you obtain – the longer you get to keep it for, just refer to the chart below.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/58e17df98c784ab285d6e8a42b4b92bc99804380.png

And here’s the thing, these stack! As such, when you secure your first victory you get the set for 10 days, and once you get your 26th victory, your items duration is renewed by 40 additional days; and respectively by 100 additional days once you get 51 victory or more.

In other words, you can have the set for a total of 150 days.

The following game modes count towards this event:
•	Plant the Bomb
•	Capture
•	Blitz

The event will be active from 19th of May 12:00 UTC (14:00 CEST) up until 22nd of May 12:00 UTC. You will be able to check the event here when it starts!

notes.notes:

Dear players!

Servers will be down for scheduled update and maintenance on April 25th from 08:00 to 11:00. Please note you will not be able to access the server during that time.

Explore the full changelog below.

New features

Ranked Matches spectator mode has been altered to fix camera position behind the spectated player.

Body skins

Male and female nano-suits

WT308

URL=www.youtube.com/watch?v=sKjTAcIHAhc


Balance changes

FY-103
Mini Oren – Damage increased from 61 to 66, minimal damage increased from 31 to 33. Recoil has been optimized to be more visually controlled, but has also been randomized (there is no fixed recoil pattern). Headshot damage values have been adjusted from 4 to 3.7, however this fix is aimed to stabilize the resulting headshot damage that remained the same as before – 244 (taking into account the current damage increase).

Weapon sound overhauls

AY 551
A3-210
FY-47

notes.title: April Balance Update -- Game economy and shop changes
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6139533/19467491304e81eccc6730fadb5ded4d94223c42.jpg

Dear players.

As a part of a rebalancing program we will be rolling out a new update, introducing the changes to game shop, various cost revamps (from weapons to special offers), and touch a tiny fraction upon the subject of making the most of the game and the new system.

One of the key factors to a successful project is its ability to deliver well-timed and positive updates, as well as recognize problems when they exist. Having said that, it is just as imperative to keep the community informed. On that note, there is no arguing there are occasional minor delays, however we are working to ensure you are in the loop with us on the updates and are moreover able to partake in the future of Warface by providing feedback – on the forum in a general fashion, and via Developer Q&A sessions (FAQ’s).

Today we’ll be addressing the game shop and item changes.

The availability of boosters

We will be reducing the super-VIP booster costs considerably. These boosters enable you to unlock game content faster, earning new ranks and obtaining access to new weapons.

Regular and super-VIP boosters will now also come with a two-hour version; if you want to play for a specific evening, you don’t need to buy the booster for an entire month if you’re not sure you’ll have enough time.

Temporary weapon variants: accessibility and comfort

In order to optimize Warface dollars gains and expenses, we will be lowering the temporary variant prices considerably, and these will no longer require repair at all! It is a fairly common model allowing you to rent a weapon instead of securing it permanently for a hefty price, let alone maintain it. This enables you to use a broader variety of weapons and eventually amass enough currency to build a consistent, decent armory. There will be three contract options available: two hour long, seven day and thirty day variants; all of these have had their costs readjusted, down by approximately 20%. However, the option to rent weapons for a day will be removed from the game – it simply didn’t fit and was underused. Moreover, players ran into excessive pointless costs with that contract length – statistically, they either don’t use the gun long enough (only for 1.5 to 2 hours instead), or opt in for saving for a permanent version.

As stated above, a new, considerably short weapon contract will be added to the game – lasting two hours, it will enable you to try out the gun or play to your heart’s content. The idea is an average player would have a few long-term lease contracts and frequently switch between short-term contracts trying out various weapons and expanding their “weapon and role pool”.

Permanent weapon variants for Kredits and Warfаce dollars will be completely removed from the shop. However, in contrast you will have permanent Arsenal weapons instead. In other words, your “Arsenal”,  found under Career -> Weapons, will be the elite guns that do require maintenance just like your armor, whereas your regular weapons will be something you pay for only when you need to use it (or, alternatively, opt in for a 30-day contract for a weapon you just fancy too much).

Disclaimer: those of you who have already purchased the permanent weapons will keep them after the update.

As of present the prevailing majority of outstanding guns are greatly underrated or simply don’t get in the spotlight enough just because more easily obtainable guns are available. As such, the wide variety in the store and the economy suffers, in the end affecting the players in a negative fashion. Most of you are familiar with RPG as a genre and it is no secret that gradual progression is vital to any game; whereas previously even a newcomer could get his hands on content designed to be accessed in end-game instead. As a result, a large ‘share’ of content was just skipped by most players in the community, whereas those that tried to progress gradually as intended were left out in minorities or with extreme challenges. Which is exactly what we’re trying to avert.

To break it down, the following equipment is affected by this change: primary, secondary and melee weapons, both Kredit and Warface dollars variants; while Arsenal weapons and all other gear (Kevlar, helmet, boots and gloves) is still available in permanent variants.

Brand new look

We are planning to expand the selection of body skins available to you in the shop. Featuring the fresh new and some returning old, are the following squads:

"Aurora"
"Pandora"
"Black Widow"
"Exo-skeleton"
"Phantom"
"Night Stalker"

...as well as the Russian and Elite uniform sets!

Keep your style game on point with your skill level; pick your favourite squadron and express yourself!

These body skins and suits can be purchased for Kredits in the shop. Every class suit is purchased separately, and is permanent.

Please bear in mind that these skins do not alter your game stats in any way and thus grant no combat advantages; they are purely cosmetic (but quite good-looking, give 'em that).

To wrap it up; we hope we have your understanding as to our intentions with this update. The goal is to create a living, breathing economy within the game with content that is spread out accordingly per its niche: entry-level to end-game. Getting your hands on a particular weapon or piece of equipment will feel more rewarding.

All of the aforementioned changes are not live yet and there is a couple of weeks before they take place. They come as a result of thorough analysis and careful calculations, and are subject to further monitoring and according adjustments. We will be looking forward to receiving your feedback in the discussion topic here; but let's all keep it clean and tidy -- we'll try to answer the questions you guys have. And if you happen to have a favourite gun you want to keep permanently, you better hurry up, this is your last chance before the update goes live!

notes.title: 'Icebreaker' update is live!
notes.notes:
Soldiers!

notes.title: Update R39.1 is here – see what’s new
notes.notes:
https://www.warface.com/files/news/f4d45f39a33690044d5ee2fe11856504.jpg

We keep the new content coming thick and fast in Warface, and our latest update once again features a whole lot of gun-toting goodness to get your teeth into – this time with a festive twist. Check out what's new in R39.1 below.

Bag and Tag Icebound

Get ready for hunting season to open on our all-new Bag and Tag map, Icebound. Set amid the snows of Siberia, Icebound challenges you to take out enemies then make off with their dogtags as you fight your way to PvP supremacy. With fiery forests, frozen lakes, and a functioning radar tower, the map offers a feast of tactical options to explore and – for the next few weeks – comes gift-wrapped in an extra special festive form. Watch the tactical overview below.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vnvBoO5ccP8

SMG-9 Ares

Alongside Icebound, update R39.1 introduces the SMG-9 Ares sub-machine gun – a new weapon for Engineers that combines speed and style. In fact, the ferocious 1120 RPM is the highest of any firearm in Warface. So, if spraying bullets like they're going out of fashion is your idea of a good time, look no further than the SMG-9 Ares. See all the details here.

Festive Fever

We've always loved getting into the seasonal spirit here at Warface HQ, and our latest update continues the tradition in style. Highlights this year include a Daily Login giveaway between December 21 – 25, Lucky Boxes in the store featuring our new Evil Santa weapons, Christmas-themed versions of TDM Hangar, TDM Oil Depot, and Icebound – and more. Get the full rundown of just how hard we're hitting the holidays right here.

What else is new in R39.1?

More improvements, new achievements, and much, much more are all incoming in R39.1. To keep you up to speed, we've prepared a detailed overview of all the other changes and bug fixes in the full patch notes. You'll find everything you need to know in our dedicated HUB Patch Notes section .

notes.title: R38.1 Game Update
notes.notes:
https://www.warface.com/files/news/5f18a5d3eec2a85a48d9cbae7cdfc160.jpg
It may only be a few weeks since Black Shark hit Warface, but that hasn't stopped us from putting together another fully loaded game update for you to sink your teeth into. Our R38.1 update arrived today, bringing a new game mode, map, and more to the table. Here are the highlights:

Blitz
Our all-new PVP mode, Blitz, gives you 90 seconds to defuse a bomb or suffer the consequences. Teams will switch roles every five rounds, either protecting or pursuing the bomb as they race to reach six or 11 wins. As you can imagine, with so little time on the clock and so much at stake, the action is always frenetic, tense, and (very) heated.

Hawkrock
No new game mode is complete without a new map, and alongside Blitz comes Hawkrock – a sun-soaked warzone based around a Mediterranean villa. As you battle to defuse or defend the bomb in Blitz, Hawkrock offers an array of breach points to exploit and changing tactical dynamics to adapt to as new routes are carved open during the 90 second match-ups. Expect a lot of noise, flying debris, and sudden deaths. We probably should have made sure the homeowner wasn't around…

Be prepared
Check out the video below for a tactical overview of Hawkrock from our very own CryKane.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JpJuoIFLSg0
Double weapon whammy
R38.1 also brought two stellar new weapons to the Warface arsenal – namely the MS Radek assault rifle (for Riflemen) andPEG-7 shotgun (for Medics).
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/c9fe42b260db5d341e5671f50b1a5f32.png

With the MS Radek boasting a brutal 84 max damage and the PEG-7 offering a faster RPM and longer range than many of its competitors, both guns will add some serious stopping power to your locker. Get them in-game now! 
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/7c4cd8c02c05d5d08b025973db95b58d.png

Steam Launcher update
As you know, we always strive to improve the quality of your experience while playing Warface. This is why we are replacing the old Warface launcher with the GFACE Launcher on Steam.

Other changes

 Improved security (captcha on login)

Known issues

When closing the Steam GFACE Launcher it goes into the taskbar not allowing the user to close Steam before quitting the Launcher 

A visible command line window popping up ('executing nw.exe') when launching the GFACE Launcher via Steam 

Steam overlay pop-up appears on the launcher 

Important information

Upon the first launch of the GFACE Launcher through Steam, the game files will need to be verified. This might take a couple of minutes.

Bug fixes and other changes
More improvements, new achievements, and a lot, lot more – it's all incoming, so we've prepared a detailed overview of all the other changes and bug fixes in the full patch notes. You'll find them in our dedicated HUB Patch Notes section.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TnBUsEPXXWE

Get ready to test your skills in a brand new PvP arena and sample the pure power of three new weapons as our October update hits today. Read on to discover exactly what's new.

New PTB map – Pyramid
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/b084c0a92cf587abfc342977035e18ab.jpg

If you've tested your mettle in our Anubis Co-op mission, you should feel right at home when you get down to business in PTB Pyramid. Our newest plant the bomb map takes you back to the deserts of North Africa for a deadly PvP duel that's guaranteed to go off with a bang. With opportunities for each class to make a strategic impact, and a cyborg horde waiting to break out at the plant sites, there's plenty to play for.

New weapons
Smashing Blackwood's elite troops takes tactics and teamwork. But it doesn't hurt to have some serious firepower either. Thankfully, Warface HQ has been hard at work on a trio of badass new weapons for Snipers and Medics who like to get a little more bang for their buck.

SVK-AS
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/e4f16456c8cfcde831c7694982932704.png

Both versions of the SVK-AS Sniper Rifle will be available for purchase for Warface Dollars via a Random Box.

SX-41
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/be93083818612f5a0fcc6e7ee94c72de.png

The SX-41 Shotgun will be available for purchase directly in the in-game shop for Warface Dollars.

Silent boot fix
We have fixed the sound issue with silent boots cancelling all noises. Now, only the sound of footsteps will be reduced/cancelled. All other sounds (gear, arming/disarming bombs) will be active.

Game client optimization
We've optimized the following maps to improve performance on low-end hardware (especially integrated Intel HDxxxx GPUs).

Hideout
TDM Oil Depot
TDM Hangar 2.0
PTB D17
STM Blackgold

Bug fixes and other changes
More game client optimizations, new achievements (over 50!), and a lot, lot more – it's all incoming, so we've prepared a detailed overview of all the other changes and bug fixes in the full patch notes. You'll find them in our brand new HUB Patch Notes section.

Find out a little more from Cry-Kane in his patch notes rundown:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oKeE_v9XUZo

notes.title: R35.1 Game Update
notes.notes:
https://www.warface.com/files/news/7202299e11842b5993c9a8c038cabd11.jpg

The latest game update will wow you with new Co-op missions, smoking guns, and our new Crysis-inspired Nanosuit style skins!

New PvE missions

Our new Co-op maps, based in our Africa setting, will come in 2 different variants and feature wide open spaces, narrow caves, and dangerous passages. The missions will combine vertical with horizontal gameplay and culminate in an arena-like drilling area perfect for up close and personal showdowns. The heat is on in these hot new maps.

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/bf92f5e6d28488933c3a762262832369.jpg

New weapons

And a Warface update wouldn't be a Warface update without adding yet more cool new weapons to the already expansive Warface arsenal!

Inspired by the pistol made in the Czech Republic and firstly introduced in 1986, the WX-86 handgun features a staggered-column magazine, all-steel construction, and a hammer forged barrel. Say hello, to our not so little friend.

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/57897d298020adce677ad180ab2d8181.png

The TT-3000 is inspired by a Russian submachine gun, designed as a close-quarter combat weapon for Police and Special Forces alike. Experience the devastating power of one of the two standard SMGs which Russian police use as standard issue. No messing about here.

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/f1602d2b7c6c392e61d1116711a8cf42.png

Nanosuit up!

The legendary Crysis Nanosuit hits Warface!

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/2c4e0398835a3becabea716fd674c24b.png

The iconic battle gear that has seen service in four epic Crysis games is coming to Warface in the form of unique new character skins. Whether you're a Rifleman, Medic, Sniper, or Engineer, there's a Nanosuit just for you.

Want to get your hands on one? Of course you do. The Nanosuit skin is exclusive to the Auction House, so get down there and get bidding.

What's your zodiac sign?

Are you spontaneous and daring like an Aries or reliable and modest as a Virgo. No matter what sign you were born under – we've got an achievement for everyone. Check our shop to find your perfect mark and pimp your loading screen even further with the mystical Zodiac badge and stripe.

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/7ab9cecddbb0bd9ef67be63b10d4cf0b.png

Gameplay changes and improvements

As part of our journey to make Warface the most action-packed and fair place for everyone, we are introducing two exciting new features for Ranked Games:


Surrender Option: Want to leave a game but can't handle the incoming ban? You'll now be able to initiate a surrender vote after 30 seconds if you think that you stand no chance against your opponents. But you won't be needing the white flag now, will you warrior?

Win-Streak Bonus: Now you will be awarded more points the more ranked matches you win in a row. Got skills? Accelerate your ascent to higher ranks without having to fight lower ranking players for too long. And if you're a lower ranked player yourself, you'll fight those highly skilled contestants less often, so this change will make the Ranked mode a more balanced experience.


Bug Fixes and other changes

Game client optimisations, new instant rewards, and a lot, lot more – it's all incoming, so we've prepared a detailed overview of all the other changes and bug fixes in the full patch notes. Head over to the forum. 

Find out a little more from Cry-Kane in his patch notes rundown:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eKIALJpo48M?rel=0
See you in Warface!

notes.title: R34.1 Game Update
notes.notes:
https://www.warface.com/files/news/_944x/375e969218764a9be67c2d50d7da9cd2.jpg
No matter if you prefer to spend your summer holidays in a palace or at the beach, Warface has got you covered. With hot maps, smoking weapons, and plenty of cool gun skins, we're turning up the heat with our latest game update!

Beautiful Death Awaits You
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gM3WglqXFrc
Palace is a medium-size Plant the Bomb map set in a sheikh's palace in the Middle East, but don't let the elaborate and beautiful architecture of this mansion distract you. You need a well-prepared battle plan, or your enemies will eradicate you and claim victory for themselves.

New weapons and skins
We will be adding two new weapons to the Warface arsenal, as well as more weapon skins!
If your favorite way of waging war is as a Rifleman, you won't want to go into battle without the destructive power of the new Dewnfield R65E4, a custom three round burst British bullpup assault rifle.

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/bee4642dfe7cdf2e86696b207d33a7a0.png

Stealthy Snipers are treated with the brand new S60E3. This heavy bolt-action sniper rifle is based on a Richmond Rifle with .308 bolt face and widely used by the US Marine Corps.

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/3e1e7e87c68fa8fc37fb261fbdc3f5e7.png

Our newly added weapon skins will give you plenty of customization options. Show your foes why they should never forget who's behind the bullets.

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/d55b8f8d5306869892aee21c017f62de.jpg

Life's a beach!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KlUNk7OLFnc
We know TDM Hangar is one of the community's favorite maps, and as the best athletes from across the world head to Brazil, we've decided to give it a sporty makeover. Don't forget to pack the sunscreen!

With a festival of athletics soon to be in full swing in Brazil, we've unleashed a set of new Jogos 2016 guns for you to go for gold with. Let the games begin!

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/3cd2f7f24dc5df065b10962eead95209.png

Gameplay changes and improvements
As we continue to make Warface even more fun and fair for everyone, we will introduce 2 exciting new features for our popular Ranked Games:

Seasons: you'll now be able to clearly see when a season starts and ends and the rewards you'll be entitled to at the end of the season. The rewards will also be granted automatically.
Players leaving a match will now be banned for a certain amount of time. The 'Fight' button will turn into a countdown displaying the time until the ban is lifted again.

Bug Fixes and other changes
New map specific achievements, UI changes, and more - it's all incoming, so we've prepared a detailed overview of all the other changes and bug fixes in the full patch notes. Head over to the patch notes forum.

Go4Warface
Not exactly part of our R34.1 update, but still news well worthy of a mention is the launch of our weekly ESL Go4Warface tournaments. Starting on August 7th, you'll have the chance to show your skills and compete for more than € 10.000 prize money!

Find out a little more from Cry-Kane in his patch notes rundown:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sgwZCMCsh7k

notes.title: Game Update 33.1
notes.notes:
https://www.warface.com/files/static/image/c938a3c8c962c6f22888ff48fd6e6228.jpg

Raise your game with our July update, which introduces a new TDM map, hard hitting guns, Top Dog helmets, and three long-awaited features.

You can't beat Sirius
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vlIQ1mKKJM8
Based on the popular Domination Mode map, Sirius, we're introducing a new Versus Mode map which we think will be just as big a hit - TDM Sirius. Battle Blackwood on their home turf and prevent them from putting the finishing touches to a weapon of mass destruction pointing squarely at Warface HQ.
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/3653c0dc6cdfb9d1fc98e330925c29fb.jpg

The hunt is on!
We'll also be welcoming three new additions to the already diverse Warface arsenal. Medics can say hello to the Fararm LTR6 - a classic sporting shotgun available in both normal and shiny golden forms. This timeless beauty bursts out 670 damage at short range, and can be equipped with Scope and Muzzle attachments.
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/173d5c5ad3dad0a3d9cbc230fa1be577.png

The Fazil UE3 assault rifle will be your weapon of choice if you want to conquer the battlefield as a Rifleman. Designed and manufactured in Brazil, this is the official weapon of the Brazilian Armed Forces, and excels both in damage and accuracy.
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/23dcbac22d9fa65228f6b313f4096389.png

Protect your head!
Be the Top Dog on the front line with our new helmets. Available for all classes, these protective pieces come in blue and red variants for Warface and Blackwood recruits, so you'll get two different designs for the price of one! The helmets increase head protection by 60%, will regenerate health while you're out of combat, and have reduced repair costs. Did we mention you'll also look like the top dog?

Blackwood:
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/8f419d3d122ad400bad5ed8db0fb7ca5.png

Warface:
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/d1b7cf2f1f2b3860ed42462fb4daf6fd.png

Gameplay changes and improvements
As we continue to make Warface even more fun and fair for everyone, we will introduce three exciting new features with our July update.

Ping limitation:If a player has a ping higher than a specific figure for a certain amount of seconds, he will now automatically be kicked from the game room. The values vary by game mode and realm, and will be closely monitored by us. We might adjust them in the future to ensure that everyone has the best Warface experience possible.
Reconnect to Ranked Games in case of crash:Should you suffer a disconnect or a client crash during a ranked game, you will now be able to reconnect to the same game within the next 3 minutes.
Block connection to Versus games that are already in progress:Players won't be able to connect to a PvP Quickplay game after the game session is already running for a particular amount of time. The time constraints are different for every game mode (i.e., the threshold will be higher for longer running modes like Storm).

Bug Fixes and other changes
Improvements for animations, personalized offers, and more - we prepared a detailed overview of all the other changes and bug fixes in the full patch notes, available on our forum.

Find out a little more from Cry-Kane in his patch notes rundown:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3MHdyu4UOwE

notes.title: Anubis Game Update
notes.notes:
https://www.warface.com/files/static/image/dd0367f6d36295fcf02806e6f036c214.jpg

	Join forces with your comrades and launch your most daring raid yet as you attempt to infiltrate a heavily-guarded pyramid which doubles as a Blackwood HQ.

	https://www.warface.com/files/static/image/c21c4e5a9e38901b389e1fe7ef904a6f.jpg
Delve into the dark truth
	Only the best Warface warriors will outlast Anubis' killer challenges. Everyone else can kiss goodbye to their souls.

	We've compiled all the intel our infiltration team was able to gather in a special 'Anubis' dossier, which you can find here:	http://hq.warface.com/updates/anubis/

	Your training will come firmly into play as you head into combat with Blackwood's deadliest troops – including waves of deadly cyborg soldiers.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YmC2pzAe9_c
…it just takes the target down
	Introducing the CCR Honey Badger- a versatile submachine gun that's perfect for Engineers to lay the smack down inclose-quarters combat. It's lethal at short range and stable enough to fire volleys of hot lead from the hip when you've closed in on the enemy.
	https://www.warface.com/files/static/image/78d53ebdb243ff9b499ef57670972069.png
	Want to augment your effectiveness on the battlefield? A great loadout is to team the Honey Badger up with the JagdKommando Knife and make your Engineer character into a ninja killing machine.
	https://www.warface.com/files/static/image/798a59ea5db0b256955138d5040c4076.png
Summon the spirit of destruction
	Blending Egyptian mythology with elements of the North African battleground, we're adding 5 new Anubis weapon skins to send your enemies to the afterlife in style. The new skins feature hieroglyphic motifs, snakeskin patterns, and an image of Anubis himself. Our new batch of very special Anubis-themed weapon skins includes the FY-103, Everest, Smg-19 Wisent, VIPER and the Python.

The ancient explorer
	Our new Spec Ops mission Anubis comes with a brand new set of achievements – if you manage to complete the mission that is. 12new stripes, marks, and batches are waiting for the brave souls who manage to survive the assault on Anubis.
	https://www.warface.com/files/static/image/d6b68e58d5200d1cc396e4e624d55da3.png
	This is just a small selection of achievements our newest game update will introduce. You can find a full list in the 	patch notes.

	Bug Fixes and other changes
	Improvements for matchmaking, better auto team balancing, an extra detailed kill log and more - we prepared a detailed overview of all the other changes and bug fixes in the full patch notes, available on our 	forum.
	
Find out a little more fromCry-Kane in his patch notes rundown.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0IDtO91SJUY

notes.title: Spring Game Update
notes.notes:
http://warface.com/files/static/image/2016_SpringGameUpdate-Forum.jpg

Step up your game with our latest game update that'll increase the pressure with new maps, new guns, ranked games and a nightmarish new difficulty mode for the popular Earth Shaker special operation. Alongside, we'll also be rolling out further updates to existing content, adjusting gameplay, improving the UI and fine tuning guns.

Explore new battlegrounds
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=doKlYG1euII
The new Free-For-All map 'Bunker' invites players indoors to battle in a vast silo complex. Fight against everyone and use military cargo and a ramified network of ventilation paths to your advantage on this visually striking map.
http://warface.com/files/static/image/Warface_top-down_TDM_18-EN_Forum.jpg
We will also welcome a new Team Deathmatch map Codename 'D18', a toxic industrial facility located somewhere in Eastern Europe. Storm the stronghold under the cover of darkness and shutdown Blackwood before they realize what hit them! Stay focused while exploring this dangerous factory and always be on the watch for ambushes, claymores and snipers hiding in dark corners.

A deadly tool
The update will be introducing the golden version of the TWM (Tactical Warface Magnum) - a sniper rifle with a detachable 5-round box magazine. One of the best sniper rifles in the game will become even better. A higher range, more rounds per minute, 1 more bullet in the clip and absolutely no repair costs - you'll love this one!
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/1f03950a5f16364b13e6728379429c1e.png

Hot! New Earth Shaker Weapons
Fight fire with fire as new Earth Shaker weapons hit Warface. Sold in individual Random Boxes this time around, we'll welcome 6 new additions to the Earth Shaker arsenal. Starting with the EXAR-L PDW and the Katana, you'll be able to get your hands on the magmatic versions of two of the most sought after weapons in Warface. Bring the heat to the battlefield!
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/1d521d1856b996a3f3f56ddeca2221a0.png

Ranked Games
Accessible through a special tab in game, the new ranked mode will add an entirely new layer of competition for all Warface veterans. You and up to 4 of your friends will be pitched against other players in a six round Plant the Bomb match. Show your skill, win matches, gather ranked points or loose matches and get valuable points deducted. Try to get ahead of the competition and reach the top of the leaderboard!

Unlock new achievements
For the achievement hunters amongst you, we also have numerous new trophies, including the new Nightmare Earth Shaker ones. Here's just a small selection of what's on offer, so make sure to check out the patch notes for a full list.
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/385a999bb584c9e5eafc98390201332f.png

Bug Fixes and other changes
Gameplay adjustments, UI improvements and more - there are too many changes to mention in detail here, but if you want the inside story, check out the full patch notes. You can find them on our forum.

notes.title: Black Mamba Game Update
notes.notes:
A secret military complex. An African savanna. A lethal missile. Two deadly forces. Warface and Blackwood will battle for control of the ultimate weapon in our new Storm Co-op PvP map Black Mamba. Are you ready to take it on?

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/64b1b21fe2d757e25ab66d10ed690256.jpg
Created in conjunction with pro gamers, Black Mamba features indoor and outdoor gameplay with dangerous choke points. If you don't play as a team, Black Mamba will bite you back. Hard. Take a look:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xo-ssV-ou-s

As always, Storm is a PvP Co-op mode. The defensive team has three command posts to protect. The attacking team must capture them in succession as quickly as possible. If a command post is lost, defenders retreat to the next. Once all posts are captured, teams swap sides for the next round.

Gear up

You'll have to work as a team to take down your opponents. But tactics, positioning, and teamwork aren't the only factors that will help you dominate. You're going to need some big guns.Warface HQ will release the Fararm ATF 12 and its golden counterpart, the Gold Fararm ATF 12 - two semi-automatic shotguns that pack a vicious punch. Engineers on the frontlines will also have a new favorite weapon: the SN-5G Sarosk, a sub-machine gun capable of engaging enemies wearing class-II body armor.

Gold Fararm ATF 12
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/75bf949e348e0ae0e2da31506b7b6f52.png
SN-5G Sarosk
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/941cd6c777f10abc129a3c52bfb3c911.png

Show your true colors

Show your colors with one of 9 new national flags. If your country of choice isn't represented, don't worry: more are on the way in future updates. And always remember to treat that flag with the utmost respect, Soldiers!

http://warface.com/files/static/image/flag-all.png

For Warface achievement hunters, we'll have a new set of badges to earn. Starting tomorrow, you'll be able to play for the legendary golden Nemean lion - an animal only Hercules could tame - and Ares, the son of Zeus and Hera and the true god of war, as well as two others. Check them out below:
[table]
[tr]
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/b677b47715ecea319417e652ff491172.png 
https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/e0ace0378fb67dd0d8bf6a2554e2347b.png[/tr]

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/09ae975d4f8e99da89d4b3f791e46071.png[/tr][/table]

Wage war!

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/63138726542f947693dd421e54616556.png

Are you ready to level up and unlock our new rank 80: Ares? Unleash your inner fury and become a real force of destruction on the battlefield, and you can carry the rank of the heroic Greek god of war.

Gameplay tweaks and changes

Need to assist your comrades on the battlefield? Restocking ammo and reviving downed teammates will now be easier than ever. We're also making some UI and HUD changes to help you save time and stay alert in the heat of battle.

Celebrate the update

To celebrate the latest update, Warface HQ will be granting open access to four Special Operations. You won't need access tokens to take on the Cyber Horde, fight to the top of the Tower, or face the Architect in Earth Shaker for the next two weeks. We also welcome back the icy Spec Ops in the Siberian mountains. So assemble your team, select your favorite gear, and tackle some of Warface's most challenging operations.

Bug fixes and other changes

There are too many changes to mention in detail here, but if you want the inside story, check out the full patch notes. You can find them on our forum.

Intel reveals our enemy has built a geothermal power plant inside a giant volcano to power up their Seismic Activity Generator (SAG) - an advanced super weapon which can cause devastation on a global scale. notes.title: WINTER GAME UPDATE
notes.notes:
Discover the content of our latest game update, including festive cheer, golden guns and seasonal skins!

Let it snow

From a festive loading screen to a yuletide TDM Oil Depot makeover, we're spreading the joy of the holiday season in style this year! As you battle it out on the new Christmas-themed Oil Depot map, you'll not only benefit from a warm and fuzzy feeling inside, but also receive +25% Arsenal Points, Experience and Warface Dollars. Additionally, we'll have happy hours with double rewards, every day from 3 pm to 7 pm, up until January 1st! 

http://warface.com/files/wysiwyg/826b7aaf5b02762fd47ecb349e41e143.jpg

Maps

There are even more map enhancements to look forward to in the update, with TDM Hangar getting a well deserved visual overhaul. In fact, we believe that the map is looking so beautiful now that we decided to name it TDM Hangar 2.0 from now on. But don't just take our word for it – take a look for yourself: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qfBxZYgSDDg

The hugely popular CTF Quarry has also been reworked from the ground up. After gathering player feedback and performing an in-depth gameplay analysis, we reduced the map size, changed routes and simplified the layout to make this gem of a map even more appealing. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vFRvS6jGrKo

Gear

If you haven't managed to add the R16A4 to your gun cabinet yet, don't worry – our winter update gives you another chance. Bag the immensely popular revamp of this classic firearm or gift yourself the high-quality Anatolia RK-102 shotgun.

notes.title: Halloween game update
notes.notes:
https://www.warface.com/files/news/_944x/27102015-HalloweenUpdate-EN-News.jpg
It’s already spooky time on Warface, and the Halloween period is just perfect to celebrate our new addition... Are you wondering what it is? Then keep on reading!

Our new game update is about to roll on Warface, adding a big slice of new tasty content and additions!

New Cyber Horde Special Operation

Our new Special Operation: Cyber Horde is now available! It’s time to face the darkness and prove you fear nothing!

One of Blackwood’s biological laboratories is out of control. Blackwood has been working on a concept of "super soldiers" and as result of a critical failure in its lab, the whole area is now controlled by experimental, deadly Cyborgs.

The Warface team must escort a vehicle with an EMP across a dark forest and reach the centre of the laboratory complex to destroy it, shutting down its generators and ending the remote control of the Cyborgs.

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/034427fe6c1295c5605e3ea30e2a8497.jpg

We have good news for you soldiers... a new campaign has arrived. You better not be afraid of the dark, because you’re to be deployed in the desert at night in our brand new mode, Bag and Tag. 

This vast battleground is a place where we sharpen our skills, where our enemy roots out the weak from its ranks, and where your only friend is the cover of descending darkness... 

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/785ab7aac29307aafc2f94f7434e5828.jpg

With enemies attacking from all sides, you’ll have to master the art of fighting off non-stop attacks all by yourself. Who knows, it’s a skill you might be calling on again soon! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OMHoWAM8dUE

We’ve also implemented new changes, and you can read about some of the major ones below:

Unlocked items for free
From now on, any unlocked item will be given for free to the player. Once an item is unlocked, a pop-up will appear with the message

Rank Up Rewards

The Rank Up Rewards random box content is now displayed in a specific pop-up, the same way as when you open a random box from the shop. You can now see exactly what the Rank up Rewards random box has given you as a reward.

Short list of additional changes:

New HUD customization: you can now adjust the size, the color and the transparency of the hit feedback / feedback indicator

Dear Warface players,

Since the launch of the Africa update last week, we identified several important issues we would like to fix/address in the near future. Thank you all for your feedback, it was invaluable to us, here are the main issues:

•	The maintenance costs (how much each item costs after each play session)
•	Some items having incorrect maintenance costs (e.g.: R249 Para)

Our developers are already working to fix these issues as part of our ongoing commitment to improve the game as a service. Thank you all for participating in making Warface better.

The Warface team

notes.title: Welcome to Africa Game Update
notes.notes:
http://warface.com/files/static/image/WF-EN-GameUpdate-29042015.jpg

Challenge the enemy in boundless Africa, the new battleground in "Operation Endless Skies"—a brand new Co-op setting.

Operation Endless Skies brings five all-new Co-op maps to Warface. Battle Blackwood in a grounded cargo ship, stalk them through dense jungles, and face off in an ancient arena. On this African battleground, new enemies, landscapes and challenges come as thick and fast as unfriendly fire.

Watch the Warface Operation Endless Skies Co-op Release Trailer now!
 
You can learn all about Operation Endless Skies in the Warface HQ


New Versus map “Breach” challenges you to breach the peace

http://warface.com/files/static/image/WF-EN-GameUpdate-29042015-Forurm2.jpg
 
The new Capture map, "Breach" features a fortified facility in the icy Siberian Mountains. A new twist in the map layout will make matches unique and tactically challenging. 

http://warface.com/files/static/image/WF-EN-GameUpdate-29042015-Forurm3.jpg
 
 The defenders will be able to block certain access routes while the attackers have the option to breach through these gates. This will challenge both sides to be even more cautious about drawing up and executing the perfect battle plan.

An economic revolution is coming to Warface!

We are changing the way you pay for weapons, outfits and a variety of Random Boxes in-game. 

We are going to make all items that are directly affecting gameplay available for Warface Dollars. This will include all weapons and outfits currently available and will also include a variety of Random Boxes.

These changes will provide a more level playing field for all our players. Weapons and outfits will become more evenly distributed and every player will be able to own them permanently. You will also have to make smart choices regarding which pieces of equipment you take into matches or on a specific mission (e.g. Is the Katana really required for Regular missions?). We think making these choices will become one of the most interesting and defining aspects of Warface.

Going forward you will have two routes to acquire Warface Dollars: You can earn them by playing as you did before and you can purchase Warface Dollars for Kredits in the shop (Misc. section) at the following rates to top up your war chest:

[TABLE] [TR] [TD] WARFACE DOLLARS[/TD] [TD] PRICE[/TD] [/TR] [TR] [TD] 2.250 WF$[/TD] [TD] 50 K[/TD] [/TR] [TR] [TD] 8.000 WF$[/TD] [TD] 174 K[/TD] [/TR] [TR] [TD] 32.000 WF$[/TD] [TD] 677 K[/TD] [/TR][/TABLE]

To balance these changes, which will open up a wider variety of choices, we will introduce a few additional changes:

This will protect our new recruits from advanced artillery and equipment that they cannot yet purchase and ensure the Versus Rookie channels remain an entry-level playing field.			We will increase the repair costs for the most powerful weapons and outfits.	

You can learn more about these changes in a message by Warface Publishing Producer Loic Raimond.

Are you up for the challenge? More than 30 new achievements await!

We know you love your achievements and we will give you new ones for the game modes introduced in the last couple of month, like Operation Cold Peak and the new Versus Mode “Domination”. Are you up for the challenge?

Other game improvements and additions
Besides a long list of fixed bugs, there are a lot of other changes and additions that will improve your game experience. You can find all the details in the Patch Notes, but highlights include:

notes.title: Big spring update delivers on all fronts
notes.notes:
http://warface.com/files/static/image/WF-EN-Game-Update-01042015.jpg

We've been hard at work on Warface! As winter blows its last icy breath, we're expanding our Operation Cold Peak setting with the grueling Marathon mode—as well as introducing "Domination"; a brand new Versus mode that plays out on the fresh SubZero map. We've also done some spring cleaning: Get ready for a completely revamped game interface, and the shiny new menus it introduces. And finally, if you're more of a summer person, our new Aquatic Assassinator and Digger of Doom weapons have got your back. 

But there is a lot more to this update, so read on:

Show your stamina in Marathon mode

http://warface.com/files/static/image/WF-FR-GameUpdate-01042015-Marathon-Forum1.jpg

As if the individual maps of Operation Cold Peak aren't challenging enough, Marathon mode invites advanced players to tackle all three – Spearhead, Ambush and Zenith – as one continuous level. Gather your strength and put your fighting fortitude to the test in a mission that may not be impossible, but will require intense teamwork.

To access Marathon mode, a Level 10 ranking is required. You have to complete Operation Cold Peak - Mission 3: Zenith at least once to unlock Marathon mode. You need 1 survival access coins to start a Marathon mode mission.

For those who want to use more than the free 4 survival access coins per day, you can now purchase them in the shop as well.

New Versus Mode – Domination

http://warface.com/files/static/image/WF-FR-GameUpdate-01042015-SubZero-Forum1.jpg

Play on the SubZero map and discover the new Domination mode. Fight to fend off the enemy as you capture and hold three strategic positions under mounting pressure that ensures only those who work together will survive.

In domination mode, the fight concentrates on three positions. Capturing two or three of them, by moving close to them and fending off the enemy team, will provide points to your team slowly (two positions captured) or quickly (all three positions captured). The team having reached a certain amount of points or having the more points at the end of the match wins.

http://warface.com/files/static/image/WF-FR-GameUpdate-01042015-SubZero-Forum2.jpg

The new DMN SubZero map takes you to the center of the Blackwood mountain-top base in Siberia, with snowy open fields and hardened bunkers, the ideal surroundings for heated Domination battles.

The Domination mode is currently not available in the Versus Rookie Channel. We intend to make it available with one of the next game updates.

New game user interface improves in game navigation

http://warface.com/files/static/image/WF-FR-GameUpdate-01042015-GameUI-Forum1.jpg

The new user interface improves the overall navigation and accessibility of the game. All in-game menus have been redesigned for better and clearer navigation and information. 

http://warface.com/files/static/image/WF-FR-GameUpdate-01042015-GameUI-Forum2.jpg

A new start menu welcomes you with the latest additions and updates. The new inventory and shop allows you to browse faster. 

A hint of summer: Aquatic Assassinator and Digger of Doom

For some R 'n' R Warface and Blackwood soldiers are sent to the sunniest beaches in the world on a regular basis. On one of those trips they encountered two of the most deadly weapons in the world and brought them back to the front line:

Aquatic Assassinator

http://warface.com/files/static/image/Aquatic-Assassinator.png

Clean up on the battlefield with this aquatic addition to your arsenal. Your enemies may duck and cover, but there's no escape from your rain of terror. 

Digger of Doom

http://warface.com/files/static/image/Digger-of-Doom.png

If you dig weapons with spadefuls of personality, look no further. Burying your enemies is child's play when you're packing plastic this powerful.

New Crown Weapons and Outfits

http://warface.com/files/static/image/WF-FR-GameUpdate-01042015-CrownWeapons-Forum1.jpg

A wide variety of powerful and fantastic looking Crown Weapons and outfits will offer you more options to spend your hard earned Crowns on. Whether you earn your Crowns in Co-op or by dominating the Clan Challenge, Crowns suddenly became even more valuable.

http://warface.com/files/static/image/WF-FR-GameUpdate-01042015-CrownWeapons-Forum2.jpg

Dodge death with the new Warlord Helmets

http://warface.com/files/static/image/WF-FR-GameUpdate-01042015-Warlords-Forum1.jpg

All front line warriors will benefit from the increased protection provided by these new helmets. Survive longer during combat with the health regeneration bonus.

Add the Metasoma 83 to your arsenal

Decimate your opposition with a tried and true Eastern European submachine gun.

Metasoma 83

http://warface.com/files/static/image/Metasoma-83.png

Developed in the 1950s, the Metasoma 83 is a Czechoslovakian .380ACP submachine gun.

The weapon is available through the Metasoma 83 Random Box starting at 600 WF$.

Returned Random Boxes

The T-27, Accuracy SEVEN, CCR CQB and Miller AP6 Random Boxes make their return.

General Game Improvements

Several overall improvements to the network code and animation synchronization should enhance the responsiveness of the game overall. Multiple convenience improvements add the ability to invite friends to a session before creating a game and a list of repair costs for all items when using “Repair all” or auto-repair gives you more of an overview on your spending. If you want to know more about the players you meet in Warface, the improved player information screen now shows you in which game mode and on which map he or she is playing at any given moment.

Also various bugs for Gameplay, Graphics, Sound, Weapons, Equipment, Rewards, Tutorial, Co-op, Versus and Survival issues have been fixed. For a full list, please see the Patch Notes.

Special Notes/Known Issues

Due to a bug we were not able to fix in time for this release we temporarily removed the option to buy skins permanently for Kredits. As mitigation we added rental options for all skins currently available in the shop. We intend to fix this bug and reverse the change with the next upcoming update.
Due to the new UI being introduced, currently only one regular mission and two initiation missions are available in Co-op. We intent to revert back to two regular missions and one initiation mission per day schedule with one of the next upcoming updates.
The hideout is switched back to an older version. We plan to introduce a new hideout in one of our upcoming updates.

Maintenance Period

To implement the changes, maintenance server restarts are required and will take place at the following times:

EU & TR: Wednesday April 1st 1PM CEST - Wednesday April 1st 5PM CEST
NA: Wednesday April 1st 9AM EDT - Wednesday April 1st 11AM EDT

For a full list of changes please see the Patch Notes.

notes.title: “Time is ticking” competition update – Resubmit entries!
notes.notes:
http://warface.com/files/static/image/WF-EN-SiberiaVideoContest-11122014-News.jpg

Soldiers, you have been brave and submitted a lot of videos showing how you managed to tackle the Spearhead mission while fighting for your life.

During the competition a glitch was discovered and while it was not known to us before, it still requires us to reopen the competition and ask all teams to resubmit their video, while not using this glitch.

The glitch in question allows you to place multiple C4 charges on the same spot of the Tank End Boss, making it too easier to kill.

What does it means for you?

Either you completed the mission and recorded the video without using this glitch, then you can send us your video again or you can record a new one and try to beat your first time. If you used the glitch by accident for your first entry, this is your chance to re-enter the competition. All videos need to follow the exact same rules as in the initial announcement.

Please note: Previous entries won’t count. Please (re-)submit your videos. Balancing changes to Cold Peak coming with the game update tomorrow may impact the best time achievable. See Patch Notes for details.

Please understand that we are giving all the teams a new chance. We think this is the fairest solution for everyone. Please make sure not to use the particular glitch. Otherwise it’ll lead to the disqualification of the whole team.

The competition will now end on Sunday December 21st, 2014 11:59PM CET.

The winners will be then announced in the following week and we’ll try to make sure that you get your prizes before Christmas.

So gear up and record the best time while tackling Spearhead mission, soldiers!

notes.title: NVIDIA GameWorks features come to latest version of Warface
notes.notes:
http://warface.com/files/static/image/WF-EN-NVIDIAGameworksUpdate-29102014.jpg

With the update earlier today a number of NVIDIA GameWorks features have arrived in the latest version of Warface. Thanks to GameWorks, Warface now uses sprite and mesh based effects with motion derived from either a turbulence simulated grid or static velocity field.

NVIDIA Turbulence and PhysX Particles bring the gameplay in Warface to a higher plane of realism: All particles have real-time collision – meaning their movement is affected by the game’s triangle mesh terrain, and the shapes of characters and vehicles.

The turbulence grid simulations take a player’s motion into account and can cause high pressure in front and low pressure behind characters as they move through the smoke effects. Players can choose from two in-game options to see the GameWorks effects in action, with "PhysX Normal" including particle mesh debris such as dirt, rocks and sparks, while "PhysX High" adds turbulence using sprite based smoke particles into the mix.

The combination of both PhysX Particles and NVIDIA Turbulence can be seen in the following effects:

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/eaeb7074b5a767030dbff798533cf0ff.jpg

The back blast of a self-propelled AA missile launcher creates a high-velocity smoke effect that collides with objects in the environment and curls up and away as it dissipates.

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/1df880292c50c1f26b409d276326a91e.jpg

A helicopter dust effect creates a visible downdraft that can collide with characters and other objects in the environment. This powerful force can affect weapon debris and other smoke effects in the vicinity.

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/62ab945626bd7a79411f946fce4ca1b1.jpg

The grenade explosion effect adds mesh debris and a lingering ambient smoke effect that other explosions, helicopters and characters can interact with.

See the effects in action:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=34c4ox5ShzE

You can enable the effects in the game settings. We recommend enabling NVIDIA Gameworks in Warface on all NVIDIA graphics cards from GeForce GTX465 upwards. A GeForce GTX 760 or better is recommended to enable PhysX High settings. We also recommend to have the latest graphics drivers installed. For more information on NVIDIA Gameworks in Warface visit: http://www.geforce.com/whats-new/articles/warface-physx-nvidia-gameworks

notes.title: GAME UPDATE: CHECK IN AT THE PARADISE MOTEL, NEVADA
notes.notes:
https://www.warface.com/files/news/_950x/WF-EN-Update-2008201470.jpg
With the last two updates, the troops of Warface and Blackwood have already acquainted themselves with the new battlegrounds of The Silver State of Nevada, but now it's time to check in at the Paradise Motel! It has all the amenities you would expect, like cable TV, aircon, phone and a pool. The only downside is you are moving in next door to your archenemy. So not surprisingly the motel and its parking lot and nearby gas station are quickly transformed into an explosive Team Deathmatch arena, with the motel in the middle itself adding a nice verticality to the map.

Included in tomorrow’s update are some of the first steps being taken to align Warface, as mentioned in the latest statement.

Crowns

Crown weapons and items are the most desirable pieces of equipment that you can lay your hands on in Warface, but we know that it can be hard to get your hands on them and try them out for yourself. As a result we have reduced the prices on Crown items and also changed the rental duration from 14 days to one and seven days. As part of the changes for more accessible weapons and items, the Crown Random Boxes have been removed from the game. All of the various Crown items are now available on an individual basis. The non-Crown permanent items that were previously included in these boxes are available in the normal Random Boxes. The other weapons will be reintroduced at a later time.

To balance these changes we have slightly reduced the Crown rewards of the Co-Op missions. With the new prices and rewards you should be able to obtain items like the “Crown Vest” after four days when you earn 75% of all possible crowns over four days.

We also want to give you more options on how to spend your crowns, so we are adding six new crown weapons to the shop:

This is also part of our preparations for the next update where we will be making many alterations to the in-game shop in terms of the weapons and items available including their WF$ pricing. notes.title: Status update from Producer Gavin Lammin
notes.notes:
https://www.warface.com/files/news/_950x/WF-EN-Game-Status-19082014.jpg
Hi all,

For those of you who don’t know me, my name is Gavin and I am a Publishing Producer for Warface PC in the West.

Two months on from my previous letter in the latter half of May – a lot has happened and we have been restructuring our internal processes so that we can operate more effectively. 

Such a process naturally comes with challenges and causes a ripple effect across certain areas of development. One example is taking time from the team to participate in our planned development diaries.

We are always listening and we are aware of areas where we can strengthen, such as hackers in the game and this is one of our biggest challenges to overcome. The anti-cheat team had been impacted by recent changes so as a temporary solution – we have added the much requested majority vote-kick feature.  When you have 6 or more players on a team, the 60/40 rule comes into effect. 

Quick Development Update

The first Nevada Team Deathmatch map “Trailer Park” went live on July 31st – a little later than originally planned in order to make the new environment the best it could be. I hope you’re enjoying it so far along with “Mine”. Keep the comments coming! 

We've been excited to see our user base grow following the release of Warface on Steam, and on that front we also recently added Trading Cards and retroactive Achievements.

The lag improvements I spoke of last time were partially applied to the game so we could first see the results. The changes will be fully applied as soon as possible. To keep expectations in check, while this is an improvement – some users may still encounter some latency. Rest assured that it remains a high priority for us along with anti-cheat.   

Pesky Bugs

One issue that is “bugging” me and you is the Brazilian Cup smoke grenades in Co-op, where they do not respawn after reaching a checkpoint. We’ve not yet fixed the problem but we know how important they can be when in missions. So we’ve decided that we will be compensating all users who have purchased these grenades in-game with the yellow smoke grenade for a rental period of at least 2 months*. We are aware that this is only one of your main concerns based on the reports we’ve received. We are changing our tools and ways internally so that we can debug these pesky bugs better than before! 

Warface Hub

Those of you who follow me on Twitter may have seen the teaser images of the Hub. We will be posting articles closer to release that will go into full detail but for the mean time here is a taster…

https://www.warface.com/files/wysiwyg/6ec44e2156467869e0cc5135b026520e.jpg


Dedicated forums 
Account management – uses your existing GFACE account
Discussion section on articles
Responsive design


Upcoming

The items I had communicated previously are still in progress but may be a bit behind schedule as we prioritize certain areas of development.  The buildup will start closer to each items release. 

We have many configuration changes upcoming as part of our efforts to align the different versions of Warface so that we have better synergy across all regions. I hope these changes will be well received and, as with any changes to the game, we want to maintain a dialogue during this transition and the WF Hub will help with this.

Lastly – I want to say thanks to the passionate community members that continue to send feedback. It is valued and you can continue to do so via the usual channels on GFACE, Facebook and Twitter or you can message me directly @gavlam88.

Gavin Lammin




*While the tri-colored World Cup grenade works fine (and looks awesome) on the battlefields of Versus mode, there are issues with it not respawing at mission checkpoints in Co-op. These grenades make a difference in Warface’s arsenal against Blackwood, so here is what we are going to do: Everybody who owned the World Cup smoke grenade at one point in time will receive a minimum of two months for the yellow smoke grenade (Smoke Grenade III). Additionally if you still have the World Cup smoke grenade, we will match the time for this as well and give you the yellow smoke grenade for the same amount of time on top. This means for example, that if you owned the World Cup smoke grenade from the beginning and you still have it for 3 more months - you will have 5 months of the yellow smoke grenade and if you already own the yellow smoke grenade, this 5 month period will be added on top of whatever amount of time is currently left for those grenades. We are planning to implement it this week.

notes.title: Game Update: Welcome to Nevada
notes.notes:
https://www.warface.com/files/news/_950x/WF-EN-GameUpdate-23072014.jpg
The global fight between Warface and Blackwood has reached the US: Nevada is an all new battleground and both sides fully intend on honoring Nevada's nickname: The Battle Born State. The first map in the all new Nevada setting is the Team Deathmatch map Trailer Park.

You will fight between camper vans, trailers and old school busses near the local airport in a hot and dusty desert. The map is the biggest Versus map in Warface yet, and you will have to switch up your game to be successful. Use the more open and interactive environment to get ahead in the battle, but  beware, you are fighting in a dust bowl and every launching aircraft can change the visibility dramatically, giving a totally different class a sudden edge.

Trailer Park is the first map that was built specifically in response to feedback we received from our players in the west and is also being released first in the Western version of Warface.

Here is a first look at the map

The second map of the update is Vault, a Capture map based in the Favelas of South America. The map was already available over the last couple of weeks as a World Cup special edition and due to the popularity we want to offer you the chance to keep playing on this map in the standard version.

Weapons

notes.title: GAME UPDATE: New Daily Bonuses To Help You Gear Up!
notes.notes:
Heads up, soldiers! 

Tomorrow, we will have another game update! What can you look forward to?

We have updated and simplified the login bonus streaks. This impacts your current Streaks as a result. We now have only a single Streak that includes cool items but will reset to Day 1, if you miss a full day. If you successfully reach the end after seven days of consecutive logins, you will receive all of the rewards and return back to Day 1. Check the full streak in the patch notes below!

Plus, to welcome new players on board, we have added several gifts such as resurrection coins and a 7-day VIP booster for those logging in for the first time and additional resurrections coins for those who complete the Basic tutorial.

And of course, we cannot forget about the shop rotation with Katana making a sharp comeback!

To implement all of these changes, Warface servers will be down at the following times: 
EU: Wednesday July 9th 9AM - 11AM CEST
US: Wednesday July 9th 3AM - 5AM EST

Apologies for any inconvenience. In the meantime, you can check the full list of patch notes below:


WARFACE PATCH NOTES
9th July 2014

Important Changes
------
The Consecutive Login Feature has been simplified and the content has been changed. This impacts users current Streaks as a result:

• Duration: 8h

• For a limited time, new players receive a 7-day VIP booster.
• The Regular mission in Coop mode is now unlocked by default for all players.
• The Quick Play section is shown as default in all Versus channels instead of the Standard Lobby Browser. All maps available are listed inside the Quick Play map list.
